        x = h.reshape(B * Lc, Fc, d)
        kpm = pad[:, None, :].expand(B, Lc, Fc).reshape(B * Lc, Fc)   # [B*L,F] True => ignore
        x = self.enc(x, src_key_padding_mask=kpm)
        return x.reshape(B, Lc, Fc, d)


class Model(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d: int = 72, d_a: int = 16, d_dna: int = 32, n_blocks: int = 3):
        super().__init__()
        self.d_dna = d_dna
        self.assay_emb = nn.Embedding(F, d_a)
        self.dna = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(4, d_dna, kernel_size=15, padding=7), nn.GELU(),
            nn.Conv1d(d_dna, d_dna, kernel_size=15, padding=7), nn.GELU(),
        )
        # fuse avg+max pooled DNA (motif preservation) -> shared d_dna features
        self.dna_proj = nn.Linear(2 * d_dna, d_dna)
        # FiLM: assay embedding -> per-assay (gamma,beta) modulating the shared DNA features
        self.dna_film = nn.Linear(d_a, 2 * d_dna)
        # scalars: count, avail, is_query, depth_in, depth_tgt, control, ctx_mean, ctx_max => 8
        in_dim = 8 + d_a + d_dna
        self.in_proj = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(in_dim, d), nn.GELU(), nn.LayerNorm(d))
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList()
        dils = [1, 2, 4, 4]
        for i in range(n_blocks):
            self.blocks.append(Spatial(d, dil=dils[i]))
            self.blocks.append(CrossAssay(d))
        self.head_r = nn.Linear(d, 1)        # NB dispersion (depth-free)
        self.head_mu = nn.Linear(d, 1)       # NB base enrichment (depth-free)
        # deeper signal head reads latent + depth-free log-enrichment (physics-grounded rank prior)
        self.head_sig = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(d + 1, d), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(d, 1))
        self.head_pk = nn.Linear(d, 1)       # peak logit (enriched-bin readout)
        self.disp_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(F))   # per-assay dispersion offset

    def forward(self, x_counts, x_avail, x_mask, x_meta, x_dna,
                control, ctrl_avail, y_meta, query_mask):
        B = x_counts.shape[0]
        dev = x_counts.device

        # DNA tower -> per-bin features via avg+max pooling (preserve motif-scale peaks)
        dna = self.dna(x_dna.transpose(1, 2))                          # [B,d_dna,19200]
        dna_a = Fn.avg_pool1d(dna, POOL)                               # [B,d_dna,L]
        dna_m = Fn.max_pool1d(dna, POOL)                               # [B,d_dna,L]
        dna = torch.cat([dna_a, dna_m], dim=1).transpose(1, 2)         # [B,L,2*d_dna]
        dna = self.dna_proj(dna)                                       # [B,L,d_dna]
        dna = dna[:, :, None, :].expand(B, L, F, self.d_dna)           # broadcast over assays

        # assay embedding + assay-conditioned FiLM on the (otherwise shared) DNA features
        ae0 = self.assay_emb(torch.arange(F, device=dev))              # [F,d_a]
        gamma, beta = self.dna_film(ae0).chunk(2, dim=-1)              # each [F,d_dna]
        dna = dna * (1.0 + gamma[None, None]) + beta[None, None]       # [B,L,F,d_dna]

        present = x_avail > 0                                          # [B,F]
        pad = ~present                                                 # True = absent (ignore)
        cnt = torch.arcsinh(x_counts) * x_avail[:, None, :]            # [B,L,F]
        av = x_avail[:, None, :].expand(B, L, F)
        is_query = x_mask.float()                                      # CLOZE flag [B,L,F]
        dep_in = x_meta[:, 0, :][:, None, :].expand(B, L, F)           # input depth_log2
        dep_tgt = y_meta[:, 0, :][:, None, :].expand(B, L, F)          # target depth_log2
        ctrl = (control[:, :, 0] * ctrl_avail[:, None])[:, :, None].expand(B, L, F)

        # explicit cross-assay context priors over PRESENT assays per position (mean + max)
        avf = x_avail[:, None, :]                                      # [B,1,F]
        ctx_sum = (cnt * avf).sum(dim=-1)                              # [B,L]
        ctx_cnt = x_avail.sum(dim=-1).clamp(min=1.0)                   # [B]
        ctx_mean = (ctx_sum / ctx_cnt[:, None])[:, :, None].expand(B, L, F)
        cnt_masked = cnt.masked_fill(~present[:, None, :], float("-inf"))
        ctx_max = cnt_masked.max(dim=-1).values.clamp(min=0.0)[:, :, None].expand(B, L, F)

        scal = torch.stack([cnt, av, is_query, dep_in, dep_tgt, ctrl, ctx_mean, ctx_max], dim=-1)

        ae = ae0[None, None, :, :].expand(B, L, F, ae0.shape[-1])
        feat = torch.cat([scal, ae, dna], dim=-1)                      # [B,L,F,in_dim]

        h = self.in_proj(feat)                                         # [B,L,F,d]
        for blk in self.blocks:
            h = blk(h, pad) if isinstance(blk, CrossAssay) else blk(h)

        r = Fn.softplus(self.head_r(h).squeeze(-1) + self.disp_bias) + 1e-2   # [B,L,F]
        mu_base = Fn.softplus(self.head_mu(h).squeeze(-1)) + 1e-3      # depth-free enrichment
        size = torch.pow(2.0, (y_meta[:, 0, :] - REF_DEPTH).clamp(-4, 4))[:, None, :]
        mu = mu_base * size                                           # full-depth mean
        probs = (mu / (mu + r)).clamp(1e-4, 1 - 1e-4)
        count_dist = torch.distributions.NegativeBinomial(total_count=r, probs=probs)
        log_enr = torch.log(mu_base + 1e-3).unsqueeze(-1)             # [B,L,F,1]
        signal_pred = self.head_sig(torch.cat([h, log_enr], dim=-1)).squeeze(-1)
        peak_prob = torch.sigmoid(self.head_pk(h).squeeze(-1))        # [B,L,F]
        return {"count_dist": count_dist, "signal_pred": signal_pred, "peak_prob": peak_prob}


class Objective:
    """ONE noise process: sample a depth level (denoising) AND mask a high fraction of present
    assays (imputation); target is always full-depth counts. Masked (imputation) positions are
    upweighted and a per-track Pearson loss on the masked tracks directly optimizes the rank-based
    imputation Spearman that is scored."""

    LEVELS = [("counts", "meta"),
              ("counts_dsf2", "meta_dsf2"),
              ("counts_dsf4", "meta_dsf4"),
              ("counts_dsf8", "meta_dsf8")]

    IMP_W = 3.0   # imputation (masked) positions weighted over denoising (kept) positions

    def corrupt(self, batch, rng):
        avail = batch["avail"]
        counts_full, meta_full = batch["counts"], batch["meta"]
        B, Lc, Fc = counts_full.shape
        dev = counts_full.device

        li = int(torch.randint(0, len(self.LEVELS), (1,), generator=rng).item())
        ck, mk = self.LEVELS[li]
        x_counts = batch[ck].clone()
        x_meta = batch[mk]

        x_avail = avail.clone()
        x_mask = torch.zeros(B, Lc, Fc, dtype=torch.bool, device=dev)
        for b in range(B):
            present = torch.where(avail[b] > 0)[0]
            n = present.numel()
            if n <= 1:
                continue
            # deployment-matched: drop a high fraction of present assays; keep >=1 as context
            frac = 0.30 + 0.45 * float(torch.rand((1,), generator=rng).item())
            k = max(1, min(n - 1, int(round(frac * n))))
            drop = present[torch.randperm(n, generator=rng)[:k]]
            x_avail[b, drop] = 0.0
            x_mask[b, :, drop] = True
        x_counts = x_counts * x_avail[:, None, :]

        sup_mask = (avail > 0)[:, None, :].expand(B, Lc, Fc).clone()
        thr = torch.quantile(counts_full, 0.90, dim=1, keepdim=True)   # [B,1,F]
        y_peaks = (counts_full > thr).float()
        return {
            "x_counts": x_counts, "x_avail": x_avail, "x_mask": x_mask, "x_meta": x_meta,
            "x_dna": batch["dna"], "control": batch["control"], "ctrl_avail": batch["ctrl_avail"],
            "y_meta": meta_full, "query_mask": (avail > 0),
            "y_counts": counts_full, "sup_mask": sup_mask, "y_peaks": y_peaks,
        }

    def _corr_imp(self, pred, tgt, track_imp):
        """Mean (1 - Pearson) over masked imputation tracks; per-(sample,assay) over positions."""
        if track_imp.sum() == 0:
            return pred.sum() * 0.0
        p = pred - pred.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True)            # center over L
        t = tgt - tgt.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True)
        num = (p * t).sum(dim=1)                             # [B,F]
        den = torch.sqrt(((p * p).sum(dim=1)).clamp(min=1e-6) *
                         ((t * t).sum(dim=1)).clamp(min=1e-6))
        corr = (num / den)[track_imp]                        # masked tracks only
        return 1.0 - corr.mean()

    def loss(self, out, cb):
        m = cb["sup_mask"]
        if m.sum() == 0:
            return (out["signal_pred"].sum() * 0.0).requires_grad_(True)
        y = cb["y_counts"].clamp(min=0)
        w = torch.where(cb["x_mask"], self.IMP_W, 1.0) * m.float()
        wsum = w.sum().clamp(min=1.0)

        nll = -out["count_dist"].log_prob(y)
        sig_tgt = torch.arcsinh(y)
        mse = (out["signal_pred"] - sig_tgt) ** 2
        nll_t = (nll * w).sum() / wsum
        mse_t = (mse * w).sum() / wsum

        track_imp = cb["x_mask"][:, 0, :] & (cb["query_mask"])         # [B,F] dropped & present
        corr_t = self._corr_imp(out["signal_pred"], sig_tgt, track_imp)

        pk_logit = torch.logit(out["peak_prob"].clamp(1e-4, 1 - 1e-4))
        bce = Fn.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(pk_logit[m], cb["y_peaks"][m])
        return nll_t + 0.5 * mse_t + 3.0 * corr_t + 1.0 * bce

    def configure_optimizer(self, params):
        return torch.optim.AdamW(params, lr=2e-3, weight_decay=3e-4)

"""CANDI v3 — cross-assay imputation with a UNIFIED enrichment field anchoring the signal rank.

Carried-forward diagnosis: the only scored headroom is S_A = held-out V/B imputation Spearman.
For a fully-masked assay the model has ZERO input counts, so its enrichment ranking must be
inferred from (a) the OTHER PRESENT assays at the same position (cross-assay correlation) and
(b) DNA. The availability-masked set-transformer (every assay attends ONLY to present context
assays) is kept — it is the core imputation pathway.

Highest-leverage change over the prior best: UNIFY the signal readout with the NB likelihood
instead of letting a free MLP head invent its own ranking. The crucial, previously under-used
fact is that `sup_mask` supervises the MASKED (imputation) tracks with their true full-depth
counts — so the NB NLL is the *real* imputation training signal, and it directly shapes the
depth-free enrichment field `mu_base`. I therefore ANCHOR the scored signal to that field:
`signal_pred = log(mu_base) + residual(h)`. The NB NLL on held-out tracks now flows straight
into the quantity that determines the scored Spearman, with a light learned residual for
rank refinement — exactly the menu's "predict ONE latent enrichment field, derive the views".

Reinforcing: (a) the rank-targeted per-track Pearson loss on masked tracks (differentiable
analogue of the scored Spearman) is upweighted and the competing MSE downweighted, so the
enrichment field is optimized for ranking rather than absolute magnitude; (b) the fraction of
present context assays is fed as a confidence feature (more present assays => more reliable
imputation); (c) mean+max cross-assay priors retained (peak co-occurrence cue).

Everything principled preserved: ONE NB likelihood (depth only via size-factor offset),
per-assay dispersion (ECE floor), motif-preserving avg+max DNA pooling under per-assay FiLM,
derived top-decile peak readout, unified dropout+downsample corruption matched to deployment,
imputation upweighting, control-optional, fixed decoder, dilated + cross-assay backbone, no JEPA.
"""

F = 8           # assays
L = 768         # bins
POOL = 25       # 19200 bp / 768 bins
REF_DEPTH = 23.0


class Spatial(nn.Module):
    """Dilated depthwise-separable conv over position, applied per-assay (memory-efficient)."""

    def __init__(self, d: int, dil: int):
        super().__init__()
        self.dw = nn.Conv1d(d, d, kernel_size=5, padding=2 * dil, dilation=dil, groups=d)
        self.pw = nn.Conv1d(d, d, kernel_size=1)
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d)

    def forward(self, h):                                  # h: [B,L,F,d]
        B, Lc, Fc, d = h.shape
        x = h.permute(0, 2, 3, 1).reshape(B * Fc, d, Lc)   # [B*F, d, L]
        y = self.pw(Fn.gelu(self.dw(x)))
        y = y.reshape(B, Fc, d, Lc).permute(0, 3, 1, 2)    # [B,L,F,d]
        return self.norm(h + y)


class CrossAssay(nn.Module):
    """Set-transformer over the F assays at each position, attending ONLY to present assays."""

    def __init__(self, d: int, nhead: int = 4, dropout: float = 0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.enc = nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
            d_model=d, nhead=nhead, dim_feedforward=2 * d, dropout=dropout, batch_first=True
        )

    def forward(self, h, pad):                             # h: [B,L,F,d]; pad: [B,F] True=absent
        B, Lc, Fc, d = h.shape
        x = h.reshape(B * Lc, Fc, d)
        kpm = pad[:, None, :].expand(B, Lc, Fc).reshape(B * Lc, Fc)   # [B*L,F] True => ignore
        x = self.enc(x, src_key_padding_mask=kpm)
        return x.reshape(B, Lc, Fc, d)


class Model(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d: int = 72, d_a: int = 16, d_dna: int = 32, n_blocks: int = 3):
        super().__init__()
        self.d_dna = d_dna
        self.assay_emb = nn.Embedding(F, d_a)
        self.dna = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(4, d_dna, kernel_size=15, padding=7), nn.GELU(),
            nn.Conv1d(d_dna, d_dna, kernel_size=15, padding=7), nn.GELU(),
        )
        # fuse avg+max pooled DNA (motif preservation) -> shared d_dna features
        self.dna_proj = nn.Linear(2 * d_dna, d_dna)
        # FiLM: assay embedding -> per-assay (gamma,beta) modulating the shared DNA features
        self.dna_film = nn.Linear(d_a, 2 * d_dna)
        # scalars: count, avail, is_query, depth_in, depth_tgt, control, ctx_mean, ctx_max,
        #          n_present_frac => 9
        in_dim = 9 + d_a + d_dna
        self.in_proj = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(in_dim, d), nn.GELU(), nn.LayerNorm(d))
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList()
        dils = [1, 2, 4, 4]
        for i in range(n_blocks):
            self.blocks.append(Spatial(d, dil=dils[i]))
            self.blocks.append(CrossAssay(d))
        self.head_r = nn.Linear(d, 1)        # NB dispersion (depth-free)
        self.head_mu = nn.Linear(d, 1)       # NB base enrichment (depth-free) == the latent field
        # signal head: LIGHT residual on top of the log-enrichment anchor (rank refinement only)
        self.head_sig = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(d, d), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(d, 1))
        self.head_pk = nn.Linear(d, 1)       # peak logit (enriched-bin readout)
        self.disp_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(F))   # per-assay dispersion offset

    def forward(self, x_counts, x_avail, x_mask, x_meta, x_dna,
                control, ctrl_avail, y_meta, query_mask):
        B = x_counts.shape[0]
        dev = x_counts.device

        # DNA tower -> per-bin features via avg+max pooling (preserve motif-scale peaks)
        dna = self.dna(x_dna.transpose(1, 2))                          # [B,d_dna,19200]
        dna_a = Fn.avg_pool1d(dna, POOL)                               # [B,d_dna,L]
        dna_m = Fn.max_pool1d(dna, POOL)                               # [B,d_dna,L]
        dna = torch.cat([dna_a, dna_m], dim=1).transpose(1, 2)         # [B,L,2*d_dna]
        dna = self.dna_proj(dna)                                       # [B,L,d_dna]
        dna = dna[:, :, None, :].expand(B, L, F, self.d_dna)           # broadcast over assays

        # assay embedding + assay-conditioned FiLM on the (otherwise shared) DNA features
        ae0 = self.assay_emb(torch.arange(F, device=dev))              # [F,d_a]
        gamma, beta = self.dna_film(ae0).chunk(2, dim=-1)              # each [F,d_dna]
        dna = dna * (1.0 + gamma[None, None]) + beta[None, None]       # [B,L,F,d_dna]

        present = x_avail > 0                                          # [B,F]
        pad = ~present                                                 # True = absent (ignore)
        cnt = torch.arcsinh(x_counts) * x_avail[:, None, :]            # [B,L,F]
        av = x_avail[:, None, :].expand(B, L, F)
        is_query = x_mask.float()                                      # CLOZE flag [B,L,F]
        dep_in = x_meta[:, 0, :][:, None, :].expand(B, L, F)           # input depth_log2
        dep_tgt = y_meta[:, 0, :][:, None, :].expand(B, L, F)          # target depth_log2
        ctrl = (control[:, :, 0] * ctrl_avail[:, None])[:, :, None].expand(B, L, F)

        # explicit cross-assay context priors over PRESENT assays per position (mean + max)
        avf = x_avail[:, None, :]                                      # [B,1,F]
        ctx_sum = (cnt * avf).sum(dim=-1)                              # [B,L]
        n_present = x_avail.sum(dim=-1).clamp(min=1.0)                 # [B]
        ctx_mean = (ctx_sum / n_present[:, None])[:, :, None].expand(B, L, F)
        cnt_masked = cnt.masked_fill(~present[:, None, :], float("-inf"))
        ctx_max = cnt_masked.max(dim=-1).values.clamp(min=0.0)[:, :, None].expand(B, L, F)
        # confidence feature: fraction of assays present as context
        n_frac = (n_present / F)[:, None, None].expand(B, L, F)

        scal = torch.stack(
            [cnt, av, is_query, dep_in, dep_tgt, ctrl, ctx_mean, ctx_max, n_frac], dim=-1)

        ae = ae0[None, None, :, :].expand(B, L, F, ae0.shape[-1])
        feat = torch.cat([scal, ae, dna], dim=-1)                      # [B,L,F,in_dim]

        h = self.in_proj(feat)                                         # [B,L,F,d]
        for blk in self.blocks:
            h = blk(h, pad) if isinstance(blk, CrossAssay) else blk(h)

        r = Fn.softplus(self.head_r(h).squeeze(-1) + self.disp_bias) + 1e-2   # [B,L,F]
        mu_base = Fn.softplus(self.head_mu(h).squeeze(-1)) + 1e-3      # depth-free enrichment field
        size = torch.pow(2.0, (y_meta[:, 0, :] - REF_DEPTH).clamp(-4, 4))[:, None, :]
        mu = mu_base * size                                           # full-depth mean
        probs = (mu / (mu + r)).clamp(1e-4, 1 - 1e-4)
        count_dist = torch.distributions.NegativeBinomial(total_count=r, probs=probs)
        # UNIFIED readout: signal rank is ANCHORED to the NB enrichment field + light residual.
        # NB NLL on held-out (masked) tracks therefore trains the scored ranking directly.
        log_enr = torch.log(mu_base + 1e-3)                           # [B,L,F]
        signal_pred = log_enr + self.head_sig(h).squeeze(-1)
        peak_prob = torch.sigmoid(self.head_pk(h).squeeze(-1))        # [B,L,F]
        return {"count_dist": count_dist, "signal_pred": signal_pred, "peak_prob": peak_prob}


class Objective:
    """ONE noise process: sample a depth level (denoising) AND mask a high fraction of present
    assays (imputation); target is always full-depth counts. The masked (imputation) tracks are
    supervised with their true full-depth counts (sup_mask uses ORIGINAL avail), upweighted, and a
    per-track Pearson loss on those tracks directly optimizes the scored imputation Spearman."""

    LEVELS = [("counts", "meta"),
              ("counts_dsf2", "meta_dsf2"),
              ("counts_dsf4", "meta_dsf4"),
              ("counts_dsf8", "meta_dsf8")]

    IMP_W = 4.0   # imputation (masked) positions weighted over denoising (kept) positions

    def corrupt(self, batch, rng):
        avail = batch["avail"]
        counts_full, meta_full = batch["counts"], batch["meta"]
        B, Lc, Fc = counts_full.shape
        dev = counts_full.device

        li = int(torch.randint(0, len(self.LEVELS), (1,), generator=rng).item())
        ck, mk = self.LEVELS[li]
        x_counts = batch[ck].clone()
        x_meta = batch[mk]

        x_avail = avail.clone()
        x_mask = torch.zeros(B, Lc, Fc, dtype=torch.bool, device=dev)
        for b in range(B):
            present = torch.where(avail[b] > 0)[0]
            n = present.numel()
            if n <= 1:
                continue
            # deployment-matched: drop a high fraction of present assays; keep >=1 as context
            frac = 0.30 + 0.45 * float(torch.rand((1,), generator=rng).item())
            k = max(1, min(n - 1, int(round(frac * n))))
            drop = present[torch.randperm(n, generator=rng)[:k]]
            x_avail[b, drop] = 0.0
            x_mask[b, :, drop] = True
        x_counts = x_counts * x_avail[:, None, :]

        sup_mask = (avail > 0)[:, None, :].expand(B, Lc, Fc).clone()
        thr = torch.quantile(counts_full, 0.90, dim=1, keepdim=True)   # [B,1,F]
        y_peaks = (counts_full > thr).float()
        return {
            "x_counts": x_counts, "x_avail": x_avail, "x_mask": x_mask, "x_meta": x_meta,
            "x_dna": batch["dna"], "control": batch["control"], "ctrl_avail": batch["ctrl_avail"],
            "y_meta": meta_full, "query_mask": (avail > 0),
            "y_counts": counts_full, "sup_mask": sup_mask, "y_peaks": y_peaks,
        }

    def _corr_imp(self, pred, tgt, track_imp):
        """Mean (1 - Pearson) over masked imputation tracks; per-(sample,assay) over positions."""
        if track_imp.sum() == 0:
            return pred.sum() * 0.0
        p = pred - pred.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True)            # center over L
        t = tgt - tgt.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True)
        num = (p * t).sum(dim=1)                             # [B,F]
        den = torch.sqrt(((p * p).sum(dim=1)).clamp(min=1e-6) *
                         ((t * t).sum(dim=1)).clamp(min=1e-6))
        corr = (num / den)[track_imp]                        # masked tracks only
        return 1.0 - corr.mean()

    def loss(self, out, cb):
        m = cb["sup_mask"]
        if m.sum() == 0:
            return (out["signal_pred"].sum() * 0.0).requires_grad_(True)
        y = cb["y_counts"].clamp(min=0)
        w = torch.where(cb["x_mask"], self.IMP_W, 1.0) * m.float()
        wsum = w.sum().clamp(min=1.0)

        nll = -out["count_dist"].log_prob(y)
        sig_tgt = torch.arcsinh(y)
        mse = (out["signal_pred"] - sig_tgt) ** 2
        nll_t = (nll * w).sum() / wsum
        mse_t = (mse * w).sum() / wsum

        track_imp = cb["x_mask"][:, 0, :] & (cb["query_mask"])         # [B,F] dropped & present
        corr_t = self._corr_imp(out["signal_pred"], sig_tgt, track_imp)

        pk_logit = torch.logit(out["peak_prob"].clamp(1e-4, 1 - 1e-4))
        bce = Fn.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(pk_logit[m], cb["y_peaks"][m])
        # NB NLL anchors the enrichment field (the scored signal); rank loss dominates the
        # refinement; MSE is light (Spearman is rank-only); BCE is a light auxiliary readout.
        return nll_t + 0.3 * mse_t + 4.0 * corr_t + 0.5 * bce

    def configure_optimizer(self, params):
        return torch.optim.AdamW(params, lr=2e-3, weight_decay=3e-4)

  - Slightly higher headline weight on the per-track Pearson (rank) loss — it is the scored
    objective's differentiable analogue — and it is computed on masked tracks only.

assay), explicit is_query CLOZE flag, ONE NB likelihood with depth ONLY through the size-factor
offset, per-assay dispersion (ECE floor), depth-free enrichment anchoring the signal head,

F = 8           # assays
L = 768         # bins
POOL = 25       # 19200 bp / 768 bins
REF_DEPTH = 23.0


class Spatial(nn.Module):
    """Dilated depthwise-separable conv over position, applied per-assay (memory-efficient)."""

    def __init__(self, d: int, dil: int):
        super().__init__()
        self.dw = nn.Conv1d(d, d, kernel_size=5, padding=2 * dil, dilation=dil, groups=d)
        self.pw = nn.Conv1d(d, d, kernel_size=1)
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d)

    def forward(self, h):                                  # h: [B,L,F,d]
        B, Lc, Fc, d = h.shape
        x = h.permute(0, 2, 3, 1).reshape(B * Fc, d, Lc)   # [B*F, d, L]
        y = self.pw(Fn.gelu(self.dw(x)))
        y = y.reshape(B, Fc, d, Lc).permute(0, 3, 1, 2)    # [B,L,F,d]
        return self.norm(h + y)


class CrossAssay(nn.Module):
    """Set-transformer over the F assays at each position. Queries attend ONLY to observed-assay
    keys (key_padding_mask) so a held-out/CLOZE assay reads genuine co-assay evidence, not empty
    masked tokens."""

    def __init__(self, d: int, nhead: int = 4, dropout: float = 0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.enc = nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
            d_model=d, nhead=nhead, dim_feedforward=2 * d, dropout=dropout, batch_first=True
        )

    def forward(self, h, key_pad):                         # h:[B,L,F,d]  key_pad:[B*L,F] True=ignore
        B, Lc, Fc, d = h.shape
        x = h.reshape(B * Lc, Fc, d)
        x = self.enc(x, src_key_padding_mask=key_pad)
        return x.reshape(B, Lc, Fc, d)


class Model(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d: int = 64, d_a: int = 16, d_dna: int = 32, n_blocks: int = 4):
        super().__init__()
        self.d_dna = d_dna
        self.assay_emb = nn.Embedding(F, d_a)
        self.dna = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(4, d_dna, kernel_size=15, padding=7), nn.GELU(),
            nn.Conv1d(d_dna, d_dna, kernel_size=15, padding=7), nn.GELU(),
        )
        # FiLM: assay embedding -> per-assay (gamma,beta) modulating the shared DNA features
        self.dna_film = nn.Linear(d_a, 2 * d_dna)
        # scalar token feats: count, avail, is_query, depth_in, depth_tgt, control, coassay_mean => 7
        in_dim = 7 + d_a + d_dna
        self.in_proj = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(in_dim, d), nn.GELU(), nn.LayerNorm(d))
        self.dils = [1, 2, 4, 8]
        self.spatial = nn.ModuleList([Spatial(d, dil=self.dils[i]) for i in range(n_blocks)])
        self.cross = nn.ModuleList([CrossAssay(d) for _ in range(n_blocks)])
        self.n_blocks = n_blocks
        self.head_r = nn.Linear(d, 1)        # NB dispersion (depth-free)
        self.head_mu = nn.Linear(d, 1)       # NB base enrichment (depth-free)
        # signal head reads latent + the depth-free log-enrichment (physics-grounded rank prior)
        self.head_sig = nn.Linear(d + 1, 1)  # signal readout (arcsinh full-depth counts)
        self.head_pk = nn.Linear(d, 1)       # peak logit (enriched-bin readout)
        self.disp_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(F))   # per-assay dispersion offset

    def forward(self, x_counts, x_avail, x_mask, x_meta, x_dna,
                control, ctrl_avail, y_meta, query_mask):
        B = x_counts.shape[0]
        dev = x_counts.device

        # DNA tower -> per-bin features
        dna = self.dna(x_dna.transpose(1, 2))                          # [B,d_dna,19200]
        dna = Fn.avg_pool1d(dna, POOL).transpose(1, 2)                 # [B,L,d_dna]
        dna = dna[:, :, None, :].expand(B, L, F, self.d_dna)           # broadcast over assays

        # assay embedding + assay-conditioned FiLM on the (otherwise shared) DNA features
        ae0 = self.assay_emb(torch.arange(F, device=dev))              # [F,d_a]
        gamma, beta = self.dna_film(ae0).chunk(2, dim=-1)              # each [F,d_dna]
        dna = dna * (1.0 + gamma[None, None]) + beta[None, None]       # [B,L,F,d_dna]

        cnt = torch.arcsinh(x_counts) * x_avail[:, None, :]            # [B,L,F]
        av = x_avail[:, None, :].expand(B, L, F)
        is_query = x_mask.float()                                      # CLOZE flag [B,L,F]
        dep_in = x_meta[:, 0, :][:, None, :].expand(B, L, F)           # input depth_log2
        dep_tgt = y_meta[:, 0, :][:, None, :].expand(B, L, F)          # target depth_log2
        ctrl = (control[:, :, 0] * ctrl_avail[:, None])[:, :, None].expand(B, L, F)

        # explicit co-assay co-localization prior: per-position mean arcsinh-count over the
        # genuinely-observed assays (masked assays contribute 0 -> naturally excluded). This is
        # the strongest sample-specific evidence for a held-out assay; broadcast to every token so
        # the cross-assay attention REFINES it rather than rebuilding it from scratch.
        n_obs = x_avail.sum(dim=1).clamp(min=1.0)                      # [B]
        coassay = (cnt.sum(dim=2) / n_obs[:, None])[:, :, None].expand(B, L, F)  # [B,L,F]

        scal = torch.stack([cnt, av, is_query, dep_in, dep_tgt, ctrl, coassay], dim=-1)  # [B,L,F,7]

        ae = ae0[None, None, :, :].expand(B, L, F, ae0.shape[-1])
        feat = torch.cat([scal, ae, dna], dim=-1)                      # [B,L,F,in_dim]

        # cross-assay key padding: queries attend ONLY to genuinely-observed assays (>=1 per sample)
        key_pad = (x_avail <= 0)                                       # [B,F] True = ignore (masked/absent)
        key_pad = key_pad[:, None, :].expand(B, L, F).reshape(B * L, F)

        h = self.in_proj(feat)                                         # [B,L,F,d]
        for i in range(self.n_blocks):
            h = self.spatial[i](h)
            h = self.cross[i](h, key_pad)

        r = Fn.softplus(self.head_r(h).squeeze(-1) + self.disp_bias) + 1e-2   # [B,L,F]
        mu_base = Fn.softplus(self.head_mu(h).squeeze(-1)) + 1e-3      # depth-free enrichment
        size = torch.pow(2.0, (y_meta[:, 0, :] - REF_DEPTH).clamp(-4, 4))[:, None, :]
        mu = mu_base * size                                           # full-depth mean
        probs = (mu / (mu + r)).clamp(1e-4, 1 - 1e-4)
        count_dist = torch.distributions.NegativeBinomial(total_count=r, probs=probs)
        log_enr = torch.log(mu_base + 1e-3).unsqueeze(-1)             # [B,L,F,1]
        signal_pred = self.head_sig(torch.cat([h, log_enr], dim=-1)).squeeze(-1)
        peak_prob = torch.sigmoid(self.head_pk(h).squeeze(-1))        # [B,L,F]
        return {"count_dist": count_dist, "signal_pred": signal_pred, "peak_prob": peak_prob}


class Objective:
    """ONE noise process: sample a depth level (denoising) AND mask a moderate, deployment-matched
    fraction of present assays (imputation); target is always full-depth counts. Masked positions
    are upweighted and a per-track Pearson loss on masked tracks directly optimizes the scored
    rank-based imputation Spearman."""

    LEVELS = [("counts", "meta"),
              ("counts_dsf2", "meta_dsf2"),
              ("counts_dsf4", "meta_dsf4"),
              ("counts_dsf8", "meta_dsf8")]

    IMP_W = 3.0   # imputation (masked) positions weighted over denoising (kept) positions

    def corrupt(self, batch, rng):
        avail = batch["avail"]
        counts_full, meta_full = batch["counts"], batch["meta"]
        B, Lc, Fc = counts_full.shape
        dev = counts_full.device

        li = int(torch.randint(0, len(self.LEVELS), (1,), generator=rng).item())
        ck, mk = self.LEVELS[li]
        x_counts = batch[ck].clone()
        x_meta = batch[mk]

        x_avail = avail.clone()
        x_mask = torch.zeros(B, Lc, Fc, dtype=torch.bool, device=dev)
        for b in range(B):
            present = torch.where(avail[b] > 0)[0]
            n = present.numel()
            if n <= 1:
                continue
            # deployment-matched: keep a realistic context set, fully mask the imputation targets
            frac = 0.20 + 0.40 * float(torch.rand((1,), generator=rng).item())
            k = max(1, min(n - 1, int(round(frac * n))))
            drop = present[torch.randperm(n, generator=rng)[:k]]
            x_avail[b, drop] = 0.0
            x_mask[b, :, drop] = True
        x_counts = x_counts * x_avail[:, None, :]

        sup_mask = (avail > 0)[:, None, :].expand(B, Lc, Fc).clone()
        thr = torch.quantile(counts_full, 0.90, dim=1, keepdim=True)   # [B,1,F]
        y_peaks = (counts_full > thr).float()
        return {
            "x_counts": x_counts, "x_avail": x_avail, "x_mask": x_mask, "x_meta": x_meta,
            "x_dna": batch["dna"], "control": batch["control"], "ctrl_avail": batch["ctrl_avail"],
            "y_meta": meta_full, "query_mask": (avail > 0),
            "y_counts": counts_full, "sup_mask": sup_mask, "y_peaks": y_peaks,
        }

    def _corr_imp(self, pred, tgt, track_imp):
        """Mean (1 - Pearson) over masked imputation tracks; per-(sample,assay) over positions."""
        if track_imp.sum() == 0:
            return pred.sum() * 0.0
        p = pred - pred.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True)            # center over L
        t = tgt - tgt.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True)
        num = (p * t).sum(dim=1)                             # [B,F]
        den = torch.sqrt(((p * p).sum(dim=1)).clamp(min=1e-6) *
                         ((t * t).sum(dim=1)).clamp(min=1e-6))
        corr = (num / den)[track_imp]                        # masked tracks only
        return 1.0 - corr.mean()

    def loss(self, out, cb):
        m = cb["sup_mask"]
        if m.sum() == 0:
            return (out["signal_pred"].sum() * 0.0).requires_grad_(True)
        y = cb["y_counts"].clamp(min=0)
        w = torch.where(cb["x_mask"], self.IMP_W, 1.0) * m.float()
        wsum = w.sum().clamp(min=1.0)

        nll = -out["count_dist"].log_prob(y)
        sig_tgt = torch.arcsinh(y)
        mse = (out["signal_pred"] - sig_tgt) ** 2
        nll_t = (nll * w).sum() / wsum
        mse_t = (mse * w).sum() / wsum

        track_imp = cb["x_mask"][:, 0, :] & (cb["query_mask"])         # [B,F] dropped & present
        corr_t = self._corr_imp(out["signal_pred"], sig_tgt, track_imp)

        pk_logit = torch.logit(out["peak_prob"].clamp(1e-4, 1 - 1e-4))
        bce = Fn.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(pk_logit[m], cb["y_peaks"][m])
        return nll_t + 0.5 * mse_t + 4.0 * corr_t + 1.0 * bce

    def configure_optimizer(self, params):
        return torch.optim.AdamW(params, lr=2e-3, weight_decay=3e-4)

target) and maximize Pearson(signal_pred, rank(target)). Maximizing correlation against the
target's ranks is a direct, stable differentiable surrogate for Spearman — exactly the scored
quantity — and de-emphasizes the few extreme peaks that previously hijacked the gradient. I also
bias the corruption toward the high-mask deployment regime (whole held-out assays) and upweight
imputation, so the budget is spent where it is scored.

        probs = (mu / (mu + r)).clamp(1e-4, 1 - 1e-4)
        count_dist = torch.distributions.NegativeBinomial(total_count=r, probs=probs)
        log_enr = torch.log(mu_base + 1e-3).unsqueeze(-1)             # [B,L,F,1]
        signal_pred = self.head_sig(torch.cat([h, log_enr], dim=-1)).squeeze(-1)
        peak_prob = torch.sigmoid(self.head_pk(h).squeeze(-1))        # [B,L,F]
        return {"count_dist": count_dist, "signal_pred": signal_pred, "peak_prob": peak_prob}


class Objective:
    """ONE noise process: sample a depth level (denoising) AND mask a high fraction of present
    assays (imputation); target is always full-depth counts. Masked (imputation) positions are
    upweighted and a RANK-TARGETED correlation loss on the masked tracks directly optimizes the
    Spearman that is scored (vs the prior Pearson which the heavy enrichment tail distorted)."""

    LEVELS = [("counts", "meta"),
              ("counts_dsf2", "meta_dsf2"),
              ("counts_dsf4", "meta_dsf4"),
              ("counts_dsf8", "meta_dsf8")]

    IMP_W = 4.0   # imputation (masked) positions weighted over denoising (kept) positions

    def corrupt(self, batch, rng):
        avail = batch["avail"]
        counts_full, meta_full = batch["counts"], batch["meta"]
        B, Lc, Fc = counts_full.shape
        dev = counts_full.device

        li = int(torch.randint(0, len(self.LEVELS), (1,), generator=rng).item())
        ck, mk = self.LEVELS[li]
        x_counts = batch[ck].clone()
        x_meta = batch[mk]

        x_avail = avail.clone()
        x_mask = torch.zeros(B, Lc, Fc, dtype=torch.bool, device=dev)
        for b in range(B):
            present = torch.where(avail[b] > 0)[0]
            n = present.numel()
            if n <= 1:
                continue
            # deployment-matched: drop a HIGH fraction of present assays (whole held-out assays);
            # keep >=1 as context. Biased high to match the imputation eval regime.
            frac = 0.40 + 0.40 * float(torch.rand((1,), generator=rng).item())
            k = max(1, min(n - 1, int(round(frac * n))))
            drop = present[torch.randperm(n, generator=rng)[:k]]
            x_avail[b, drop] = 0.0
            x_mask[b, :, drop] = True
        x_counts = x_counts * x_avail[:, None, :]

        sup_mask = (avail > 0)[:, None, :].expand(B, Lc, Fc).clone()
        thr = torch.quantile(counts_full, 0.90, dim=1, keepdim=True)   # [B,1,F]
        y_peaks = (counts_full > thr).float()
        return {
            "x_counts": x_counts, "x_avail": x_avail, "x_mask": x_mask, "x_meta": x_meta,
            "x_dna": batch["dna"], "control": batch["control"], "ctrl_avail": batch["ctrl_avail"],
            "y_meta": meta_full, "query_mask": (avail > 0),
            "y_counts": counts_full, "sup_mask": sup_mask, "y_peaks": y_peaks,
        }

    @staticmethod
    def _rank_along_L(x):
        """Rank-transform x along position (dim=1) -> float ranks [B,L,F]. No grad needed."""
        order = x.argsort(dim=1)
        ranks = torch.empty_like(order)
        ar = torch.arange(x.shape[1], device=x.device)
        ranks.scatter_(1, order, ar[:, None].expand_as(order))
        return ranks.float()

    def _spearman_surrogate(self, pred, tgt, track_imp):
        """Mean (1 - Pearson(pred, rank(tgt))) over masked imputation tracks — a stable,
        differentiable surrogate for the scored Spearman (rank correlation)."""
        if track_imp.sum() == 0:
            return pred.sum() * 0.0
        tr = self._rank_along_L(tgt)                          # rank target along L (no grad)
        p = pred - pred.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True)             # center over L
        t = tr - tr.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True)
        num = (p * t).sum(dim=1)                              # [B,F]
        den = torch.sqrt(((p * p).sum(dim=1)).clamp(min=1e-6) *
                         ((t * t).sum(dim=1)).clamp(min=1e-6))
        corr = (num / den)[track_imp]                         # masked tracks only
        return 1.0 - corr.mean()

    def loss(self, out, cb):
        m = cb["sup_mask"]
        if m.sum() == 0:
            return (out["signal_pred"].sum() * 0.0).requires_grad_(True)
        y = cb["y_counts"].clamp(min=0)
        w = torch.where(cb["x_mask"], self.IMP_W, 1.0) * m.float()
        wsum = w.sum().clamp(min=1.0)

        nll = -out["count_dist"].log_prob(y)
        sig_tgt = torch.arcsinh(y)
        mse = (out["signal_pred"] - sig_tgt) ** 2
        nll_t = (nll * w).sum() / wsum
        mse_t = (mse * w).sum() / wsum

        track_imp = cb["x_mask"][:, 0, :] & (cb["query_mask"])         # [B,F] dropped & present
        corr_t = self._spearman_surrogate(out["signal_pred"], sig_tgt, track_imp)

        pk_logit = torch.logit(out["peak_prob"].clamp(1e-4, 1 - 1e-4))
        bce = Fn.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(pk_logit[m], cb["y_peaks"][m])
        # rank surrogate is the scored quantity -> primary; mse small (anchors magnitude/stability)
        return nll_t + 0.25 * mse_t + 3.0 * corr_t + 1.0 * bce

    def configure_optimizer(self, params):
        return torch.optim.AdamW(params, lr=2e-3, weight_decay=3e-4)

"""CANDI v3 — LEARNED co-assay attention imputation on top of a gated cross-assay backbone.

The single scored lever is held-out V/B imputation Spearman: for a fully-masked assay the model
has NO observed counts of its own, so its prediction must be borrowed from the genuinely-observed
co-assays. The prior version handed the model only the UNDIFFERENTIATED mean over observed assays
(identical for every held-out target at a position) — that cannot separate, say, an H3K27ac target
from an H3K9me3 target, so all discrimination had to be (slowly) rediscovered inside attention.

mark-colocalization premise made a first-class predictor):

  coassay[b,l,t] = sum_{s observed} softmax_s(q[t]·k[s]) * arcsinh_count[b,l,s]

i.e. for each TARGET assay t we learn (via assay embeddings) how much to weight each OBSERVED
source assay s, renormalized per-sample over whatever is actually present (availability-masked
softmax → control-optional, variable assay sets handled natively). This is a direct, position-wise
linear imputation in arcsinh space that converges in a handful of steps and is, by itself, a strong
Spearman predictor. It is fed BOTH as an input token feature AND added as a skip term to the final
signal head, so signal_pred = coassay + latent residual: early training rides the cheap co-assay
combination, the transformer only has to learn the residual structure.

Kept (all helped before): one NB likelihood with depth ONLY through the size-factor offset (ECE
floor, DCR band), per-assay dispersion, depth-free enrichment, assay-conditioned FiLM on DNA,
dilated depthwise-separable spatial conv + per-position set attention (memory-efficient, no O(L^2)),
MISSING-vs-CLOZE flag, deployment-matched 0.2-0.6 masking, derived peak head, control-optional,
fixed decoder, no JEPA. The differentiable per-track Pearson rank loss (proxy for the scored
Spearman) remains the dominant objective term.

F = 8           # assays
L = 768         # bins
POOL = 25       # 19200 bp / 768 bins
REF_DEPTH = 23.0


class Spatial(nn.Module):
    """Dilated depthwise-separable conv over position, applied per-assay (memory-efficient)."""

    def __init__(self, d: int, dil: int):
        super().__init__()
        self.dw = nn.Conv1d(d, d, kernel_size=5, padding=2 * dil, dilation=dil, groups=d)
        self.pw = nn.Conv1d(d, d, kernel_size=1)
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d)

    def forward(self, h):                                  # h: [B,L,F,d]
        B, Lc, Fc, d = h.shape
        x = h.permute(0, 2, 3, 1).reshape(B * Fc, d, Lc)   # [B*F, d, L]
        y = self.pw(Fn.gelu(self.dw(x)))
        y = y.reshape(B, Fc, d, Lc).permute(0, 3, 1, 2)    # [B,L,F,d]
        return self.norm(h + y)


class CrossAssay(nn.Module):
    """Set-transformer over the F assays at each position. Queries attend ONLY to observed-assay
    keys (key_padding_mask) so a held-out/CLOZE assay reads genuine co-assay evidence."""

    def __init__(self, d: int, nhead: int = 6, dropout: float = 0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.enc = nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
            d_model=d, nhead=nhead, dim_feedforward=2 * d, dropout=dropout, batch_first=True
        )

    def forward(self, h, key_pad):                         # h:[B,L,F,d]  key_pad:[B*L,F] True=ignore
        B, Lc, Fc, d = h.shape
        x = h.reshape(B * Lc, Fc, d)
        x = self.enc(x, src_key_padding_mask=key_pad)
        return x.reshape(B, Lc, Fc, d)


class Model(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d: int = 96, d_a: int = 24, d_dna: int = 48, d_aff: int = 32, n_blocks: int = 4):
        super().__init__()
        self.d_dna = d_dna
        self.assay_emb = nn.Embedding(F, d_a)
        self.dna = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(4, d_dna, kernel_size=15, padding=7), nn.GELU(),
            nn.Conv1d(d_dna, d_dna, kernel_size=15, padding=7), nn.GELU(),
        )
        self.dna_film = nn.Linear(d_a, 2 * d_dna)
        # learned assay->assay affinity for the explicit co-assay imputation
        self.aff_q = nn.Linear(d_a, d_aff)
        self.aff_k = nn.Linear(d_a, d_aff)
        self.d_aff = d_aff
        # scalar token feats: count, avail, is_query, depth_in, depth_tgt, control, coassay => 7
        in_dim = 7 + d_a + d_dna
        self.in_proj = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(in_dim, d), nn.GELU(), nn.LayerNorm(d))
        self.dils = [1, 2, 4, 8]
        self.n_blocks = n_blocks
        self.spatial = nn.ModuleList([Spatial(d, dil=self.dils[i % len(self.dils)]) for i in range(n_blocks)])
        self.cross = nn.ModuleList([CrossAssay(d) for _ in range(n_blocks)])
        self.head_r = nn.Linear(d, 1)        # NB dispersion (depth-free)
        self.head_mu = nn.Linear(d, 1)       # NB base enrichment (depth-free)
        # signal head: residual MLP over latent + depth-free log-enrichment; added to coassay skip
        self.head_sig = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(d + 1, d), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(d, 1))
        self.head_pk = nn.Linear(d, 1)       # peak logit (enriched-bin readout)
        self.disp_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(F))
        self.sig_gain = nn.Parameter(torch.tensor(0.3))   # blend gain on learned residual

    def _coassay(self, cnt, x_avail, ae0):
        """Learned availability-masked assay->assay imputation in arcsinh space. cnt:[B,L,F]."""
        B = cnt.shape[0]
        q = self.aff_q(ae0)                                            # [F_tgt, d_aff]
        k = self.aff_k(ae0)                                            # [F_src, d_aff]
        scores = (q @ k.t()) / (self.d_aff ** 0.5)                     # [F_tgt, F_src]
        scores = scores[None].expand(B, F, F).clone()                  # [B,F_tgt,F_src]
        src_ok = (x_avail > 0)[:, None, :].expand(B, F, F)             # observable sources
        scores = scores.masked_fill(~src_ok, -1e9)
        w = torch.softmax(scores, dim=-1)                              # [B,F_tgt,F_src]
        w = torch.nan_to_num(w, nan=0.0)                               # samples w/ no source
        return torch.einsum("bts,bls->blt", w, cnt)                    # [B,L,F_tgt]

    def forward(self, x_counts, x_avail, x_mask, x_meta, x_dna,
                control, ctrl_avail, y_meta, query_mask):
        B = x_counts.shape[0]
        dev = x_counts.device

        dna = self.dna(x_dna.transpose(1, 2))                          # [B,d_dna,19200]
        dna = Fn.avg_pool1d(dna, POOL).transpose(1, 2)                 # [B,L,d_dna]
        dna = dna[:, :, None, :].expand(B, L, F, self.d_dna)

        ae0 = self.assay_emb(torch.arange(F, device=dev))              # [F,d_a]
        gamma, beta = self.dna_film(ae0).chunk(2, dim=-1)
        dna = dna * (1.0 + gamma[None, None]) + beta[None, None]       # [B,L,F,d_dna]

        cnt = torch.arcsinh(x_counts) * x_avail[:, None, :]            # context-only arcsinh signal
        av = x_avail[:, None, :].expand(B, L, F)
        is_query = x_mask.float()
        dep_in = x_meta[:, 0, :][:, None, :].expand(B, L, F)
        dep_tgt = y_meta[:, 0, :][:, None, :].expand(B, L, F)
        ctrl = (control[:, :, 0] * ctrl_avail[:, None])[:, :, None].expand(B, L, F)

        coassay = self._coassay(cnt, x_avail, ae0)                     # [B,L,F] learned imputation
        scal = torch.stack([cnt, av, is_query, dep_in, dep_tgt, ctrl, coassay], dim=-1)  # [B,L,F,7]

        ae = ae0[None, None, :, :].expand(B, L, F, ae0.shape[-1])
        feat = torch.cat([scal, ae, dna], dim=-1)

        key_pad = (x_avail <= 0)
        key_pad = key_pad[:, None, :].expand(B, L, F).reshape(B * L, F)

        h = self.in_proj(feat)
        for i in range(self.n_blocks):
            h = self.spatial[i](h)
            h = self.cross[i](h, key_pad)

        r = Fn.softplus(self.head_r(h).squeeze(-1) + self.disp_bias) + 1e-2
        mu_base = Fn.softplus(self.head_mu(h).squeeze(-1)) + 1e-3
        size = torch.pow(2.0, (y_meta[:, 0, :] - REF_DEPTH).clamp(-4, 4))[:, None, :]
        mu = mu_base * size
        probs = (mu / (mu + r)).clamp(1e-4, 1 - 1e-4)
        count_dist = torch.distributions.NegativeBinomial(total_count=r, probs=probs)

        log_enr = torch.log(mu_base + 1e-3).unsqueeze(-1)
        resid = self.head_sig(torch.cat([h, log_enr], dim=-1)).squeeze(-1)
        signal_pred = coassay + self.sig_gain * resid                  # ride co-assay, learn residual
        peak_prob = torch.sigmoid(self.head_pk(h).squeeze(-1))
        return {"count_dist": count_dist, "signal_pred": signal_pred, "peak_prob": peak_prob}


class Objective:
    """ONE noise process: sample a depth level (denoising) AND mask a deployment-matched fraction of
    present assays (imputation); target is always full-depth counts. Masked positions are upweighted
    and a per-track Pearson loss on masked tracks directly optimizes the scored imputation Spearman."""

    LEVELS = [("counts", "meta"),
              ("counts_dsf2", "meta_dsf2"),
              ("counts_dsf4", "meta_dsf4"),
              ("counts_dsf8", "meta_dsf8")]

    IMP_W = 3.0

    def corrupt(self, batch, rng):
        avail = batch["avail"]
        counts_full, meta_full = batch["counts"], batch["meta"]
        B, Lc, Fc = counts_full.shape
        dev = counts_full.device

        li = int(torch.randint(0, len(self.LEVELS), (1,), generator=rng).item())
        ck, mk = self.LEVELS[li]
        x_counts = batch[ck].clone()
        x_meta = batch[mk]

        x_avail = avail.clone()
        x_mask = torch.zeros(B, Lc, Fc, dtype=torch.bool, device=dev)
        for b in range(B):
            present = torch.where(avail[b] > 0)[0]
            n = present.numel()
            if n <= 1:
                continue
            frac = 0.20 + 0.40 * float(torch.rand((1,), generator=rng).item())
            k = max(1, min(n - 1, int(round(frac * n))))
            drop = present[torch.randperm(n, generator=rng)[:k]]
            x_avail[b, drop] = 0.0
            x_mask[b, :, drop] = True
        x_counts = x_counts * x_avail[:, None, :]

        sup_mask = (avail > 0)[:, None, :].expand(B, Lc, Fc).clone()
        thr = torch.quantile(counts_full, 0.90, dim=1, keepdim=True)
        y_peaks = (counts_full > thr).float()
        return {
            "x_counts": x_counts, "x_avail": x_avail, "x_mask": x_mask, "x_meta": x_meta,
            "x_dna": batch["dna"], "control": batch["control"], "ctrl_avail": batch["ctrl_avail"],
            "y_meta": meta_full, "query_mask": (avail > 0),
            "y_counts": counts_full, "sup_mask": sup_mask, "y_peaks": y_peaks,
        }

    def _corr_imp(self, pred, tgt, track_imp):
        if track_imp.sum() == 0:
            return pred.sum() * 0.0
        p = pred - pred.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True)
        t = tgt - tgt.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True)
        num = (p * t).sum(dim=1)
        den = torch.sqrt(((p * p).sum(dim=1)).clamp(min=1e-6) *
                         ((t * t).sum(dim=1)).clamp(min=1e-6))
        corr = (num / den)[track_imp]
        return 1.0 - corr.mean()

    def loss(self, out, cb):
        m = cb["sup_mask"]
        if m.sum() == 0:
            return (out["signal_pred"].sum() * 0.0).requires_grad_(True)
        y = cb["y_counts"].clamp(min=0)
        w = torch.where(cb["x_mask"], self.IMP_W, 1.0) * m.float()
        wsum = w.sum().clamp(min=1.0)

        nll = -out["count_dist"].log_prob(y)
        sig_tgt = torch.arcsinh(y)
        mse = (out["signal_pred"] - sig_tgt) ** 2
        nll_t = (nll * w).sum() / wsum
        mse_t = (mse * w).sum() / wsum

        track_imp = cb["x_mask"][:, 0, :] & (cb["query_mask"])
        corr_t = self._corr_imp(out["signal_pred"], sig_tgt, track_imp)

        pk_logit = torch.logit(out["peak_prob"].clamp(1e-4, 1 - 1e-4))
        bce = Fn.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(pk_logit[m], cb["y_peaks"][m])
        return nll_t + 0.5 * mse_t + 4.0 * corr_t + 1.0 * bce

    def configure_optimizer(self, params):
        return torch.optim.AdamW(params, lr=2e-3, weight_decay=3e-4)

        self.d_dna = d_dna
        self.d_a = d_a
        self.assay_emb = nn.Embedding(F, d_a)
        self.dna = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(4, d_dna, kernel_size=15, padding=7), nn.GELU(),
            nn.Conv1d(d_dna, d_dna, kernel_size=15, padding=7), nn.GELU(),
        )
        # fuse avg+max pooled DNA (motif preservation) -> shared d_dna features
        self.dna_proj = nn.Linear(2 * d_dna, d_dna)
        # FiLM: assay embedding -> per-assay (gamma,beta) modulating the shared DNA features
        self.dna_film = nn.Linear(d_a, 2 * d_dna)
        # affinity temperature for the learned cross-assay imputation prior
        self.aff_logtemp = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1))
        # scalar token feats: count, avail, is_query, depth_in, depth_tgt, control, ctx_mean,
        # ctx_aff (learned affinity-weighted cross-assay context) => 8
        in_dim = 8 + d_a + d_dna
        self.in_proj = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(in_dim, d), nn.GELU(), nn.LayerNorm(d))
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList()
        dils = [1, 2, 4, 8]
        for i in range(n_blocks):
            self.blocks.append(Spatial(d, dil=dils[i % len(dils)]))
            self.blocks.append(CrossAssay(d))
        self.head_r = nn.Linear(d, 1)        # NB dispersion (depth-free)
        self.head_mu = nn.Linear(d, 1)       # NB base enrichment (depth-free)
        # deeper signal head reads latent + depth-free log-enrichment + affinity prior
        self.head_sig = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(d + 2, d), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(d, 1))
        self.head_pk = nn.Linear(d, 1)       # peak logit (enriched-bin readout)
        self.disp_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(F))   # per-assay dispersion offset

    def forward(self, x_counts, x_avail, x_mask, x_meta, x_dna,
                control, ctrl_avail, y_meta, query_mask):
        B = x_counts.shape[0]
        dev = x_counts.device

        # DNA tower -> per-bin features via avg+max pooling (preserve motif-scale peaks)
        dna = self.dna(x_dna.transpose(1, 2))                          # [B,d_dna,19200]
        dna_a = Fn.avg_pool1d(dna, POOL)                               # [B,d_dna,L]
        dna_m = Fn.max_pool1d(dna, POOL)                               # [B,d_dna,L]
        dna = torch.cat([dna_a, dna_m], dim=1).transpose(1, 2)         # [B,L,2*d_dna]
        dna = self.dna_proj(dna)                                       # [B,L,d_dna]
        dna = dna[:, :, None, :].expand(B, L, F, self.d_dna)           # broadcast over assays

        # assay embedding + assay-conditioned FiLM on the (otherwise shared) DNA features
        ae0 = self.assay_emb(torch.arange(F, device=dev))              # [F,d_a]
        gamma, beta = self.dna_film(ae0).chunk(2, dim=-1)              # each [F,d_dna]
        dna = dna * (1.0 + gamma[None, None]) + beta[None, None]       # [B,L,F,d_dna]

        cnt = torch.arcsinh(x_counts) * x_avail[:, None, :]            # [B,L,F]
        av = x_avail[:, None, :].expand(B, L, F)
        is_query = x_mask.float()                                      # CLOZE flag [B,L,F]
        dep_in = x_meta[:, 0, :][:, None, :].expand(B, L, F)           # input depth_log2
        dep_tgt = y_meta[:, 0, :][:, None, :].expand(B, L, F)          # target depth_log2
        ctrl = (control[:, :, 0] * ctrl_avail[:, None])[:, :, None].expand(B, L, F)

        # plain context prior: mean arcsinh-count over PRESENT assays per position
        ctx_sum = (cnt * x_avail[:, None, :]).sum(dim=-1)              # [B,L]
        ctx_cnt = x_avail.sum(dim=-1).clamp(min=1.0)                   # [B]
        ctx = (ctx_sum / ctx_cnt[:, None])[:, :, None].expand(B, L, F) # [B,L,F]

        # LEARNED cross-assay affinity prior: for each target assay t, attention-weighted
        # combination of the PRESENT source assays' arcsinh counts (per-assay linear imputer)
        temp = Fn.softplus(self.aff_logtemp) + 1e-2
        aff = (ae0 @ ae0.t()) / (math.sqrt(self.d_a) * temp)          # [F,F]
        mask_src = (x_avail > 0).float()                              # [B,F] present sources
        aff_b = aff[None].expand(B, F, F) + (mask_src[:, None, :] - 1.0) * 1e9
        w = torch.softmax(aff_b, dim=-1)                             # [B,F(target),F(source)]
        ctx_aff = torch.einsum('bts,bls->blt', w, cnt)               # [B,L,F]

        scal = torch.stack([cnt, av, is_query, dep_in, dep_tgt, ctrl, ctx, ctx_aff], dim=-1)

        ae = ae0[None, None, :, :].expand(B, L, F, self.d_a)
        feat = torch.cat([scal, ae, dna], dim=-1)                      # [B,L,F,in_dim]

        h = self.in_proj(feat)                                         # [B,L,F,d]
        for blk in self.blocks:
            h = blk(h)

        r = Fn.softplus(self.head_r(h).squeeze(-1) + self.disp_bias) + 1e-2   # [B,L,F]
        mu_base = Fn.softplus(self.head_mu(h).squeeze(-1)) + 1e-3      # depth-free enrichment
        size = torch.pow(2.0, (y_meta[:, 0, :] - REF_DEPTH).clamp(-4, 4))[:, None, :]
        mu = mu_base * size                                           # full-depth mean
        probs = (mu / (mu + r)).clamp(1e-4, 1 - 1e-4)
        count_dist = torch.distributions.NegativeBinomial(total_count=r, probs=probs)
        log_enr = torch.log(mu_base + 1e-3)                          # [B,L,F]
        sig_in = torch.cat([h, log_enr.unsqueeze(-1), ctx_aff.unsqueeze(-1)], dim=-1)
        signal_pred = self.head_sig(sig_in).squeeze(-1)
        peak_prob = torch.sigmoid(self.head_pk(h).squeeze(-1))        # [B,L,F]
        return {"count_dist": count_dist, "signal_pred": signal_pred, "peak_prob": peak_prob}


class Objective:
    """ONE noise process: sample a depth level (denoising) AND mask a high fraction of present
    assays (imputation); target is always full-depth counts. Masked (imputation) positions are
    upweighted and a per-track Pearson loss on the masked tracks directly optimizes the rank-based
    imputation Spearman that is scored."""

    LEVELS = [("counts", "meta"),
              ("counts_dsf2", "meta_dsf2"),
              ("counts_dsf4", "meta_dsf4"),
              ("counts_dsf8", "meta_dsf8")]

    IMP_W = 3.0   # imputation (masked) positions weighted over denoising (kept) positions

    def corrupt(self, batch, rng):
        avail = batch["avail"]
        counts_full, meta_full = batch["counts"], batch["meta"]
        B, Lc, Fc = counts_full.shape
        dev = counts_full.device

        li = int(torch.randint(0, len(self.LEVELS), (1,), generator=rng).item())
        ck, mk = self.LEVELS[li]
        x_counts = batch[ck].clone()
        x_meta = batch[mk]

        x_avail = avail.clone()
        x_mask = torch.zeros(B, Lc, Fc, dtype=torch.bool, device=dev)
        for b in range(B):
            present = torch.where(avail[b] > 0)[0]
            n = present.numel()
            if n <= 1:
                continue
            # deployment-matched: drop a high fraction of present assays; keep >=1 as context
            frac = 0.30 + 0.45 * float(torch.rand((1,), generator=rng).item())
            k = max(1, min(n - 1, int(round(frac * n))))
            drop = present[torch.randperm(n, generator=rng)[:k]]
            x_avail[b, drop] = 0.0
            x_mask[b, :, drop] = True
        x_counts = x_counts * x_avail[:, None, :]

        sup_mask = (avail > 0)[:, None, :].expand(B, Lc, Fc).clone()
        thr = torch.quantile(counts_full, 0.90, dim=1, keepdim=True)   # [B,1,F]
        y_peaks = (counts_full > thr).float()
        return {
            "x_counts": x_counts, "x_avail": x_avail, "x_mask": x_mask, "x_meta": x_meta,
            "x_dna": batch["dna"], "control": batch["control"], "ctrl_avail": batch["ctrl_avail"],
            "y_meta": meta_full, "query_mask": (avail > 0),
            "y_counts": counts_full, "sup_mask": sup_mask, "y_peaks": y_peaks,
        }

    def _corr_imp(self, pred, tgt, track_imp):
        """Mean (1 - Pearson) over masked imputation tracks; per-(sample,assay) over positions."""
        if track_imp.sum() == 0:
            return pred.sum() * 0.0
        p = pred - pred.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True)            # center over L
        t = tgt - tgt.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True)
        num = (p * t).sum(dim=1)                             # [B,F]
        den = torch.sqrt(((p * p).sum(dim=1)).clamp(min=1e-6) *
                         ((t * t).sum(dim=1)).clamp(min=1e-6))
        corr = (num / den)[track_imp]                        # masked tracks only
        return 1.0 - corr.mean()

    def loss(self, out, cb):
        m = cb["sup_mask"]
        if m.sum() == 0:
            return (out["signal_pred"].sum() * 0.0).requires_grad_(True)
        y = cb["y_counts"].clamp(min=0)
        w = torch.where(cb["x_mask"], self.IMP_W, 1.0) * m.float()
        wsum = w.sum().clamp(min=1.0)

        nll = -out["count_dist"].log_prob(y)
        sig_tgt = torch.arcsinh(y)
        mse = (out["signal_pred"] - sig_tgt) ** 2
        nll_t = (nll * w).sum() / wsum
        mse_t = (mse * w).sum() / wsum

        track_imp = cb["x_mask"][:, 0, :] & (cb["query_mask"])         # [B,F] dropped & present
        corr_t = self._corr_imp(out["signal_pred"], sig_tgt, track_imp)

        pk_logit = torch.logit(out["peak_prob"].clamp(1e-4, 1 - 1e-4))
        bce = Fn.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(pk_logit[m], cb["y_peaks"][m])
        return nll_t + 0.5 * mse_t + 2.5 * corr_t + 1.0 * bce

    def configure_optimizer(self, params):
        return torch.optim.AdamW(params, lr=2e-3, weight_decay=3e-4)

"""CANDI v3 — co-assay-ANCHORED imputation: the signal head predicts a RESIDUAL on top of an
explicit co-assay co-localization baseline, instead of regressing the held-out track from scratch.

Diagnosis of the prior best (−0.118, below the 0.4652 baseline): the strongest single predictor of
a held-out assay's signal is the per-position co-localization of the genuinely-observed co-assays
(the eDICE/Avocado premise), and the prior program injected it only as ONE input feature among many.
A time-limited, underfit backbone then still had to LEARN to route that feature to the output rank —
and within 600 s it under-learned that routing, landing below the co-localization baseline itself.

Fix: make the co-assay baseline the SIGNAL HEAD'S ANCHOR. signal_pred = g·coassay + b + residual,
with per-assay learnable gain g (init 1) and bias b (init 0). At step 0 the prediction already EQUALS
the co-localization baseline (so even an underfit model scores ≈ baseline, not below it), and the
backbone spends its limited capacity only on the per-assay CORRECTION that lifts the rank above the
unweighted-mean prior — exactly what a tight budget can afford. The anchor is computed from x_avail
AFTER masking, so masked assays are excluded — identical to eval, where V_/B_ assays are never seen.

Everything that helped is kept: gated cross-assay set-transformer (held-out tokens attend ONLY to
observed-assay keys via key_padding_mask), assay-conditioned DNA via FiLM, dilated depthwise backbone
(reach to dilation 8), ONE NB likelihood with depth ONLY through the size-factor offset, per-assay
dispersion (ECE floor), depth-free enrichment, deployment-matched 0.2–0.6 mask schedule, derived
top-decile peak head, control-optional, fixed decoder, no JEPA. NB count head (DCR/ECE) is untouched.
"""

import torch

F = 8           # assays
L = 768         # bins
POOL = 25       # 19200 bp / 768 bins
REF_DEPTH = 23.0


class Spatial(nn.Module):
    """Dilated depthwise-separable conv over position, applied per-assay (memory-efficient)."""

    def __init__(self, d: int, dil: int):
        super().__init__()
        self.dw = nn.Conv1d(d, d, kernel_size=5, padding=2 * dil, dilation=dil, groups=d)
        self.pw = nn.Conv1d(d, d, kernel_size=1)
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d)

    def forward(self, h):                                  # h: [B,L,F,d]
        B, Lc, Fc, d = h.shape
        x = h.permute(0, 2, 3, 1).reshape(B * Fc, d, Lc)   # [B*F, d, L]
        y = self.pw(Fn.gelu(self.dw(x)))
        y = y.reshape(B, Fc, d, Lc).permute(0, 3, 1, 2)    # [B,L,F,d]
        return self.norm(h + y)


class CrossAssay(nn.Module):
    """Set-transformer over the F assays at each position. Queries attend ONLY to observed-assay
    keys (key_padding_mask) so a held-out/CLOZE assay reads genuine co-assay evidence."""

    def __init__(self, d: int, nhead: int = 4, dropout: float = 0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.enc = nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
            d_model=d, nhead=nhead, dim_feedforward=2 * d, dropout=dropout, batch_first=True
        )

    def forward(self, h, key_pad):                         # h:[B,L,F,d]  key_pad:[B*L,F] True=ignore
        B, Lc, Fc, d = h.shape
        x = h.reshape(B * Lc, Fc, d)
        x = self.enc(x, src_key_padding_mask=key_pad)
        return x.reshape(B, Lc, Fc, d)


class Model(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d: int = 64, d_a: int = 16, d_dna: int = 32, n_blocks: int = 4):
        super().__init__()
        self.d_dna = d_dna
        self.assay_emb = nn.Embedding(F, d_a)
        self.dna = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv1d(4, d_dna, kernel_size=15, padding=7), nn.GELU(),
            nn.Conv1d(d_dna, d_dna, kernel_size=15, padding=7), nn.GELU(),
        )
        self.dna_film = nn.Linear(d_a, 2 * d_dna)
        # scalar token feats: count, avail, is_query, depth_in, depth_tgt, control, coassay_mean,
        # coassay_max => 8
        in_dim = 8 + d_a + d_dna
        self.in_proj = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(in_dim, d), nn.GELU(), nn.LayerNorm(d))
        self.dils = [1, 2, 4, 8]
        self.spatial = nn.ModuleList([Spatial(d, dil=self.dils[i]) for i in range(n_blocks)])
        self.cross = nn.ModuleList([CrossAssay(d) for _ in range(n_blocks)])
        self.n_blocks = n_blocks
        self.head_r = nn.Linear(d, 1)        # NB dispersion (depth-free)
        self.head_mu = nn.Linear(d, 1)       # NB base enrichment (depth-free)
        # signal head outputs a RESIDUAL on top of the per-assay-gained co-assay anchor
        self.head_sig = nn.Linear(d + 1, 1)
        self.sig_gain = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(F))      # per-assay anchor gain (init 1 = baseline)
        self.sig_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(F))     # per-assay anchor offset
        self.head_pk = nn.Linear(d, 1)       # peak logit (enriched-bin readout)
        self.disp_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(F))    # per-assay dispersion offset

    def forward(self, x_counts, x_avail, x_mask, x_meta, x_dna,
                control, ctrl_avail, y_meta, query_mask):
        B = x_counts.shape[0]
        dev = x_counts.device

        # DNA tower -> per-bin features
        dna = self.dna(x_dna.transpose(1, 2))                          # [B,d_dna,19200]
        dna = Fn.avg_pool1d(dna, POOL).transpose(1, 2)                 # [B,L,d_dna]
        dna = dna[:, :, None, :].expand(B, L, F, self.d_dna)           # broadcast over assays

        # assay embedding + assay-conditioned FiLM on the (shared) DNA features
        ae0 = self.assay_emb(torch.arange(F, device=dev))              # [F,d_a]
        gamma, beta = self.dna_film(ae0).chunk(2, dim=-1)              # each [F,d_dna]
        dna = dna * (1.0 + gamma[None, None]) + beta[None, None]       # [B,L,F,d_dna]

        cnt = torch.arcsinh(x_counts) * x_avail[:, None, :]            # [B,L,F]
        av = x_avail[:, None, :].expand(B, L, F)
        is_query = x_mask.float()                                      # CLOZE flag [B,L,F]
        dep_in = x_meta[:, 0, :][:, None, :].expand(B, L, F)           # input depth_log2
        dep_tgt = y_meta[:, 0, :][:, None, :].expand(B, L, F)          # target depth_log2
        ctrl = (control[:, :, 0] * ctrl_avail[:, None])[:, :, None].expand(B, L, F)

        # explicit co-assay co-localization prior: per-position mean AND max arcsinh-count over the
        # genuinely-observed assays (masked/absent assays contribute 0 -> naturally excluded).
        n_obs = x_avail.sum(dim=1).clamp(min=1.0)                      # [B]
        coassay = cnt.sum(dim=2) / n_obs[:, None]                      # [B,L]
        coassay_max = (cnt + (x_avail[:, None, :] - 1.0) * 1e4).max(dim=2).values  # [B,L] obs-only max
        coassay_max = coassay_max.clamp(min=0.0)
        coB = coassay[:, :, None].expand(B, L, F)                      # [B,L,F]
        coMx = coassay_max[:, :, None].expand(B, L, F)

        scal = torch.stack([cnt, av, is_query, dep_in, dep_tgt, ctrl, coB, coMx], dim=-1)

        ae = ae0[None, None, :, :].expand(B, L, F, ae0.shape[-1])
        feat = torch.cat([scal, ae, dna], dim=-1)                      # [B,L,F,in_dim]

        # cross-assay key padding: queries attend ONLY to genuinely-observed assays
        key_pad = (x_avail <= 0)                                       # [B,F] True = ignore
        key_pad = key_pad[:, None, :].expand(B, L, F).reshape(B * L, F)

        h = self.in_proj(feat)                                         # [B,L,F,d]
        for i in range(self.n_blocks):
            h = self.spatial[i](h)
            h = self.cross[i](h, key_pad)

        r = Fn.softplus(self.head_r(h).squeeze(-1) + self.disp_bias) + 1e-2   # [B,L,F]
        mu_base = Fn.softplus(self.head_mu(h).squeeze(-1)) + 1e-3      # depth-free enrichment
        size = torch.pow(2.0, (y_meta[:, 0, :] - REF_DEPTH).clamp(-4, 4))[:, None, :]
        mu = mu_base * size                                           # full-depth mean
        probs = (mu / (mu + r)).clamp(1e-4, 1 - 1e-4)
        count_dist = torch.distributions.NegativeBinomial(total_count=r, probs=probs)

        # signal = per-assay-gained co-assay ANCHOR + depth-free-enrichment-aware learned residual.
        # At init (gain=1,bias=0,small residual) signal_pred ≈ co-localization baseline.
        log_enr = torch.log(mu_base + 1e-3).unsqueeze(-1)             # [B,L,F,1]
        resid = self.head_sig(torch.cat([h, log_enr], dim=-1)).squeeze(-1)
        anchor = self.sig_gain[None, None, :] * coB + self.sig_bias[None, None, :]
        signal_pred = anchor + resid                                 # [B,L,F]
        peak_prob = torch.sigmoid(self.head_pk(h).squeeze(-1))       # [B,L,F]
        return {"count_dist": count_dist, "signal_pred": signal_pred, "peak_prob": peak_prob}


class Objective:
    """ONE noise process: sample a depth level (denoising) AND mask a moderate, deployment-matched
    fraction of present assays (imputation); target is always full-depth counts. Masked positions
    are upweighted and a per-track Pearson loss on masked tracks directly optimizes the scored rank."""

    LEVELS = [("counts", "meta"),
              ("counts_dsf2", "meta_dsf2"),
              ("counts_dsf4", "meta_dsf4"),
              ("counts_dsf8", "meta_dsf8")]

    IMP_W = 3.0

    def corrupt(self, batch, rng):

        counts_full, meta_full = batch["counts"], batch["meta"]
        B, Lc, Fc = counts_full.shape
        dev = counts_full.device

        ck, mk = self.LEVELS[li]
        x_counts = batch[ck].clone()
        x_meta = batch[mk]

        x_avail = avail.clone()
        x_mask = torch.zeros(B, Lc, Fc, dtype=torch.bool, device=dev)
        for b in range(B):
            present = torch.where(avail[b] > 0)[0]
            n = present.numel()
            if n <= 1:
                continue
            frac = 0.20 + 0.40 * float(torch.rand((1,), generator=rng).item())
            k = max(1, min(n - 1, int(round(frac * n))))
            drop = present[torch.randperm(n, generator=rng)[:k]]
            x_avail[b, drop] = 0.0
            x_mask[b, :, drop] = True
        x_counts = x_counts * x_avail[:, None, :]

        sup_mask = (avail > 0)[:, None, :].expand(B, Lc, Fc).clone()
        thr = torch.quantile(counts_full, 0.90, dim=1, keepdim=True)   # [B,1,F]
        y_peaks = (counts_full > thr).float()
        return {
            "x_counts": x_counts, "x_avail": x_avail, "x_mask": x_mask, "x_meta": x_meta,
            "x_dna": batch["dna"], "control": batch["control"], "ctrl_avail": batch["ctrl_avail"],
            "y_meta": meta_full, "query_mask": (avail > 0),
            "y_counts": counts_full, "sup_mask": sup_mask, "y_peaks": y_peaks,
        }

    def _corr_imp(self, pred, tgt, track_imp):
        """Mean (1 - Pearson) over masked imputation tracks; per-(sample,assay) over positions."""
        if track_imp.sum() == 0:
            return pred.sum() * 0.0
        p = pred - pred.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True)            # center over L
        t = tgt - tgt.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True)
        num = (p * t).sum(dim=1)                             # [B,F]
        den = torch.sqrt(((p * p).sum(dim=1)).clamp(min=1e-6) *
                         ((t * t).sum(dim=1)).clamp(min=1e-6))
        corr = (num / den)[track_imp]                        # masked tracks only
        return 1.0 - corr.mean()

    def loss(self, out, cb):
        m = cb["sup_mask"]
        if m.sum() == 0:
            return (out["signal_pred"].sum() * 0.0).requires_grad_(True)
        y = cb["y_counts"].clamp(min=0)
        w = torch.where(cb["x_mask"], self.IMP_W, 1.0) * m.float()
        wsum = w.sum().clamp(min=1.0)

        nll = -out["count_dist"].log_prob(y)
        sig_tgt = torch.arcsinh(y)
        mse = (out["signal_pred"] - sig_tgt) ** 2
        nll_t = (nll * w).sum() / wsum
        mse_t = (mse * w).sum() / wsum

        track_imp = cb["x_mask"][:, 0, :] & (cb["query_mask"])         # [B,F] dropped & present
        corr_t = self._corr_imp(out["signal_pred"], sig_tgt, track_imp)

        pk_logit = torch.logit(out["peak_prob"].clamp(1e-4, 1 - 1e-4))
        bce = Fn.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(pk_logit[m], cb["y_peaks"][m])
        return nll_t + 0.5 * mse_t + 4.0 * corr_t + 1.0 * bce

    def configure_optimizer(self, params):
        return torch.optim.AdamW(params, lr=2e-3, weight_decay=3e-4)

ingredients; this version concentrates on extracting more *rank* signal from them, because the metric
is a within-track genome-wide Spearman and rank is exactly what a linear NLL readout under-optimizes:

  (1) SHARPER RANK READOUT. The signal head was a single linear map; ranking distal enrichment from
      sequence + neighbour context is nonlinear, so I make it a 2-layer MLP anchored on the log of the
      depth-free enrichment (the quantity whose rank IS the target). I also apply the differentiable
      per-track Pearson loss (the scale/offset-invariant analogue of the scored Spearman) to BOTH the
      signal readout AND the NB enrichment mean, so the likelihood's own location parameter is pushed
      to rank correctly rather than only fit magnitude — this directly couples the learned likelihood
      to the scored quantity.

  (2) RICHER CROSS-ASSAY MIXING. The held-out track must borrow from co-present assays; I give the
      per-position set-transformer more heads and a wider FFN (the cheap axis — only F=8 tokens) so the
      cross-assay borrowing is expressive, and a learnable residual gate so DNA-only positions (no
      context) are not swamped.

  (3) DEPLOYMENT-MATCHED CORRUPTION. Eval holds out a large block of assays; I push the masking
      fraction higher (up to ~0.85, occasionally down to a single context assay) so training sees the
      sparse-context regime it is actually scored on, and upweight masked (imputation) positions.

Everything principled is preserved: ONE NB likelihood (depth ONLY via the size-factor offset),
per-assay dispersion (ECE floor), depth-free enrichment, derived top-decile peak head, control-optional,
fixed decoder, no JEPA.
