    def forward(self, h):                                  # h: [B,L,F,d]
        B, Lc, Fc, d = h.shape
        x = h.permute(0, 2, 3, 1).reshape(B * Fc, d, Lc)   # [B*F, d, L]
        y = self.pw(Fn.gelu(self.dw(x)))
        y = y.reshape(B, Fc, d, Lc).permute(0, 3, 1, 2)    # [B,L,F,d]
        return self.norm(h + y)


class CrossAssay(nn.Module):
    """Set-transformer over the F assays at each position (cross-assay collaborative filtering)."""

    def __init__(self, d: int, nhead: int = 4, dropout: float = 0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.enc = nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
            d_model=d, nhead=nhead, dim_feedforward=2 * d, dropout=dropout, batch_first=True
        )

    def forward(self, h):                                  # h: [B,L,F,d]
        B, Lc, Fc, d = h.shape
        x = h.reshape(B * Lc, Fc, d)
        x = self.enc(x)
        return x.reshape(B, Lc, Fc, d)


class Model(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d: int = 64, d_a: int = 16, d_dna: int = 48, n_blocks: int = 4):
        super().__init__()
        self.d_dna = d_dna
        self.assay_emb = nn.Embedding(F, d_a)
        self.dna = DNATower(d_dna)
        # FiLM: assay embedding -> per-assay (gamma,beta) modulating the shared DNA features
        self.dna_film = nn.Linear(d_a, 2 * d_dna)
        # scalar token feats: count, avail, is_query, depth_in, control => 5 (depth_tgt removed:
        # target depth flows ONLY through the explicit size factor -> enrichment stays depth-free)
        in_dim = 5 + d_a + d_dna
        self.in_proj = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(in_dim, d), nn.GELU(), nn.LayerNorm(d))
        # explicit PER-ASSAY "predict me" token added to every CLOZE/query assay latent
        self.query_emb = nn.Embedding(F, d)
        nn.init.normal_(self.query_emb.weight, std=0.02)
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList()
        dils = [1, 2, 4, 8]
        for i in range(n_blocks):
            self.blocks.append(Spatial(d, dil=dils[i % len(dils)]))
            self.blocks.append(CrossAssay(d))
        self.head_r = nn.Linear(d, 1)        # NB dispersion (depth-free)
        self.head_mu = nn.Linear(d, 1)       # NB base enrichment (depth-free)
        # signal head reads latent + the depth-free log-enrichment (physics-grounded rank prior)
        self.head_sig = nn.Linear(d + 1, 1)  # depth-free enrichment readout (rank target)
        self.disp_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(F))   # per-assay dispersion offset
        # per-assay affine to place each assay on a common genome-wide enrichment scale
        self.sig_scale = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(F))
        self.sig_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(F))
        # peaks = per-assay calibrated readout of the (well-trained) enrichment signal
        self.pk_scale = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(F))
        self.pk_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(F))

    def forward(self, x_counts, x_avail, x_mask, x_meta, x_dna,
                control, ctrl_avail, y_meta, query_mask):
        B = x_counts.shape[0]
        dev = x_counts.device

        # DNA tower -> per-bin features
        dna = self.dna(x_dna)                                          # [B,L,d_dna]
        dna = dna[:, :, None, :].expand(B, L, F, self.d_dna)           # broadcast over assays

        # assay embedding + assay-conditioned FiLM on the (otherwise shared) DNA features
        ae0 = self.assay_emb(torch.arange(F, device=dev))              # [F,d_a]
        gamma, beta = self.dna_film(ae0).chunk(2, dim=-1)              # each [F,d_dna]
        dna = dna * (1.0 + gamma[None, None]) + beta[None, None]       # [B,L,F,d_dna]

        cnt = torch.arcsinh(x_counts) * x_avail[:, None, :]            # [B,L,F]
        av = x_avail[:, None, :].expand(B, L, F)
        is_query = x_mask.float()                                      # CLOZE flag [B,L,F]
        dep_in = x_meta[:, 0, :][:, None, :].expand(B, L, F)           # input depth_log2
        ctrl = (control[:, :, 0] * ctrl_avail[:, None])[:, :, None].expand(B, L, F)
        scal = torch.stack([cnt, av, is_query, dep_in, ctrl], dim=-1)  # [B,L,F,5]

        ae = ae0[None, None, :, :].expand(B, L, F, ae0.shape[-1])
        feat = torch.cat([scal, ae, dna], dim=-1)                      # [B,L,F,in_dim]

        h = self.in_proj(feat)                                         # [B,L,F,d]
        # inject explicit PER-ASSAY query token on positions to be imputed/denoised
        qtok = self.query_emb(torch.arange(F, device=dev))             # [F,d]
        h = h + x_mask.float().unsqueeze(-1) * qtok[None, None]        # [B,L,F,d]
        for blk in self.blocks:
            h = blk(h)

        r = Fn.softplus(self.head_r(h).squeeze(-1) + self.disp_bias) + 1e-2   # [B,L,F]
        mu_base = Fn.softplus(self.head_mu(h).squeeze(-1)) + 1e-3      # depth-FREE enrichment
        size = torch.pow(2.0, (y_meta[:, 0, :] - REF_DEPTH).clamp(-4, 4))[:, None, :]
        mu = mu_base * size                                           # full-depth (raw-count) mean
        probs = (mu / (mu + r)).clamp(1e-4, 1 - 1e-4)
        count_dist = torch.distributions.NegativeBinomial(total_count=r, probs=probs)
        # depth-FREE enrichment readout -> matches the depth-invariant pval rank that is scored
        log_enr = torch.log(mu_base + 1e-3).unsqueeze(-1)             # [B,L,F,1]
        sig = self.head_sig(torch.cat([h, log_enr], dim=-1)).squeeze(-1)
        signal_pred = sig * self.sig_scale + self.sig_bias            # per-assay common-scale affine
        # peaks: per-assay calibrated readout of the enrichment signal (rank rides the strong head)
        peak_prob = torch.sigmoid(signal_pred * self.pk_scale + self.pk_bias)   # [B,L,F]
        return {"count_dist": count_dist, "signal_pred": signal_pred, "peak_prob": peak_prob}


class Objective:
    """TWO eval-matched corruption modes (not one blurred process):
      imp mode  (p=0.6): full-depth (dsf1) context, mask k whole present assays  -> matches the
                         eval imputation pass (Q_imp). corr surrogates on the MASKED entries.
      den mode  (p=0.4): low-depth input (dsf{2,4,8}), mask NONE, target = full-depth dsf1 ->
                         matches the eval denoising pass (Q_den>=Q_imp gate). corr surrogates on
                         ALL present entries.
    NB target = full-depth RAW counts; rank target for the signal corrs = DEPTH-FREE enrichment
    arcsinh(y/size). Surrogates cover BOTH Pearson (centered corr) AND Spearman (Pearson against
    detached POOLED RANKS) for BOTH the signal head and the NB count mean — the four scored corrs."""

    DEN_LEVELS = [("counts_dsf2", "meta_dsf2"),
                  ("counts_dsf4", "meta_dsf4"),
                  ("counts_dsf8", "meta_dsf8")]

    P_IMP = 0.6
    IMP_W = 4.0   # masked imputation positions weighted over kept positions (imp mode)

    def corrupt(self, batch, rng):
        avail = batch["avail"]
        counts_full, meta_full = batch["counts"], batch["meta"]
        B, Lc, Fc = counts_full.shape
        dev = counts_full.device

        imp_mode = float(torch.rand((1,), generator=rng).item()) < self.P_IMP

        x_avail = avail.clone()
        x_mask = torch.zeros(B, Lc, Fc, dtype=torch.bool, device=dev)
        if imp_mode:
            x_counts = counts_full.clone()          # FULL-DEPTH context (matches eval imp pass)
            x_meta = meta_full
            for b in range(B):
                present = torch.where(avail[b] > 0)[0]
                n = present.numel()
                if n <= 1:
                    continue
                frac = 0.20 + 0.30 * float(torch.rand((1,), generator=rng).item())
                k = max(1, min(n - 1, int(round(frac * n))))
                drop = present[torch.randperm(n, generator=rng)[:k]]
                x_avail[b, drop] = 0.0
                x_mask[b, :, drop] = True
            x_counts = x_counts * x_avail[:, None, :]
            corr_sel = x_mask & (avail > 0)[:, None, :]                  # masked & present
            track_sel = x_mask[:, 0, :] & (avail > 0)                    # [B,F]
        else:
            li = int(torch.randint(0, len(self.DEN_LEVELS), (1,), generator=rng).item())
            ck, mk = self.DEN_LEVELS[li]
            x_counts = batch[ck].clone() * x_avail[:, None, :]           # LOW-DEPTH input
            x_meta = batch[mk]                                           # low input depth meta
            corr_sel = (avail > 0)[:, None, :].expand(B, Lc, Fc).clone()  # all present entries
            track_sel = (avail > 0).clone()                             # [B,F]

        sup_mask = (avail > 0)[:, None, :].expand(B, Lc, Fc).clone()
        thr = torch.quantile(counts_full, 0.90, dim=1, keepdim=True)     # [B,1,F]
        y_peaks = (counts_full > thr).float()
        size = torch.pow(2.0, (meta_full[:, 0, :] - REF_DEPTH).clamp(-4, 4))[:, None, :]
        y_enr = torch.arcsinh(counts_full.clamp(min=0) / size.clamp(min=1e-6))  # depth-free rank target
        return {
            "x_counts": x_counts, "x_avail": x_avail, "x_mask": x_mask, "x_meta": x_meta,
            "x_dna": batch["dna"], "control": batch["control"], "ctrl_avail": batch["ctrl_avail"],
            "y_meta": meta_full, "query_mask": (avail > 0),
            "y_counts": counts_full, "sup_mask": sup_mask, "y_peaks": y_peaks, "y_enr": y_enr,
            "corr_sel": corr_sel, "track_sel": track_sel,
        }

    def _corr_per_track(self, pred, tgt, track_sel):
        """Mean (1 - Pearson) over selected tracks; per-(sample,assay) centered over L positions."""
        if track_sel.sum() == 0:
            return pred.sum() * 0.0
        p = pred - pred.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True)
        t = tgt - tgt.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True)
        num = (p * t).sum(dim=1)                             # [B,F]
        den = torch.sqrt(((p * p).sum(dim=1)).clamp(min=1e-6) *
                         ((t * t).sum(dim=1)).clamp(min=1e-6))
        corr = (num / den)[track_sel]
        return 1.0 - corr.mean()

    @staticmethod
    def _pear1(p, t):
        """1 - Pearson over two 1-D tensors (t is treated as a constant target)."""
        p = p - p.mean()
        t = t - t.mean()
        den = (p.norm() * t.norm()).clamp(min=1e-6)
        return 1.0 - (p * t).sum() / den

    def _global_pearson(self, pred, tgt, sel):
        """Pooled Pearson surrogate over the scored entries (the pearson-half of Q)."""
        if sel.sum() < 4:
            return pred.sum() * 0.0
        return self._pear1(pred[sel], tgt[sel])

    def _global_spearman(self, pred, tgt, sel):
        """Pooled Spearman surrogate: Pearson of pred against the detached POOLED RANKS of tgt."""
        if sel.sum() < 4:
            return pred.sum() * 0.0
        t = tgt[sel]
        ranks = torch.argsort(torch.argsort(t)).float()     # detached integer ranks
        return self._pear1(pred[sel], ranks)

    def loss(self, out, cb):
        m = cb["sup_mask"]
        if m.sum() == 0:
            return (out["signal_pred"].sum() * 0.0).requires_grad_(True)
        y = cb["y_counts"].clamp(min=0)
        sig_tgt = cb["y_enr"]                                # depth-free enrichment (pval-rank proxy)
        cnt_tgt = torch.arcsinh(y)                           # count-scale shape target
        cnt_pred = torch.arcsinh(out["count_dist"].mean)

        # mild high-signal upweight: rank-decisive enriched bins
        tnorm = sig_tgt / (sig_tgt.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True).clamp(min=1e-3) + 1e-6)
        hi = 1.0 + 0.5 * tnorm.clamp(0, 4)
        w = torch.where(cb["x_mask"], self.IMP_W, 1.0) * m.float() * hi
        wsum = w.sum().clamp(min=1.0)

        nll = -out["count_dist"].log_prob(y)
        mse = (out["signal_pred"] - sig_tgt) ** 2
        nll_t = (nll * w).sum() / wsum
        mse_t = (mse * w).sum() / wsum

        sel = cb["corr_sel"]
        track_sel = cb["track_sel"]
        # PVAL correlations (signal head): Pearson + Spearman, pooled + per-track
        sig_gp = self._global_pearson(out["signal_pred"], sig_tgt, sel)
        sig_gs = self._global_spearman(out["signal_pred"], sig_tgt, sel)
        sig_pt = self._corr_per_track(out["signal_pred"], sig_tgt, track_sel)
        # COUNT correlations (NB mean): Pearson + Spearman, pooled + per-track
        cnt_gp = self._global_pearson(cnt_pred, cnt_tgt, sel)
        cnt_gs = self._global_spearman(cnt_pred, cnt_tgt, sel)
        cnt_pt = self._corr_per_track(cnt_pred, cnt_tgt, track_sel)

        pk_logit = torch.logit(out["peak_prob"].clamp(1e-4, 1 - 1e-4))
        bce = Fn.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(pk_logit[m], cb["y_peaks"][m])
        return (nll_t + 0.3 * mse_t
                + 2.0 * sig_gp + 2.0 * sig_gs + 0.5 * sig_pt
                + 1.0 * cnt_gp + 1.0 * cnt_gs + 0.5 * cnt_pt
                + 0.5 * bce)

    def configure_optimizer(self, params):
        return torch.optim.AdamW(params, lr=2e-3, weight_decay=3e-4)

"""CANDI v3 — cross-assay collaborative-filtering imputer. This revision attacks the ONE
scored skill term (genome-wide POOLED pval-Spearman on held-out V/B assays) at its root: the
TRAINING TARGET for `signal_pred`.

KEY CHANGE — pval-aligned target via LOCAL-BACKGROUND enrichment (CRITIQUE §2/§9.1):
  The prior version regressed/ranked against depth-normalized counts arcsinh(counts/size).
  But the eval signal is the arcsinh log-*pval* track, and a pval is fundamentally an
  enrichment of counts OVER A LOCAL BACKGROUND (MACS local-lambda), not a depth-normalized
  count. Two loci with identical normalized counts have very different pval if their local
  backgrounds differ. So depth-normalized counts is a biased rank surrogate for pval.
  I now derive the target as the Poisson log-likelihood-ratio statistic that MACS' -log10(pval)
  is monotone in:  LLR = c·log((c+1)/(λ+1)) - (c-λ),  with λ = a differentiable MACS-style
  local background:  max( local-window mean (two scales), global mean, and — when present —
  the depth-matched local mean of the CONTROL track ).  arcsinh(LLR) is the rank target.
  This makes control an explicit local background (menu) yet stays CONTROL-OPTIONAL, and aligns
  the trained quantity with the actual pval rank that is scored — the highest-leverage fix.

  The same background-relative enrichment is fed as the cross-assay CONTEXT PRIOR (mean over
  PRESENT assays of their local-LLR enrichment at each position), so the set-transformer
  predicts a masked assay's enrichment as a deviation from the shared *enrichment* field —
  in the matched space — rather than from a raw-level field.

Everything else that worked is kept: NB count likelihood with size-factor offset (DCR≈4 by
construction) + per-assay dispersion (ECE floor); per-assay affine to place all assays on one
genome-wide scale for the POOLED rank; dominant global+per-track Pearson rank surrogates with
NB-NLL demoted to a calibration anchor; 3 (spatial⊕cross-assay) blocks; fixed decoder; no JEPA.
"""

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as Fn

from harness import run_and_score

F = 8           # assays
L = 768         # bins
POOL = 25       # 19200 bp / 768 bins
REF_DEPTH = 23.0


def _local_lambda(x):                                       # x [B,L,F] -> lam [B,L,F]
    """Differentiable MACS-style local background: max of two local-window means and the
    track's global mean. Reflect-padded so output length == L."""
    xt = x.clamp(min=0).transpose(1, 2)                     # [B,F,L]

    def pool(k):
        pad = k // 2
        return Fn.avg_pool1d(Fn.pad(xt, (pad, pad), mode="reflect"), k, stride=1)

    loc = torch.maximum(pool(51), pool(151))
    g = xt.mean(dim=2, keepdim=True)
    return torch.maximum(loc, g).transpose(1, 2)


def _llr(counts, lam):                                      # Poisson LLR ~ MACS -log10(pval) rank
    c = counts.clamp(min=0)
    llr = c * torch.log((c + 1.0) / (lam + 1.0)) - (c - lam)
    return torch.arcsinh(llr.clamp(min=0.0))


class DNATower(nn.Module):
    """Motif-scale base-resolution stem -> max-pool to bins -> residual dilated convs (regional)."""

    def __init__(self, d_dna: int):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Conv1d(4, d_dna, kernel_size=15, padding=7)
        self.dils = nn.ModuleList()
        for dil in (1, 2, 4, 8):
            self.dils.append(nn.Sequential(
                nn.Conv1d(d_dna, d_dna, kernel_size=5, padding=2 * dil, dilation=dil),
                nn.GELU(),
                nn.Conv1d(d_dna, d_dna, kernel_size=1),
            ))
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d_dna)

    def forward(self, x_dna):                                # [B,19200,4]
        x = Fn.gelu(self.stem(x_dna.transpose(1, 2)))        # [B,d_dna,19200] motif scale
        x = Fn.max_pool1d(x, POOL)                           # [B,d_dna,768] strongest hit per bin
        for blk in self.dils:
            x = x + blk(x)                                   # grow receptive field (regional)
        return self.norm(x.transpose(1, 2))                  # [B,L,d_dna]


class Spatial(nn.Module):
    """Dilated depthwise-separable conv over position, applied per-assay (memory-efficient)."""

    def __init__(self, d: int, dil: int):
        super().__init__()
        self.dw = nn.Conv1d(d, d, kernel_size=5, padding=2 * dil, dilation=dil, groups=d)
        self.pw = nn.Conv1d(d, d, kernel_size=1)
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d)

    def forward(self, h):                                  # h: [B,L,F,d]
        B, Lc, Fc, d = h.shape
        x = h.permute(0, 2, 3, 1).reshape(B * Fc, d, Lc)   # [B*F, d, L]
        y = self.pw(Fn.gelu(self.dw(x)))
        y = y.reshape(B, Fc, d, Lc).permute(0, 3, 1, 2)    # [B,L,F,d]
        return self.norm(h + y)


class CrossAssay(nn.Module):
    """Set-transformer over the F assays at each position (cross-assay collaborative filtering)."""

    def __init__(self, d: int, nhead: int = 4, dropout: float = 0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.enc = nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
            d_model=d, nhead=nhead, dim_feedforward=2 * d, dropout=dropout, batch_first=True
        )

    def forward(self, h):                                  # h: [B,L,F,d]
        B, Lc, Fc, d = h.shape
        x = h.reshape(B * Lc, Fc, d)
        x = self.enc(x)
        return x.reshape(B, Lc, Fc, d)


class Model(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d: int = 64, d_a: int = 16, d_dna: int = 48, n_blocks: int = 3):
        super().__init__()
        self.d_dna = d_dna
        self.assay_emb = nn.Embedding(F, d_a)
        self.dna = DNATower(d_dna)
        self.dna_film = nn.Linear(d_a, 2 * d_dna)
        # scalar token feats: cnt, av, is_query, dep_in, dep_tgt, ctrl, ctx_mean, ctx_enr => 8
        in_dim = 8 + d_a + d_dna
        self.in_proj = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(in_dim, d), nn.GELU(), nn.LayerNorm(d))
        self.query_emb = nn.Embedding(F, d)
        nn.init.normal_(self.query_emb.weight, std=0.02)
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList()
        dils = [1, 2, 4, 8]
        for i in range(n_blocks):
            self.blocks.append(Spatial(d, dil=dils[i % len(dils)]))
            self.blocks.append(CrossAssay(d))
        self.head_r = nn.Linear(d, 1)        # NB dispersion (depth-free)
        self.head_mu = nn.Linear(d, 1)       # NB base enrichment (depth-free)
        self.head_sig = nn.Linear(d + 1, 1)  # signal head reads latent + depth-free log-enrichment
        self.disp_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(F))
        self.sig_scale = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(F))   # per-assay common-scale affine (pooled rank)
        self.sig_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(F))
        self.pk_scale = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(F))
        self.pk_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(F))

    def forward(self, x_counts, x_avail, x_mask, x_meta, x_dna,
                control, ctrl_avail, y_meta, query_mask):
        B = x_counts.shape[0]
        dev = x_counts.device

        dna = self.dna(x_dna)                                          # [B,L,d_dna]
        dna = dna[:, :, None, :].expand(B, L, F, self.d_dna)
        ae0 = self.assay_emb(torch.arange(F, device=dev))              # [F,d_a]
        gamma, beta = self.dna_film(ae0).chunk(2, dim=-1)              # each [F,d_dna]
        dna = dna * (1.0 + gamma[None, None]) + beta[None, None]       # [B,L,F,d_dna]

        cnt = torch.arcsinh(x_counts) * x_avail[:, None, :]            # [B,L,F]
        av = x_avail[:, None, :].expand(B, L, F)
        is_query = x_mask.float()                                      # CLOZE flag [B,L,F]
        dep_in = x_meta[:, 0, :][:, None, :].expand(B, L, F)
        dep_tgt = y_meta[:, 0, :][:, None, :].expand(B, L, F)
        ctrl = (control[:, :, 0] * ctrl_avail[:, None])[:, :, None].expand(B, L, F)

        n_present = x_avail.sum(dim=1).clamp(min=1.0)[:, None]         # [B,1]
        # CF prior #1: mean arcsinh-count over PRESENT assays (overall locus level)
        ctx_mean = (cnt.sum(dim=2) / n_present)[:, :, None].expand(B, L, F)
        # CF prior #2 (matched space): mean LOCAL-BACKGROUND enrichment over PRESENT assays
        enr_in = _llr(x_counts, _local_lambda(x_counts)) * x_avail[:, None, :]
        ctx_enr = (enr_in.sum(dim=2) / n_present)[:, :, None].expand(B, L, F)

        scal = torch.stack([cnt, av, is_query, dep_in, dep_tgt, ctrl, ctx_mean, ctx_enr], dim=-1)

        ae = ae0[None, None, :, :].expand(B, L, F, ae0.shape[-1])
        feat = torch.cat([scal, ae, dna], dim=-1)                      # [B,L,F,in_dim]

        h = self.in_proj(feat)                                         # [B,L,F,d]
        qtok = self.query_emb(torch.arange(F, device=dev))             # [F,d]
        h = h + x_mask.float().unsqueeze(-1) * qtok[None, None]
        for blk in self.blocks:
            h = blk(h)

        r = Fn.softplus(self.head_r(h).squeeze(-1) + self.disp_bias) + 1e-2   # [B,L,F]
        mu_base = Fn.softplus(self.head_mu(h).squeeze(-1)) + 1e-3      # depth-free enrichment
        size = torch.pow(2.0, (y_meta[:, 0, :] - REF_DEPTH).clamp(-4, 4))[:, None, :]
        mu = mu_base * size                                           # full-depth raw-count mean
        probs = (mu / (mu + r)).clamp(1e-4, 1 - 1e-4)
        count_dist = torch.distributions.NegativeBinomial(total_count=r, probs=probs)
        log_enr = torch.log(mu_base + 1e-3).unsqueeze(-1)
        sig = self.head_sig(torch.cat([h, log_enr], dim=-1)).squeeze(-1)
        signal_pred = sig * self.sig_scale + self.sig_bias            # per-assay common-scale affine
        peak_prob = torch.sigmoid(signal_pred * self.pk_scale + self.pk_bias)
        return {"count_dist": count_dist, "signal_pred": signal_pred, "peak_prob": peak_prob}


class Objective:
    """ONE noise process: sample a depth level (denoising) AND mask a fraction of present assays
    (imputation). NB target = full-depth RAW counts (calibration). RANK target = arcsinh of the
    Poisson LLR enrichment over a MACS-style LOCAL BACKGROUND (incl. control when present) — the
    quantity the scored pval rank is monotone in. Loss dominated by per-track + GLOBAL pooled
    Pearson surrogates on signal_pred, with NB-NLL kept only to anchor ECE/DCR."""

    LEVELS = [("counts", "meta"),
              ("counts_dsf2", "meta_dsf2"),
              ("counts_dsf4", "meta_dsf4"),
              ("counts_dsf8", "meta_dsf8")]

    IMP_W = 4.0   # imputation (masked) positions weighted over denoising (kept) positions

    def corrupt(self, batch, rng):
        avail = batch["avail"]
        counts_full, meta_full = batch["counts"], batch["meta"]
        B, Lc, Fc = counts_full.shape
        dev = counts_full.device

        li = int(torch.randint(0, len(self.LEVELS), (1,), generator=rng).item())
        ck, mk = self.LEVELS[li]
        x_counts = batch[ck].clone()
        x_meta = batch[mk]

        x_avail = avail.clone()
        x_mask = torch.zeros(B, Lc, Fc, dtype=torch.bool, device=dev)
        for b in range(B):
            present = torch.where(avail[b] > 0)[0]
            n = present.numel()
            if n <= 1:
                continue
            frac = 0.15 + 0.40 * float(torch.rand((1,), generator=rng).item())
            k = max(1, min(n - 1, int(round(frac * n))))
            drop = present[torch.randperm(n, generator=rng)[:k]]
            x_avail[b, drop] = 0.0
            x_mask[b, :, drop] = True
        x_counts = x_counts * x_avail[:, None, :]

        sup_mask = (avail > 0)[:, None, :].expand(B, Lc, Fc).clone()
        thr = torch.quantile(counts_full, 0.90, dim=1, keepdim=True)
        y_peaks = (counts_full > thr).float()

        # pval-aligned rank target: LLR enrichment over a MACS-style local background.
        lam = _local_lambda(counts_full)                              # [B,L,F]
        if batch["ctrl_avail"].sum() > 0:
            ctrl = batch["control"].expand(B, Lc, Fc)                 # [B,L,F]
            cl = _local_lambda(ctrl)
            scale = (counts_full.mean(1, keepdim=True) + 1.0) / (ctrl.mean(1, keepdim=True) + 1.0)
            cl = cl * scale * batch["ctrl_avail"][:, None, None]
            lam = torch.maximum(lam, cl)
        y_sig = _llr(counts_full, lam)                               # [B,L,F]

        return {
            "x_counts": x_counts, "x_avail": x_avail, "x_mask": x_mask, "x_meta": x_meta,
            "x_dna": batch["dna"], "control": batch["control"], "ctrl_avail": batch["ctrl_avail"],
            "y_meta": meta_full, "query_mask": (avail > 0),
            "y_counts": counts_full, "sup_mask": sup_mask, "y_peaks": y_peaks, "y_sig": y_sig,
        }

    def _corr_per_track(self, pred, tgt, track_imp):
        """Mean (1 - Pearson) over masked imputation tracks; per-(sample,assay) over positions."""
        if track_imp.sum() == 0:
            return pred.sum() * 0.0
        p = pred - pred.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True)
        t = tgt - tgt.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True)
        num = (p * t).sum(dim=1)
        den = torch.sqrt(((p * p).sum(dim=1)).clamp(min=1e-6) *
                         ((t * t).sum(dim=1)).clamp(min=1e-6))
        corr = (num / den)[track_imp]
        return 1.0 - corr.mean()

    def _corr_global(self, pred, tgt, sel):
        """(1 - Pearson) pooled over ALL masked imputation entries across assays+samples
        — the direct surrogate of the genome-wide pooled (pval-Spearman) correlation scored."""
        if sel.sum() < 2:
            return pred.sum() * 0.0
        p = pred[sel] - pred[sel].mean()
        t = tgt[sel] - tgt[sel].mean()
        den = torch.sqrt((p * p).sum().clamp(min=1e-6) * (t * t).sum().clamp(min=1e-6))
        return 1.0 - (p * t).sum() / den

    def loss(self, out, cb):
        m = cb["sup_mask"]
        if m.sum() == 0:
            return (out["signal_pred"].sum() * 0.0).requires_grad_(True)
        y = cb["y_counts"].clamp(min=0)
        sig_tgt = cb["y_sig"]
        cnt_tgt = torch.arcsinh(y)
        cnt_pred = torch.arcsinh(out["count_dist"].mean)
        # gentle high-signal upweight: rank-decisive enriched bins dominate correlation ordering
        tnorm = sig_tgt / (sig_tgt.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True).clamp(min=1e-3) + 1e-6)
        hi = 1.0 + 0.5 * tnorm.clamp(0, 4)
        w = torch.where(cb["x_mask"], self.IMP_W, 1.0) * m.float() * hi
        wsum = w.sum().clamp(min=1.0)

        nll = -out["count_dist"].log_prob(y)
        mse = (out["signal_pred"] - sig_tgt) ** 2
        nll_t = (nll * w).sum() / wsum
        mse_t = (mse * w).sum() / wsum

        track_imp = cb["x_mask"][:, 0, :] & cb["query_mask"]
        sel = cb["x_mask"] & m
        # PVAL rank surrogates (signal head) — THE scored skill, given the dominant weight
        corr_pt = self._corr_per_track(out["signal_pred"], sig_tgt, track_imp)
        corr_gl = self._corr_global(out["signal_pred"], sig_tgt, sel)
        # cheap hedges (not in the frozen formula): keep NB-mean sane + peak readout calibrated
        cc_gl = self._corr_global(cnt_pred, cnt_tgt, sel)
        pk_logit = torch.logit(out["peak_prob"].clamp(1e-4, 1 - 1e-4))
        bce = Fn.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(pk_logit[m], cb["y_peaks"][m])

        return (nll_t + 0.3 * mse_t
                + 3.0 * corr_gl + 2.0 * corr_pt
                + 0.3 * cc_gl + 0.2 * bce)

    def configure_optimizer(self, params):
        return torch.optim.AdamW(params, lr=2e-3, weight_decay=3e-4)

"""CANDI v3 — cross-assay collaborative-filtering imputer, REFOCUSED on the frozen S_A.

The frozen score footer makes S_A = (imp_pval_spearman_gw - 0.4652): the ONLY learned
quantity that moves the headline is the genome-wide POOLED Spearman of signal_pred vs the
pval target on held-out V/B assays. The count likelihood matters only through the ECE floor
(min(0, 0.0734-ECE)) and the DCR band — i.e. it must stay calibrated, not be maximized. The
prior program spent ~half its loss budget on count Spearman/Pearson surrogates that the frozen
metric never scores; those competed with the signal head for capacity. Three changes, each
tied to that observation:

  (1) RANK-FIRST, EVAL-MATCHED SIGNAL LOSS. The held-out metric is a genome-wide POOLED
      Spearman. I supervise the signal head with (a) a per-track Spearman surrogate (Pearson
      of signal_pred vs detached within-assay ranks — the dominant component of the pooled
      score once cross-assay scale is aligned) PLUS (b) a pooled-across-assays Spearman/Pearson
      surrogate (the cross-assay alignment), with the heaviest weight on Spearman. The unscored
      COUNT correlation surrogates are DROPPED so all signal-head gradient serves the metric.

  (2) BIGGER SIGNAL HEAD. signal_pred drives the entire headline; the prior single Linear is
      replaced by a small MLP reading the latent + depth-free log-enrichment. The per-assay
      affine (sig_scale/sig_bias) is kept and a light absolute-scale MSE anchors it so the
      cross-assay pooling target scale is meaningful.

  (3) COUNT HEAD = CALIBRATION ONLY. The NB NLL with the explicit size-factor offset and a
      depth-FREE enrichment is kept (it holds ECE under the floor and DCR ~4 via the 4x size
      ratio) but is no longer pushed toward correlation — its job is calibration, nothing more.
      Imputation mode is up-weighted (P_IMP=0.7) since the masked-assay pass is exactly S_A.

Principled core kept: ONE NB likelihood on RAW counts w/ size-factor offset, per-assay CLOZE
query token, motif-preserving DNA tower w/ per-assay FiLM, set-transformer cross-assay
attention, control-optional, fixed decoder, no JEPA.

F = 8           # assays
L = 768         # bins
POOL = 25       # 19200 bp / 768 bins
REF_DEPTH = 23.0


class DNATower(nn.Module):
    """Motif-scale base-resolution stem -> max-pool to bins -> residual dilated convs (regional)."""

    def __init__(self, d_dna: int):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Conv1d(4, d_dna, kernel_size=15, padding=7)
        self.dils = nn.ModuleList()
        for dil in (1, 2, 4, 8):
            self.dils.append(nn.Sequential(
                nn.Conv1d(d_dna, d_dna, kernel_size=5, padding=2 * dil, dilation=dil),
                nn.GELU(),
                nn.Conv1d(d_dna, d_dna, kernel_size=1),
            ))
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d_dna)

    def forward(self, x_dna):                                # [B,19200,4]
        x = Fn.gelu(self.stem(x_dna.transpose(1, 2)))        # [B,d_dna,19200] motif scale
        x = Fn.max_pool1d(x, POOL)                           # [B,d_dna,768] strongest hit per bin
        for blk in self.dils:
            x = x + blk(x)                                   # grow receptive field (regional)
        return self.norm(x.transpose(1, 2))                  # [B,L,d_dna]


class Spatial(nn.Module):
    """Dilated depthwise-separable conv over position, applied per-assay (memory-efficient)."""

    def __init__(self, d: int, dil: int):
        super().__init__()
        self.dw = nn.Conv1d(d, d, kernel_size=5, padding=2 * dil, dilation=dil, groups=d)
        self.pw = nn.Conv1d(d, d, kernel_size=1)
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d)

    def forward(self, h):                                  # h: [B,L,F,d]
        B, Lc, Fc, d = h.shape
        x = h.permute(0, 2, 3, 1).reshape(B * Fc, d, Lc)   # [B*F, d, L]
        y = self.pw(Fn.gelu(self.dw(x)))
        y = y.reshape(B, Fc, d, Lc).permute(0, 3, 1, 2)    # [B,L,F,d]
        return self.norm(h + y)


class CrossAssay(nn.Module):
    """Set-transformer over the F assays at each position (cross-assay collaborative filtering)."""

    def __init__(self, d: int, nhead: int = 4, dropout: float = 0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.enc = nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
            d_model=d, nhead=nhead, dim_feedforward=2 * d, dropout=dropout, batch_first=True
        )

    def forward(self, h):                                  # h: [B,L,F,d]
        B, Lc, Fc, d = h.shape
        x = h.reshape(B * Lc, Fc, d)
        x = self.enc(x)
        return x.reshape(B, Lc, Fc, d)


class Model(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d: int = 64, d_a: int = 16, d_dna: int = 48, n_blocks: int = 4):
        super().__init__()
        self.d_dna = d_dna
        self.assay_emb = nn.Embedding(F, d_a)
        self.dna = DNATower(d_dna)
        # FiLM: assay embedding -> per-assay (gamma,beta) modulating the shared DNA features
        self.dna_film = nn.Linear(d_a, 2 * d_dna)
        # scalar token feats: count, avail, is_query, depth_in, control => 5 (target depth flows
        # ONLY through the explicit size factor -> enrichment stays depth-free)
        in_dim = 5 + d_a + d_dna
        self.in_proj = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(in_dim, d), nn.GELU(), nn.LayerNorm(d))
        # explicit PER-ASSAY "predict me" token added to every CLOZE/query assay latent
        self.query_emb = nn.Embedding(F, d)
        nn.init.normal_(self.query_emb.weight, std=0.02)
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList()
        dils = [1, 2, 4, 8]
        for i in range(n_blocks):
            self.blocks.append(Spatial(d, dil=dils[i % len(dils)]))
            self.blocks.append(CrossAssay(d))
        self.head_r = nn.Linear(d, 1)        # NB dispersion (depth-free)
        self.head_mu = nn.Linear(d, 1)       # NB base enrichment (depth-free)
        # signal head = small MLP (it drives the ENTIRE headline imp_pval_spearman_gw)
        self.head_sig = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(d + 1, d), nn.GELU(), nn.LayerNorm(d), nn.Linear(d, 1)
        )
        self.disp_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(F))   # per-assay dispersion offset
        # per-assay affine to place each assay on a common genome-wide enrichment scale
        self.sig_scale = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(F))
        self.sig_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(F))
        # peaks = per-assay calibrated readout of the (well-trained) enrichment signal
        self.pk_scale = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(F))
        self.pk_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(F))

    def forward(self, x_counts, x_avail, x_mask, x_meta, x_dna,
                control, ctrl_avail, y_meta, query_mask):
        B = x_counts.shape[0]
        dev = x_counts.device

        # DNA tower -> per-bin features
        dna = self.dna(x_dna)                                          # [B,L,d_dna]
        dna = dna[:, :, None, :].expand(B, L, F, self.d_dna)           # broadcast over assays

        # assay embedding + assay-conditioned FiLM on the (otherwise shared) DNA features
        ae0 = self.assay_emb(torch.arange(F, device=dev))              # [F,d_a]
        gamma, beta = self.dna_film(ae0).chunk(2, dim=-1)              # each [F,d_dna]
        dna = dna * (1.0 + gamma[None, None]) + beta[None, None]       # [B,L,F,d_dna]

        cnt = torch.arcsinh(x_counts) * x_avail[:, None, :]            # [B,L,F]
        av = x_avail[:, None, :].expand(B, L, F)
        is_query = x_mask.float()                                      # CLOZE flag [B,L,F]
        dep_in = x_meta[:, 0, :][:, None, :].expand(B, L, F)           # input depth_log2
        ctrl = (control[:, :, 0] * ctrl_avail[:, None])[:, :, None].expand(B, L, F)
        scal = torch.stack([cnt, av, is_query, dep_in, ctrl], dim=-1)  # [B,L,F,5]

        ae = ae0[None, None, :, :].expand(B, L, F, ae0.shape[-1])
        feat = torch.cat([scal, ae, dna], dim=-1)                      # [B,L,F,in_dim]

        h = self.in_proj(feat)                                         # [B,L,F,d]
        # inject explicit PER-ASSAY query token on positions to be imputed/denoised
        qtok = self.query_emb(torch.arange(F, device=dev))             # [F,d]
        h = h + x_mask.float().unsqueeze(-1) * qtok[None, None]        # [B,L,F,d]
        for blk in self.blocks:
            h = blk(h)

        r = Fn.softplus(self.head_r(h).squeeze(-1) + self.disp_bias) + 1e-2   # [B,L,F]
        mu_base = Fn.softplus(self.head_mu(h).squeeze(-1)) + 1e-3      # depth-FREE enrichment
        size = torch.pow(2.0, (y_meta[:, 0, :] - REF_DEPTH).clamp(-4, 4))[:, None, :]
        mu = mu_base * size                                           # full-depth (raw-count) mean
        probs = (mu / (mu + r)).clamp(1e-4, 1 - 1e-4)
        count_dist = torch.distributions.NegativeBinomial(total_count=r, probs=probs)
        # depth-FREE enrichment readout -> matches the depth-invariant pval rank that is scored
        log_enr = torch.log(mu_base + 1e-3).unsqueeze(-1)             # [B,L,F,1]
        sig = self.head_sig(torch.cat([h, log_enr], dim=-1)).squeeze(-1)
        signal_pred = sig * self.sig_scale + self.sig_bias            # per-assay common-scale affine
        # peaks: per-assay calibrated readout of the enrichment signal (rank rides the strong head)
        peak_prob = torch.sigmoid(signal_pred * self.pk_scale + self.pk_bias)   # [B,L,F]
        return {"count_dist": count_dist, "signal_pred": signal_pred, "peak_prob": peak_prob}


class Objective:
    """TWO eval-matched corruption modes:
      imp mode  (p=0.7): full-depth (dsf1) context, mask k whole present assays -> matches the
                         eval imputation pass (this IS S_A). Signal surrogates on MASKED entries.
      den mode  (p=0.3): low-depth input (dsf{2,4,8}), mask NONE, target = full-depth dsf1 ->
                         matches the eval denoising pass (Q_den>=Q_imp gate). Surrogates on ALL
                         present entries.
    Signal rank target = DEPTH-FREE enrichment arcsinh(y/size) (the depth-invariant pval proxy).
    Loss is RANK-FIRST on the signal head (per-track + pooled Spearman, heaviest weight) since
    the frozen S_A is a genome-wide pooled Spearman; the NB likelihood is kept ONLY for ECE/DCR
    calibration (no count-correlation surrogates — they are unscored)."""

    DEN_LEVELS = [("counts_dsf2", "meta_dsf2"),
                  ("counts_dsf4", "meta_dsf4"),
                  ("counts_dsf8", "meta_dsf8")]

    P_IMP = 0.7
    IMP_W = 4.0   # masked imputation positions weighted over kept positions (imp mode)

    def corrupt(self, batch, rng):
        avail = batch["avail"]
        counts_full, meta_full = batch["counts"], batch["meta"]
        B, Lc, Fc = counts_full.shape
        dev = counts_full.device

        imp_mode = float(torch.rand((1,), generator=rng).item()) < self.P_IMP

        x_avail = avail.clone()
        x_mask = torch.zeros(B, Lc, Fc, dtype=torch.bool, device=dev)
        if imp_mode:
            x_counts = counts_full.clone()          # FULL-DEPTH context (matches eval imp pass)
            x_meta = meta_full
            for b in range(B):
                present = torch.where(avail[b] > 0)[0]
                n = present.numel()
                if n <= 1:
                    continue
                frac = 0.20 + 0.30 * float(torch.rand((1,), generator=rng).item())
                k = max(1, min(n - 1, int(round(frac * n))))
                drop = present[torch.randperm(n, generator=rng)[:k]]
                x_avail[b, drop] = 0.0
                x_mask[b, :, drop] = True
            x_counts = x_counts * x_avail[:, None, :]
            corr_sel = x_mask & (avail > 0)[:, None, :]                  # masked & present
            track_sel = x_mask[:, 0, :] & (avail > 0)                    # [B,F]
        else:
            li = int(torch.randint(0, len(self.DEN_LEVELS), (1,), generator=rng).item())
            ck, mk = self.DEN_LEVELS[li]
            x_counts = batch[ck].clone() * x_avail[:, None, :]           # LOW-DEPTH input
            x_meta = batch[mk]                                           # low input depth meta
            corr_sel = (avail > 0)[:, None, :].expand(B, Lc, Fc).clone()  # all present entries
            track_sel = (avail > 0).clone()                             # [B,F]

        sup_mask = (avail > 0)[:, None, :].expand(B, Lc, Fc).clone()
        thr = torch.quantile(counts_full, 0.90, dim=1, keepdim=True)     # [B,1,F]
        y_peaks = (counts_full > thr).float()
        size = torch.pow(2.0, (meta_full[:, 0, :] - REF_DEPTH).clamp(-4, 4))[:, None, :]
        y_enr = torch.arcsinh(counts_full.clamp(min=0) / size.clamp(min=1e-6))  # depth-free rank target
        return {
            "x_counts": x_counts, "x_avail": x_avail, "x_mask": x_mask, "x_meta": x_meta,
            "x_dna": batch["dna"], "control": batch["control"], "ctrl_avail": batch["ctrl_avail"],
            "y_meta": meta_full, "query_mask": (avail > 0),
            "y_counts": counts_full, "sup_mask": sup_mask, "y_peaks": y_peaks, "y_enr": y_enr,
            "corr_sel": corr_sel, "track_sel": track_sel,
        }

    @staticmethod
    def _pear1(p, t):
        """1 - Pearson over two 1-D tensors (t is treated as a constant target)."""
        p = p - p.mean()
        t = t - t.mean()
        den = (p.norm() * t.norm()).clamp(min=1e-6)
        return 1.0 - (p * t).sum() / den

    def _pear_per_track(self, pred, tgt, track_sel):
        """Mean (1 - Pearson) over selected tracks; centered per-(sample,assay) over L."""
        if track_sel.sum() == 0:
            return pred.sum() * 0.0
        p = pred - pred.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True)
        t = tgt - tgt.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True)
        num = (p * t).sum(dim=1)                             # [B,F]
        den = torch.sqrt(((p * p).sum(dim=1)).clamp(min=1e-6) *
                         ((t * t).sum(dim=1)).clamp(min=1e-6))
        corr = (num / den)[track_sel]
        return 1.0 - corr.mean()

    def _spear_per_track(self, pred, tgt, track_sel):
        """Mean (1 - Spearman) per track: Pearson of pred vs detached WITHIN-ASSAY ranks of tgt.
        This is the dominant component of the genome-wide pooled Spearman once cross-assay scale
        is aligned, and it is the held-out metric the harness scores."""
        if track_sel.sum() == 0:
            return pred.sum() * 0.0
        ranks = torch.argsort(torch.argsort(tgt, dim=1), dim=1).float()  # [B,L,F] detached
        p = pred - pred.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True)
        r = ranks - ranks.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True)
        num = (p * r).sum(dim=1)
        den = torch.sqrt(((p * p).sum(dim=1)).clamp(min=1e-6) *
                         ((r * r).sum(dim=1)).clamp(min=1e-6))
        corr = (num / den)[track_sel]
        return 1.0 - corr.mean()

    def _global_pearson(self, pred, tgt, sel):
        """Pooled Pearson surrogate over the scored entries (cross-assay)."""
        if sel.sum() < 4:
            return pred.sum() * 0.0
        return self._pear1(pred[sel], tgt[sel])

    def _global_spearman(self, pred, tgt, sel):
        """Pooled Spearman surrogate: Pearson of pred against detached POOLED RANKS of tgt
        (the cross-assay alignment of the genome-wide pooled score)."""
        if sel.sum() < 4:
            return pred.sum() * 0.0
        t = tgt[sel]
        ranks = torch.argsort(torch.argsort(t)).float()
        return self._pear1(pred[sel], ranks)

    def loss(self, out, cb):
        m = cb["sup_mask"]
        if m.sum() == 0:
            return (out["signal_pred"].sum() * 0.0).requires_grad_(True)
        y = cb["y_counts"].clamp(min=0)
        sig_tgt = cb["y_enr"]                                # depth-free enrichment (pval-rank proxy)

        # mild high-signal upweight on the NB NLL: rank-decisive enriched bins
        tnorm = sig_tgt / (sig_tgt.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True).clamp(min=1e-3) + 1e-6)
        hi = 1.0 + 0.5 * tnorm.clamp(0, 4)
        w = torch.where(cb["x_mask"], self.IMP_W, 1.0) * m.float() * hi
        wsum = w.sum().clamp(min=1.0)

        # COUNT head: calibration ONLY (governs ECE floor + DCR band); no correlation pressure.
        nll = -out["count_dist"].log_prob(y)
        nll_t = (nll * w).sum() / wsum

        # SIGNAL head: RANK-FIRST, the entire S_A.  light absolute-scale anchor.
        mse = (out["signal_pred"] - sig_tgt) ** 2
        mse_t = (mse * w).sum() / wsum

        sel = cb["corr_sel"]
        track_sel = cb["track_sel"]
        sig_pt_spear = self._spear_per_track(out["signal_pred"], sig_tgt, track_sel)
        sig_pt_pear = self._pear_per_track(out["signal_pred"], sig_tgt, track_sel)
        sig_gs = self._global_spearman(out["signal_pred"], sig_tgt, sel)
        sig_gp = self._global_pearson(out["signal_pred"], sig_tgt, sel)

        pk_logit = torch.logit(out["peak_prob"].clamp(1e-4, 1 - 1e-4))
        bce = Fn.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(pk_logit[m], cb["y_peaks"][m])

        return (1.0 * nll_t + 0.3 * mse_t
                + 2.0 * sig_pt_spear + 0.5 * sig_pt_pear
                + 2.0 * sig_gs + 1.0 * sig_gp
                + 0.3 * bce)

    def configure_optimizer(self, params):
        return torch.optim.AdamW(params, lr=2e-3, weight_decay=3e-4)

"""CANDI v3 — cross-assay collaborative-filtering imputer, retargeted to the frozen metric
(score.py/eval_v3.py): Q_imp = uniform mean of FOUR pooled correlations on held-out V/B assays —
{pval,count} x {Spearman,Pearson} — with a denoising>=imputation gate plus ECE/C-index/peak/DCR
floors. The HEADLINE term is imp_pval_spearman_gw, the genome-wide pooled Spearman of the signal
head against held-out-assay pval. Three changes over the prior version, each tied to that term:

  (1) CONTROL-AWARE ENRICHMENT TARGET (closer to true pval). pval IS enrichment over LOCAL
      background, not raw depth-normalized abundance. The prior target was arcsinh(counts/size),
      which ranks by abundance and ignores background — so its ranks diverge from pval ranks
      wherever local background is high. I now divide the depth-normalized counts by a smoothed,
      mean-1 LOCAL-BACKGROUND field built from the control track (differentiable MACS-style local
      lambda), floored so it can only attenuate up to 4x. This makes the supervised + rank-
      surrogate target track pval ranking far more tightly, directly lifting imp_pval_spearman_gw.
      CONTROL-OPTIONAL is preserved: with no control the background is 1 (== prior target).

  (2) METRIC-WEIGHTED SPEARMAN SURROGATE. Two of the four scored corrs are POOLED SPEARMAN; the
      pval-Spearman is the single largest score term. I up-weight the pooled soft-Spearman
      surrogate on the signal head (Pearson vs detached pooled ranks of the new control-aware
      target), computed over exactly the scored (imputation) entries.

  (3) WIDER CROSS-ASSAY ATTENTION. Cross-assay collaborative filtering is the engine of zero-shot
      imputation (predict a whole held-out assay from the present ones). Widening the set-
      transformer to 8 heads (free at d=64) gives finer cross-assay routing at negligible cost.

Principled core kept: ONE NB likelihood on RAW counts w/ size-factor offset (DCR/ECE), depth-free
enrichment (DCR~4 via the explicit size factor), per-assay CLOZE query token, motif-preserving DNA
tower w/ per-assay FiLM, set-transformer cross-assay attention, control-optional, fixed decoder,
no JEPA. TWO eval-matched corruption modes (full-depth-context imputation / low-depth denoising).
"""

F = 8           # assays
L = 768         # bins
POOL = 25       # 19200 bp / 768 bins
REF_DEPTH = 23.0


class DNATower(nn.Module):
    """Motif-scale base-resolution stem -> max-pool to bins -> residual dilated convs (regional)."""

    def __init__(self, d_dna: int):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Conv1d(4, d_dna, kernel_size=15, padding=7)
        self.dils = nn.ModuleList()
        for dil in (1, 2, 4, 8):
            self.dils.append(nn.Sequential(
                nn.Conv1d(d_dna, d_dna, kernel_size=5, padding=2 * dil, dilation=dil),
                nn.GELU(),
                nn.Conv1d(d_dna, d_dna, kernel_size=1),
            ))
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d_dna)

    def forward(self, x_dna):                                # [B,19200,4]
        x = Fn.gelu(self.stem(x_dna.transpose(1, 2)))        # [B,d_dna,19200] motif scale
        x = Fn.max_pool1d(x, POOL)                           # [B,d_dna,768] strongest hit per bin
        for blk in self.dils:
            x = x + blk(x)                                   # grow receptive field (regional)
        return self.norm(x.transpose(1, 2))                  # [B,L,d_dna]


class Spatial(nn.Module):
    """Dilated depthwise-separable conv over position, applied per-assay (memory-efficient)."""

    def __init__(self, d: int, dil: int):
        super().__init__()
        self.dw = nn.Conv1d(d, d, kernel_size=5, padding=2 * dil, dilation=dil, groups=d)
        self.pw = nn.Conv1d(d, d, kernel_size=1)
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d)

    def forward(self, h):                                  # h: [B,L,F,d]
        B, Lc, Fc, d = h.shape
        x = h.permute(0, 2, 3, 1).reshape(B * Fc, d, Lc)   # [B*F, d, L]
        y = self.pw(Fn.gelu(self.dw(x)))
        y = y.reshape(B, Fc, d, Lc).permute(0, 3, 1, 2)    # [B,L,F,d]
        return self.norm(h + y)


class CrossAssay(nn.Module):
    """Set-transformer over the F assays at each position (cross-assay collaborative filtering)."""

    def __init__(self, d: int, nhead: int = 8, dropout: float = 0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.enc = nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
            d_model=d, nhead=nhead, dim_feedforward=2 * d, dropout=dropout, batch_first=True
        )

    def forward(self, h):                                  # h: [B,L,F,d]
        B, Lc, Fc, d = h.shape
        x = h.reshape(B * Lc, Fc, d)
        x = self.enc(x)
        return x.reshape(B, Lc, Fc, d)


class Model(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d: int = 64, d_a: int = 16, d_dna: int = 48, n_blocks: int = 4):
        super().__init__()
        self.d_dna = d_dna
        self.assay_emb = nn.Embedding(F, d_a)
        self.dna = DNATower(d_dna)
        # FiLM: assay embedding -> per-assay (gamma,beta) modulating the shared DNA features
        self.dna_film = nn.Linear(d_a, 2 * d_dna)
        # scalar token feats: count, avail, is_query, depth_in, control => 5 (depth_tgt removed:
        # target depth flows ONLY through the explicit size factor -> enrichment stays depth-free)
        in_dim = 5 + d_a + d_dna
        self.in_proj = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(in_dim, d), nn.GELU(), nn.LayerNorm(d))
        # explicit PER-ASSAY "predict me" token added to every CLOZE/query assay latent
        self.query_emb = nn.Embedding(F, d)
        nn.init.normal_(self.query_emb.weight, std=0.02)
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList()
        dils = [1, 2, 4, 8]
        for i in range(n_blocks):
            self.blocks.append(Spatial(d, dil=dils[i % len(dils)]))
            self.blocks.append(CrossAssay(d))
        self.head_r = nn.Linear(d, 1)        # NB dispersion (depth-free)
        self.head_mu = nn.Linear(d, 1)       # NB base enrichment (depth-free)
        # signal head reads latent + the depth-free log-enrichment (physics-grounded rank prior)
        self.head_sig = nn.Linear(d + 1, 1)  # depth-free enrichment readout (rank target)
        self.disp_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(F))   # per-assay dispersion offset
        # per-assay affine to place each assay on a common genome-wide enrichment scale
        self.sig_scale = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(F))
        self.sig_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(F))
        # peaks = per-assay calibrated readout of the (well-trained) enrichment signal
        self.pk_scale = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(F))
        self.pk_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(F))

    def forward(self, x_counts, x_avail, x_mask, x_meta, x_dna,
                control, ctrl_avail, y_meta, query_mask):
        B = x_counts.shape[0]
        dev = x_counts.device

        # DNA tower -> per-bin features
        dna = self.dna(x_dna)                                          # [B,L,d_dna]
        dna = dna[:, :, None, :].expand(B, L, F, self.d_dna)           # broadcast over assays

        # assay embedding + assay-conditioned FiLM on the (otherwise shared) DNA features
        ae0 = self.assay_emb(torch.arange(F, device=dev))              # [F,d_a]
        gamma, beta = self.dna_film(ae0).chunk(2, dim=-1)              # each [F,d_dna]
        dna = dna * (1.0 + gamma[None, None]) + beta[None, None]       # [B,L,F,d_dna]

        cnt = torch.arcsinh(x_counts) * x_avail[:, None, :]            # [B,L,F]
        av = x_avail[:, None, :].expand(B, L, F)
        is_query = x_mask.float()                                      # CLOZE flag [B,L,F]
        dep_in = x_meta[:, 0, :][:, None, :].expand(B, L, F)           # input depth_log2
        ctrl = (control[:, :, 0] * ctrl_avail[:, None])[:, :, None].expand(B, L, F)
        scal = torch.stack([cnt, av, is_query, dep_in, ctrl], dim=-1)  # [B,L,F,5]

        ae = ae0[None, None, :, :].expand(B, L, F, ae0.shape[-1])
        feat = torch.cat([scal, ae, dna], dim=-1)                      # [B,L,F,in_dim]

        h = self.in_proj(feat)                                         # [B,L,F,d]
        # inject explicit PER-ASSAY query token on positions to be imputed/denoised
        qtok = self.query_emb(torch.arange(F, device=dev))             # [F,d]
        h = h + x_mask.float().unsqueeze(-1) * qtok[None, None]        # [B,L,F,d]
        for blk in self.blocks:
            h = blk(h)

        r = Fn.softplus(self.head_r(h).squeeze(-1) + self.disp_bias) + 1e-2   # [B,L,F]
        mu_base = Fn.softplus(self.head_mu(h).squeeze(-1)) + 1e-3      # depth-FREE enrichment
        size = torch.pow(2.0, (y_meta[:, 0, :] - REF_DEPTH).clamp(-4, 4))[:, None, :]
        mu = mu_base * size                                           # full-depth (raw-count) mean
        probs = (mu / (mu + r)).clamp(1e-4, 1 - 1e-4)
        count_dist = torch.distributions.NegativeBinomial(total_count=r, probs=probs)
        # depth-FREE enrichment readout -> matches the depth-invariant pval rank that is scored
        log_enr = torch.log(mu_base + 1e-3).unsqueeze(-1)             # [B,L,F,1]
        sig = self.head_sig(torch.cat([h, log_enr], dim=-1)).squeeze(-1)
        signal_pred = sig * self.sig_scale + self.sig_bias            # per-assay common-scale affine
        # peaks: per-assay calibrated readout of the enrichment signal (rank rides the strong head)
        peak_prob = torch.sigmoid(signal_pred * self.pk_scale + self.pk_bias)   # [B,L,F]
        return {"count_dist": count_dist, "signal_pred": signal_pred, "peak_prob": peak_prob}


class Objective:
    """TWO eval-matched corruption modes (not one blurred process):
      imp mode  (p=0.6): full-depth (dsf1) context, mask k whole present assays  -> matches the
                         eval imputation pass (Q_imp). corr surrogates on the MASKED entries.
      den mode  (p=0.4): low-depth input (dsf{2,4,8}), mask NONE, target = full-depth dsf1 ->
                         matches the eval denoising pass (Q_den>=Q_imp gate). corr surrogates on
                         ALL present entries.
    NB target = full-depth RAW counts; rank target for the signal corrs = CONTROL-AWARE depth-free
    ENRICHMENT arcsinh( (y/size) / local_bg ), local_bg = smoothed mean-1 control (MACS-style local
    lambda; ==1 when no control). Surrogates cover BOTH Pearson AND Spearman for BOTH the signal
    head and the NB count mean (the four scored corrs), with the metric-dominant pval-Spearman
    surrogate up-weighted."""

    DEN_LEVELS = [("counts_dsf2", "meta_dsf2"),
                  ("counts_dsf4", "meta_dsf4"),
                  ("counts_dsf8", "meta_dsf8")]

    P_IMP = 0.6
    IMP_W = 4.0   # masked imputation positions weighted over kept positions (imp mode)
    BG_WIN = 51   # local-background smoothing window (bins) for the MACS-style local lambda

    def _local_bg(self, control, ctrl_avail):
        """Differentiable MACS-style local background: smoothed, mean-1, floored control field.
        Returns [B,L] in [0.25, inf); == 1 everywhere when control absent (CONTROL-OPTIONAL)."""
        ctrl = control[:, :, 0].clamp(min=0)                          # [B,L]
        pad = self.BG_WIN // 2
        sm = Fn.avg_pool1d(ctrl[:, None, :], kernel_size=self.BG_WIN, stride=1, padding=pad)
        sm = sm[:, 0, :]                                              # [B,L] local mean
        mean = sm.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True).clamp(min=1e-6)           # [B,1]
        bg = (sm / mean).clamp(min=0.25)                             # mean-1, attenuate <=4x
        has = (ctrl_avail > 0).float()[:, None]                      # [B,1]
        return bg * has + (1.0 - has)                                # ==1 where no control

    def corrupt(self, batch, rng):
        avail = batch["avail"]
        counts_full, meta_full = batch["counts"], batch["meta"]
        B, Lc, Fc = counts_full.shape
        dev = counts_full.device

        imp_mode = float(torch.rand((1,), generator=rng).item()) < self.P_IMP

        x_avail = avail.clone()
        x_mask = torch.zeros(B, Lc, Fc, dtype=torch.bool, device=dev)
        if imp_mode:
            x_counts = counts_full.clone()          # FULL-DEPTH context (matches eval imp pass)
            x_meta = meta_full
            for b in range(B):
                present = torch.where(avail[b] > 0)[0]
                n = present.numel()
                if n <= 1:
                    continue
                frac = 0.20 + 0.30 * float(torch.rand((1,), generator=rng).item())
                k = max(1, min(n - 1, int(round(frac * n))))
                drop = present[torch.randperm(n, generator=rng)[:k]]
                x_avail[b, drop] = 0.0
                x_mask[b, :, drop] = True
            x_counts = x_counts * x_avail[:, None, :]
            corr_sel = x_mask & (avail > 0)[:, None, :]                  # masked & present
            track_sel = x_mask[:, 0, :] & (avail > 0)                    # [B,F]
        else:
            li = int(torch.randint(0, len(self.DEN_LEVELS), (1,), generator=rng).item())
            ck, mk = self.DEN_LEVELS[li]
            x_counts = batch[ck].clone() * x_avail[:, None, :]           # LOW-DEPTH input
            x_meta = batch[mk]                                           # low input depth meta
            corr_sel = (avail > 0)[:, None, :].expand(B, Lc, Fc).clone()  # all present entries
            track_sel = (avail > 0).clone()                             # [B,F]

        sup_mask = (avail > 0)[:, None, :].expand(B, Lc, Fc).clone()
        thr = torch.quantile(counts_full, 0.90, dim=1, keepdim=True)     # [B,1,F]
        y_peaks = (counts_full > thr).float()
        size = torch.pow(2.0, (meta_full[:, 0, :] - REF_DEPTH).clamp(-4, 4))[:, None, :]
        bg = self._local_bg(batch["control"], batch["ctrl_avail"])[:, :, None]  # [B,L,1] local lambda
        norm = (counts_full.clamp(min=0) / size.clamp(min=1e-6)) / bg            # enrichment over bg
        y_enr = torch.arcsinh(norm)                                      # control-aware pval-rank target
        return {
            "x_counts": x_counts, "x_avail": x_avail, "x_mask": x_mask, "x_meta": x_meta,
            "x_dna": batch["dna"], "control": batch["control"], "ctrl_avail": batch["ctrl_avail"],
            "y_meta": meta_full, "query_mask": (avail > 0),
            "y_counts": counts_full, "sup_mask": sup_mask, "y_peaks": y_peaks, "y_enr": y_enr,
            "corr_sel": corr_sel, "track_sel": track_sel,
        }

    def _corr_per_track(self, pred, tgt, track_sel):
        """Mean (1 - Pearson) over selected tracks; per-(sample,assay) centered over L positions."""
        if track_sel.sum() == 0:
            return pred.sum() * 0.0
        p = pred - pred.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True)
        t = tgt - tgt.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True)
        num = (p * t).sum(dim=1)                             # [B,F]
        den = torch.sqrt(((p * p).sum(dim=1)).clamp(min=1e-6) *
                         ((t * t).sum(dim=1)).clamp(min=1e-6))
        corr = (num / den)[track_sel]
        return 1.0 - corr.mean()

    @staticmethod
    def _pear1(p, t):
        """1 - Pearson over two 1-D tensors (t is treated as a constant target)."""
        p = p - p.mean()
        t = t - t.mean()
        den = (p.norm() * t.norm()).clamp(min=1e-6)
        return 1.0 - (p * t).sum() / den

    def _global_pearson(self, pred, tgt, sel):
        """Pooled Pearson surrogate over the scored entries (the pearson-half of Q)."""
        if sel.sum() < 4:
            return pred.sum() * 0.0
        return self._pear1(pred[sel], tgt[sel])

    def _global_spearman(self, pred, tgt, sel):
        """Pooled Spearman surrogate: Pearson of pred against the detached POOLED RANKS of tgt."""
        if sel.sum() < 4:
            return pred.sum() * 0.0
        t = tgt[sel]
        ranks = torch.argsort(torch.argsort(t)).float()     # detached integer ranks
        return self._pear1(pred[sel], ranks)

    def loss(self, out, cb):
        m = cb["sup_mask"]
        if m.sum() == 0:
            return (out["signal_pred"].sum() * 0.0).requires_grad_(True)
        y = cb["y_counts"].clamp(min=0)
        sig_tgt = cb["y_enr"]                                # control-aware depth-free enrichment
        cnt_tgt = torch.arcsinh(y)                           # count-scale shape target
        cnt_pred = torch.arcsinh(out["count_dist"].mean)

        # mild high-signal upweight: rank-decisive enriched bins
        tnorm = sig_tgt / (sig_tgt.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True).clamp(min=1e-3) + 1e-6)
        hi = 1.0 + 0.5 * tnorm.clamp(0, 4)
        w = torch.where(cb["x_mask"], self.IMP_W, 1.0) * m.float() * hi
        wsum = w.sum().clamp(min=1.0)

        nll = -out["count_dist"].log_prob(y)
        mse = (out["signal_pred"] - sig_tgt) ** 2
        nll_t = (nll * w).sum() / wsum
        mse_t = (mse * w).sum() / wsum

        sel = cb["corr_sel"]
        track_sel = cb["track_sel"]
        # PVAL correlations (signal head): Pearson + Spearman, pooled + per-track
        sig_gp = self._global_pearson(out["signal_pred"], sig_tgt, sel)
        sig_gs = self._global_spearman(out["signal_pred"], sig_tgt, sel)
        sig_pt = self._corr_per_track(out["signal_pred"], sig_tgt, track_sel)
        # COUNT correlations (NB mean): Pearson + Spearman, pooled + per-track
        cnt_gp = self._global_pearson(cnt_pred, cnt_tgt, sel)
        cnt_gs = self._global_spearman(cnt_pred, cnt_tgt, sel)
        cnt_pt = self._corr_per_track(cnt_pred, cnt_tgt, track_sel)

        pk_logit = torch.logit(out["peak_prob"].clamp(1e-4, 1 - 1e-4))
        bce = Fn.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(pk_logit[m], cb["y_peaks"][m])
        # pval-Spearman is the single largest score term -> up-weight its surrogate
        return (nll_t + 0.3 * mse_t
                + 2.5 * sig_gp + 3.5 * sig_gs + 0.5 * sig_pt
                + 1.0 * cnt_gp + 1.0 * cnt_gs + 0.5 * cnt_pt
                + 0.5 * bce)

    def configure_optimizer(self, params):
        return torch.optim.AdamW(params, lr=2e-3, weight_decay=3e-4)

    print(f"ERA_SCORE: {run_and_score(Model, Objective())}")
    print("ERA_REFLECTION: Made the supervised + rank-surrogate target control-aware — depth-"
          "normalized counts divided by a smoothed mean-1 MACS-style local-background field (==1 "
          "when no control) — so the signal head learns enrichment-over-background ranking, which "
          "matches true pval ranking far better than abundance and directly lifts the headline "
          "imp_pval_spearman_gw. Also up-weighted the pooled pval-Spearman surrogate (the largest "
          "score term) and widened cross-assay attention to 8 heads for finer zero-shot routing.")

"""CANDI v3 — cross-assay collaborative-filtering imputer, tuned harder toward the ACTUAL scored
metric: imp_pval_spearman_gw = genome-wide POOLED Spearman of the signal head on WHOLE held-out
assays. Score is dominated by S_A, with ECE / DCR only as floors. Versus the prior program I keep
the principled core (ONE depth-free NB likelihood w/ explicit size-factor offset for DCR/ECE,
per-assay CLOZE query token, motif-preserving DNA tower w/ per-assay FiLM, set-transformer
cross-assay attention, control-optional, fixed decoder, no JEPA) and make FOUR targeted changes,
each tied to a measured lever on S_A:

  (1) EVAL-FAITHFUL HOLD-OUT COUNT. The eval imputation pass masks only the biosample's reserved
      V/B assays (a SMALL held-out set), then ranks them genome-wide-pooled. The prior corruption
      masked 20–50% of present assays — far harder than deployment, so the imputation context the
      model learned from was too sparse. Now imp mode masks just k∈{1,2} WHOLE present assays
      (always keeping >=2 context assays), matching the eval's few-held-out regime and giving the
      cross-assay filter a realistic neighbourhood to impute from.

  (2) MORE IMPUTATION MASS. S_A is purely the imputation metric; denoising only has to satisfy
      the Q_den>=Q_imp gate (denoising is the easier direction, rarely binding). I raise the
      imputation-mode probability 0.6 -> 0.72 so the gradient budget concentrates on the scored
      task while still training the denoising readout enough to hold the gate.

  (3) RANK-FIRST SIGNAL LOSS. Two of the scored corrs (the headline one) are POOLED Spearman across
      positions AND assays, so cross-assay rank consistency is what's graded. I up-weight the pooled
      soft-Spearman surrogate on the signal head and STANDARDIZE the enrichment-MSE per (sample,assay)
      to a z-score — so the regression term only fixes within-track SHAPE and stops fighting the
      per-assay affine that places assays on the common pooled scale.

  (4) A LITTLE MORE CROSS-ASSAY CAPACITY. Imputing an unseen assay is a collaborative-filtering
      inference; I widen d 64->72 with 6-head cross-assay attention and a learned gated residual,
      which fits comfortably in the budget on this small data and sharpens the held-out ranking.
