F = 8           # assays
L = 768         # bins
POOL = 25       # 19200 bp / 768 bins
REF_DEPTH = 23.0
N_ASSAY_ID = 64  # global assay-id table (indexed by meta assay_id, not tensor position)
CF_HEADS = 4     # multi-head CF affinity
COARSE = 8       # multi-resolution position pooling factor (768 -> 96)


class DNATower(nn.Module):
    """Motif-scale base-resolution stem -> max-pool to bins -> residual dilated convs (regional)."""

    def __init__(self, d_dna: int):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Conv1d(4, d_dna, kernel_size=15, padding=7)
        self.dils = nn.ModuleList()
        for dil in (1, 2, 4, 8):
            self.dils.append(nn.Sequential(
                nn.Conv1d(d_dna, d_dna, kernel_size=5, padding=2 * dil, dilation=dil),
                nn.GELU(),
                nn.Conv1d(d_dna, d_dna, kernel_size=1),
            ))
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d_dna)

    def forward(self, x_dna):                                # [B,19200,4]
        x = Fn.gelu(self.stem(x_dna.transpose(1, 2)))        # [B,d_dna,19200] motif scale
        x = Fn.max_pool1d(x, POOL)                           # [B,d_dna,768] strongest hit per bin
        for blk in self.dils:
            x = x + blk(x)                                   # grow receptive field (regional)
        return self.norm(x.transpose(1, 2))                  # [B,L,d_dna]


class Spatial(nn.Module):
    """Multi-resolution position mixer per-assay (memory-efficient): a FINE dilated
    depthwise-separable conv PLUS a COARSE pooled-conv branch (avg-pool x8 -> conv -> upsample) so
    every bin sees ~locus-scale context without quadratic attention (§3.6b)."""

    def __init__(self, d: int, dil: int):
        super().__init__()
        self.dw = nn.Conv1d(d, d, kernel_size=5, padding=2 * dil, dilation=dil, groups=d)
        self.pw = nn.Conv1d(d, d, kernel_size=1)
        self.coarse = nn.Conv1d(d, d, kernel_size=3, padding=1)   # on pooled (long-range)
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d)

    def forward(self, h, key_padding=None):               # h: [B,L,F,d]
        B, Lc, Fc, d = h.shape
        x = h.permute(0, 2, 3, 1).reshape(B * Fc, d, Lc)   # [B*F, d, L]
        fine = self.pw(Fn.gelu(self.dw(x)))                # local
        c = Fn.avg_pool1d(x, COARSE)                       # [B*F, d, L/8]
        c = Fn.gelu(self.coarse(c))
        c = Fn.interpolate(c, size=Lc, mode="linear", align_corners=False)  # locus-scale
        y = (fine + c).reshape(B, Fc, d, Lc).permute(0, 3, 1, 2)            # [B,L,F,d]
        return self.norm(h + y)


class CrossAssay(nn.Module):
    """Set-transformer over the F assays at each position (cross-assay collaborative filtering).
    Keys are restricted to PRESENT CONTEXT assays so every query reads only real evidence."""

    def __init__(self, d: int, nhead: int = 4, dropout: float = 0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.enc = nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
            d_model=d, nhead=nhead, dim_feedforward=2 * d, dropout=dropout, batch_first=True
        )

    def forward(self, h, key_padding=None):               # h:[B,L,F,d]; key_padding:[B,F] True=ignore
        B, Lc, Fc, d = h.shape
        x = h.reshape(B * Lc, Fc, d)
        kpm = None
        if key_padding is not None:
            kpm = key_padding[:, None, :].expand(B, Lc, Fc).reshape(B * Lc, Fc)
        x = self.enc(x, src_key_padding_mask=kpm)
        return x.reshape(B, Lc, Fc, d)


class Model(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d: int = 64, d_a: int = 16, d_dna: int = 48, n_blocks: int = 4):
        super().__init__()
        assert d_a % CF_HEADS == 0
        self.d_dna = d_dna
        self.d_a = d_a
        self.hd = d_a // CF_HEADS
        self.assay_emb = nn.Embedding(N_ASSAY_ID, d_a)
        self.dna = DNATower(d_dna)
        self.dna_film = nn.Linear(d_a, 2 * d_dna)
        in_dim = 7 + d_a + d_dna                            # 7 scalar feats (+ avg-ref) + assay emb + dna
        self.in_proj = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(in_dim, d), nn.GELU(), nn.LayerNorm(d))
        self.query_emb = nn.Embedding(N_ASSAY_ID, d)
        nn.init.normal_(self.query_emb.weight, std=0.02)
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList()
        dils = [1, 2, 4, 8]
        for i in range(n_blocks):
            self.blocks.append(Spatial(d, dil=dils[i % len(dils)]))
            self.blocks.append(CrossAssay(d))
        # explicit MULTI-HEAD cross-assay CF affinity (H independent bilinear forms)
        self.cf_W = nn.Parameter(torch.eye(self.hd)[None].repeat(CF_HEADS, 1, 1))  # [H,hd,hd]
        self.cf_gate = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(N_ASSAY_ID))   # per-assay pass-through of CF prior
        self.head_r = nn.Linear(d, 1)        # NB dispersion (depth-free)
        self.head_mu = nn.Linear(d, 1)       # NB base enrichment (depth-free)
        # DECOUPLED depth-free DEVIATION readout: imputation (masked) vs denoising (kept) pathways.
        # Final layer ZERO-INIT so the model starts at the reference+CF baseline and the heads
        # learn ONLY the cell-type-specific residual on top (ENCODE-challenge prior §3.6a).
        self.head_sig_imp = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(d + 1 + CF_HEADS, d), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(d, 1))  # masked positions
        self.head_sig_den = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(d + 1 + CF_HEADS, d), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(d, 1))  # kept positions
        for head in (self.head_sig_imp, self.head_sig_den):
            nn.init.zeros_(head[-1].weight); nn.init.zeros_(head[-1].bias)
        # COVARIATE-ROLE pathway: target (read_length, run_type) -> light additive level bias.
        self.cov_bias = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(2, d_a), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(d_a, 1))
        nn.init.zeros_(self.cov_bias[-1].weight); nn.init.zeros_(self.cov_bias[-1].bias)
        self.disp_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(N_ASSAY_ID))
        # AVERAGE-REFERENCE gate: per-target-assay coefficient on the cross-assay activity prior.
        # Init at 1.0 so the strong, leak-free baseline is the DOMINANT carrier from step 0 and the
        # zero-init learned heads start by modelling the *deviation* around it (§3.6a).
        self.ref_gate = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(N_ASSAY_ID))
        self.sig_scale = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(N_ASSAY_ID))
        self.sig_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(N_ASSAY_ID))
        self.pk_scale = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(N_ASSAY_ID))
        self.pk_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(N_ASSAY_ID))

    def _aid(self, x_meta):
        return x_meta[:, 1, :].round().long().clamp(0, N_ASSAY_ID - 1)   # [B,F]

    def forward(self, x_counts, x_avail, x_mask, x_meta, x_dna,
                control, ctrl_avail, y_meta, query_mask):
        B = x_counts.shape[0]
        aid = self._aid(y_meta)                                        # [B,F] target assay ids

        dna = self.dna(x_dna)[:, :, None, :].expand(B, L, F, self.d_dna)
        ae = self.assay_emb(aid)                                       # [B,F,d_a]
        gamma, beta = self.dna_film(ae).chunk(2, dim=-1)
        dna = dna * (1.0 + gamma[:, None]) + beta[:, None]

        # depth-free enrichment of the OBSERVED context (input depth), in arcsinh units
        size_in = torch.pow(2.0, (x_meta[:, 0, :] - REF_DEPTH).clamp(-4, 4)).clamp(min=1e-6)  # [B,F]
        enr_in = torch.arcsinh(x_counts.clamp(min=0) / size_in[:, None, :])                   # [B,L,F]
        # --- AVERAGE REFERENCE: mean enrichment over genuinely-present context assays [B,L] ---
        avail_f = x_avail[:, None, :]                                  # [B,1,F]
        ref = (enr_in * avail_f).sum(dim=2) / x_avail.sum(dim=1, keepdim=True).clamp(min=1.0)  # [B,L]
        ref_b = ref[:, :, None].expand(B, L, F)                        # broadcast to all assays

        cnt = torch.arcsinh(x_counts) * x_avail[:, None, :]
        av = x_avail[:, None, :].expand(B, L, F)
        is_query = x_mask.float()
        dep_in = x_meta[:, 0, :][:, None, :].expand(B, L, F)
        dep_tgt = y_meta[:, 0, :][:, None, :].expand(B, L, F)
        ctrl = (control[:, :, 0] * ctrl_avail[:, None])[:, :, None].expand(B, L, F)
        scal = torch.stack([cnt, av, is_query, dep_in, dep_tgt, ctrl, ref_b], dim=-1)

        ae_b = ae[:, None, :, :].expand(B, L, F, ae.shape[-1])
        feat = torch.cat([scal, ae_b, dna], dim=-1)

        h = self.in_proj(feat)                                        # [B,L,F,d]
        qtok = self.query_emb(aid)
        h = h + x_mask.float().unsqueeze(-1) * qtok[:, None]

        # cross-assay attention reads ONLY present context assays as keys
        key_padding = ~(x_avail > 0)                                  # [B,F] True = ignore as key
        for blk in self.blocks:
            h = blk(h, key_padding)

        # --- explicit MULTI-HEAD cross-assay CF prior (depth-free), masked to present sources ---
        ae_h = ae.view(B, F, CF_HEADS, self.hd)                       # [B,F,H,hd]
        aff = torch.einsum('bfhd,hde,bghe->bfgh', ae_h, self.cf_W, ae_h)   # [B,F,F,H]
        key_ok = (x_avail > 0)[:, None, :, None]                      # [B,1,F,1] present as source
        aff = aff.masked_fill(~key_ok, -1e9)
        p = torch.softmax(aff, dim=2)                                # [B,F,F,H] over source g
        cf_prior = torch.einsum('bfgh,blg->blfh', p, enr_in)         # [B,L,F,H] H CF estimates
        cf_mean = cf_prior.mean(dim=-1)                              # [B,L,F] CF deviation estimate

        disp = self.disp_bias[aid][:, None, :]
        r = Fn.softplus(self.head_r(h).squeeze(-1) + disp) + 1e-2
        mu_base = Fn.softplus(self.head_mu(h).squeeze(-1)) + 1e-3     # depth-free enrichment
        size = torch.pow(2.0, (y_meta[:, 0, :] - REF_DEPTH).clamp(-4, 4))[:, None, :]
        mu = mu_base * size
        probs = (mu / (mu + r)).clamp(1e-4, 1 - 1e-4)
        count_dist = torch.distributions.NegativeBinomial(total_count=r, probs=probs)

        log_enr = torch.log(mu_base + 1e-3).unsqueeze(-1)            # physics-grounded rank prior
        feat_sig = torch.cat([h, log_enr, cf_prior], dim=-1)
        delta_imp = self.head_sig_imp(feat_sig).squeeze(-1)          # masked-position residual
        delta_den = self.head_sig_den(feat_sig).squeeze(-1)          # kept-position residual
        delta = torch.where(x_mask, delta_imp, delta_den)           # decoupled pathway selection

        # COVARIATE-ROLE additive bias from TARGET (read_length, run_type) — protocol level offset
        cov = torch.stack([y_meta[:, 2, :] / 100.0, y_meta[:, 3, :]], dim=-1)  # [B,F,2]
        cov_b = self.cov_bias(cov).squeeze(-1)[:, None, :]          # [B,1,F]

        gate = self.cf_gate[aid][:, None, :]
        rgate = self.ref_gate[aid][:, None, :]
        # RESIDUAL-ON-REFERENCE: strong leak-free baseline (reference + CF deviation) is the
        # carrier; the zero-init learned heads add ONLY the cell-type-specific deviation Δ.
        combined = rgate * ref_b + gate * cf_mean + cov_b + delta
        sc = self.sig_scale[aid][:, None, :]
        bi = self.sig_bias[aid][:, None, :]
        signal_pred = combined * sc + bi
        pk = self.pk_scale[aid][:, None, :]
        pb = self.pk_bias[aid][:, None, :]
        peak_prob = torch.sigmoid(signal_pred * pk + pb)
        return {"count_dist": count_dist, "signal_pred": signal_pred, "peak_prob": peak_prob}


class Objective:
    """ONE noise process: sample a depth level (denoising) AND mask present assays (imputation).
    Curriculum: 70% deployment-matched low-mask (1–2 assays), 30% heavier. NB target = full-depth
    raw counts; signal target = depth-free enrichment arcsinh(y_counts/size). Loss =
    correlation-dominant (genome-wide + per-track value-Pearson) PLUS an explicit
    DEVIATION-correlation term on imputed positions (correlate pred−ref vs target−ref, the
    cell-type-specific residual the metric rewards), light Huber for well-posedness, light NB
    owning ECE/DCR, and a light cross-assay consistency anchor. No soft-Spearman surrogate.
    IMP_W=1.0 (equal-weight generalization regime; the imp/den split lives in the model)."""

    LEVELS = [("counts", "meta"),
              ("counts_dsf2", "meta_dsf2"),
              ("counts_dsf4", "meta_dsf4"),
              ("counts_dsf8", "meta_dsf8")]

    IMP_W = 1.0   # equal weighting of imputation (masked) and denoising (kept) positions
    CONS_W = 0.3  # cross-assay consistency anchor weight
    DEV_W = 1.0   # explicit deviation-from-average-reference correlation weight

    def corrupt(self, batch, rng):
        avail = batch["avail"]
        counts_full, meta_full = batch["counts"], batch["meta"]
        B, Lc, Fc = counts_full.shape
        dev = counts_full.device

        li = int(torch.randint(0, len(self.LEVELS), (1,), generator=rng).item())
        ck, mk = self.LEVELS[li]
        x_counts = batch[ck].clone()
        x_meta = batch[mk]

        heavy = float(torch.rand((1,), generator=rng).item()) < 0.3
        lo, span = (0.30, 0.20) if heavy else (0.10, 0.20)

        x_avail = avail.clone()
        x_mask = torch.zeros(B, Lc, Fc, dtype=torch.bool, device=dev)
        for b in range(B):
            present = torch.where(avail[b] > 0)[0]
            n = present.numel()
            if n <= 1:
                continue
            frac = lo + span * float(torch.rand((1,), generator=rng).item())
            k = max(1, min(max(1, n - 1), int(round(frac * n))))
            drop = present[torch.randperm(n, generator=rng)[:k]]
            x_avail[b, drop] = 0.0
            x_mask[b, :, drop] = True
        x_counts = x_counts * x_avail[:, None, :]

        sup_mask = (avail > 0)[:, None, :].expand(B, Lc, Fc).clone()
        thr = torch.quantile(counts_full, 0.90, dim=1, keepdim=True)
        y_peaks = (counts_full > thr).float()
        size = torch.pow(2.0, (meta_full[:, 0, :] - REF_DEPTH).clamp(-4, 4))[:, None, :]
        y_enr = torch.arcsinh(counts_full.clamp(min=0) / size.clamp(min=1e-6))
        # full-depth average-reference over all genuinely-present assays (matches model's prior)
        avail_full = (avail > 0).float()                                       # [B,F]
        y_ref = (y_enr * avail_full[:, None, :]).sum(dim=2) / \
                avail_full.sum(dim=1, keepdim=True).clamp(min=1.0)             # [B,L]
        return {
            "x_counts": x_counts, "x_avail": x_avail, "x_mask": x_mask, "x_meta": x_meta,
            "x_dna": batch["dna"], "control": batch["control"], "ctrl_avail": batch["ctrl_avail"],
            "y_meta": meta_full, "query_mask": (avail > 0),
            "y_counts": counts_full, "sup_mask": sup_mask, "y_peaks": y_peaks, "y_enr": y_enr,
            "y_ref": y_ref,
        }

    def _pearson_track(self, pred, tgt, track_imp):
        if track_imp.sum() == 0:
            return pred.sum() * 0.0
        p = pred - pred.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True)
        t = tgt - tgt.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True)
        num = (p * t).sum(dim=1)
        den = torch.sqrt(((p * p).sum(dim=1)).clamp(min=1e-6) *
                         ((t * t).sum(dim=1)).clamp(min=1e-6))
        corr = (num / den)[track_imp]
        return 1.0 - corr.mean()

    def _pearson_global(self, pred, tgt, sel):
        if sel.sum() < 2:
            return pred.sum() * 0.0
        p = pred[sel]; t = tgt[sel]
        p = p - p.mean(); t = t - t.mean()
        den = torch.sqrt((p * p).sum().clamp(min=1e-6) * (t * t).sum().clamp(min=1e-6))
        return 1.0 - (p * t).sum() / den

    def _deviation_pearson(self, pred, tgt, ref, sel):
        """Correlate the cell-type-specific RESIDUAL (pred-ref) vs (target-ref) on imputed
        positions — the ONLY signal that beats the average-reference baseline (§3.6a). Putting
        gradient pressure here keeps the model from coasting on the (leak-free) reference."""
        if sel.sum() < 2:
            return pred.sum() * 0.0
        refb = ref[:, :, None].expand_as(pred)
        dp = (pred - refb)[sel]
        dt = (tgt - refb)[sel]
        dp = dp - dp.mean(); dt = dt - dt.mean()
        den = torch.sqrt((dp * dp).sum().clamp(min=1e-6) * (dt * dt).sum().clamp(min=1e-6))
        return 1.0 - (dp * dt).sum() / den

    def _consistency(self, sig_pred, sig_tgt, cb, m):
        """Imputed tracks' per-position mean profile must CORRELATE (across positions) with the
        observed tracks' per-position mean profile (observed detached)."""
        imp_sel = (cb["x_mask"] & m).float()                 # [B,L,F]
        obs_sel = ((~cb["x_mask"]) & m).float()              # [B,L,F]
        imp_n = imp_sel.sum(dim=2).clamp(min=1.0)            # [B,L]
        obs_n = obs_sel.sum(dim=2).clamp(min=1.0)
        imp_m = (sig_pred * imp_sel).sum(dim=2) / imp_n       # [B,L]
        obs_m = (sig_tgt.detach() * obs_sel).sum(dim=2) / obs_n
        valid_b = ((cb["x_mask"] & m).any(dim=1).any(dim=1) &
                   ((~cb["x_mask"]) & m).any(dim=1).any(dim=1))   # [B] has both imp & obs tracks
        if valid_b.sum() == 0:
            return sig_pred.sum() * 0.0
        p = imp_m - imp_m.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True)
        t = obs_m - obs_m.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True)
        num = (p * t).sum(dim=1)
        den = torch.sqrt((p * p).sum(dim=1).clamp(min=1e-6) * (t * t).sum(dim=1).clamp(min=1e-6))
        corr = (num / den)[valid_b]
        return 1.0 - corr.mean()

    def loss(self, out, cb):
        m = cb["sup_mask"]
        if m.sum() == 0:
            return (out["signal_pred"].sum() * 0.0).requires_grad_(True)
        y = cb["y_counts"].clamp(min=0)
        sig_tgt = cb["y_enr"]
        sig_pred = out["signal_pred"]

        tnorm = sig_tgt / (sig_tgt.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True).clamp(min=1e-3) + 1e-6)
        hi = 1.0 + 0.5 * tnorm.clamp(0, 4)
        w = torch.where(cb["x_mask"], self.IMP_W, 1.0) * m.float() * hi
        wsum = w.sum().clamp(min=1.0)

        nll = -out["count_dist"].log_prob(y)
        huber = Fn.smooth_l1_loss(sig_pred, sig_tgt, reduction="none", beta=1.0)
        nll_t = (nll * w).sum() / wsum
        hub_t = (huber * w).sum() / wsum

        track_imp = cb["x_mask"][:, 0, :] & cb["query_mask"]
        sel = cb["x_mask"] & m

        pe_gl = self._pearson_global(sig_pred, sig_tgt, sel)
        pe_pt = self._pearson_track(sig_pred, sig_tgt, track_imp)
        dev = self._deviation_pearson(sig_pred, sig_tgt, cb["y_ref"], sel)
        cons = self._consistency(sig_pred, sig_tgt, cb, m)

        pk_logit = torch.logit(out["peak_prob"].clamp(1e-4, 1 - 1e-4))
        bce = Fn.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(pk_logit[m], cb["y_peaks"][m])

        return (0.5 * nll_t + 0.5 * hub_t
                + 1.5 * pe_gl + 1.0 * pe_pt
                + self.DEV_W * dev
                + self.CONS_W * cons
                + 0.1 * bce)

    def configure_optimizer(self, params):
        return torch.optim.AdamW(params, lr=1.5e-3, weight_decay=3e-4)

"""CANDI v3 — cross-assay collaborative-filtering imputer with DECOUPLED imp/den readout heads,
a cross-assay consistency anchor, principled use of read_length/run_type as a light additive
conditioning bias, a TRUE MULTI-SCALE (pyramid) positional context, a local within-window
peak-shape correlation objective, an explicit AVERAGE-REFERENCE RESIDUAL parameterization of the
imputed signal, AND — the single new change this revision — a MID-RANGE-EMPHASIS supervision
weight that targets the signal regime where imputation skill is actually won.

Regime kept from the prior best (ONE NB likelihood on raw counts with a size-factor offset owning
ECE/DCR; depth-free enrichment signal head matched to the depth-invariant pval target; motif-
preserving DNA tower; availability-aware set-transformer cross-assay attention; unified
dropout+downsample corruption; curriculum masking; control-optional; fixed decoder; no JEPA;
multi-head bilinear cross-assay CF prior; decoupled imp/den readout heads; cross-assay consistency
anchor; covariate-role additive bias; multi-scale position pyramid context; local peak-shape
correlation; average-reference residual; IMP_W=1.0; correlation-dominant objective).

WHAT CHANGES and WHY. The ENCODE imputation-challenge assessment (PLAN §3.6a) makes two precise
claims about *where* error concentrates that the supervision weighting has not yet acted on
jointly: (i) "accuracy has three regimes vs signal level: easy at low signal, easy at very high
signal, **sharp failure at intermediate/ambiguous signal** — the mid-range is where skill is won";
and (ii) "magnitude at correctly-located peaks is the dominant error." The prior weight
`hi = 1 + 0.5·tnorm` only encodes (ii): it monotonically up-weights HIGH signal, so it spends the
loss budget on the already-easy high-signal tail and the easy background tail while UNDER-weighting
exactly the ambiguous mid-range that decides the genome-wide rank (Spearman) on held-out tracks.
We therefore ADD a Gaussian mid-range bump (peaking where the target enrichment ≈ its per-track
mean, i.e. the intermediate/ambiguous regime) on top of the existing high-signal term. The weight
now emphasizes BOTH the mid-range (regime (i), the scored-Spearman lever) AND the high-signal peaks
(regime (ii), magnitude), while still de-emphasizing the easy background — a strictly additive,
literature-grounded reshaping of where gradient lands, leaving architecture and the fragile
NB/size-factor (DCR/ECE) head entirely untouched for clean attribution.
"""

import torch

import torch.nn.functional as Fn

from harness import run_and_score

F = 8           # assays
L = 768         # bins
POOL = 25       # 19200 bp / 768 bins
REF_DEPTH = 23.0
N_ASSAY_ID = 64  # global assay-id table (indexed by meta assay_id, not tensor position)
CF_HEADS = 4     # multi-head CF affinity
SCALES = (8, 32, 128)  # multi-resolution context windows (bins): ~200bp / ~800bp / ~3.2kb
D_CTX = 16       # projected regional-context width
LOCAL_W = 32     # local-shape correlation window (bins ≈ 800 bp)


class DNATower(nn.Module):
    """Motif-scale base-resolution stem -> max-pool to bins -> residual dilated convs (regional)."""

    def __init__(self, d_dna: int):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Conv1d(4, d_dna, kernel_size=15, padding=7)
        self.dils = nn.ModuleList()
        for dil in (1, 2, 4, 8):
            self.dils.append(nn.Sequential(
                nn.Conv1d(d_dna, d_dna, kernel_size=5, padding=2 * dil, dilation=dil),
                nn.GELU(),
                nn.Conv1d(d_dna, d_dna, kernel_size=1),
            ))
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d_dna)

    def forward(self, x_dna):                                # [B,19200,4]
        x = Fn.gelu(self.stem(x_dna.transpose(1, 2)))        # [B,d_dna,19200] motif scale
        x = Fn.max_pool1d(x, POOL)                           # [B,d_dna,768] strongest hit per bin
        for blk in self.dils:
            x = x + blk(x)                                   # grow receptive field (regional)
        return self.norm(x.transpose(1, 2))                  # [B,L,d_dna]


class Spatial(nn.Module):
    """Dilated depthwise-separable conv over position, applied per-assay (memory-efficient)."""

    def __init__(self, d: int, dil: int):
        super().__init__()
        self.dw = nn.Conv1d(d, d, kernel_size=5, padding=2 * dil, dilation=dil, groups=d)
        self.pw = nn.Conv1d(d, d, kernel_size=1)
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d)

    def forward(self, h, key_padding=None):               # h: [B,L,F,d]
        B, Lc, Fc, d = h.shape
        x = h.permute(0, 2, 3, 1).reshape(B * Fc, d, Lc)   # [B*F, d, L]
        y = self.pw(Fn.gelu(self.dw(x)))
        y = y.reshape(B, Fc, d, Lc).permute(0, 3, 1, 2)    # [B,L,F,d]
        return self.norm(h + y)


class CrossAssay(nn.Module):
    """Set-transformer over the F assays at each position (cross-assay collaborative filtering).
    Keys are restricted to PRESENT CONTEXT assays so every query reads only real evidence."""

    def __init__(self, d: int, nhead: int = 4, dropout: float = 0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.enc = nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
            d_model=d, nhead=nhead, dim_feedforward=2 * d, dropout=dropout, batch_first=True
        )

    def forward(self, h, key_padding=None):               # h:[B,L,F,d]; key_padding:[B,F] True=ignore
        B, Lc, Fc, d = h.shape
        x = h.reshape(B * Lc, Fc, d)
        kpm = None
        if key_padding is not None:
            kpm = key_padding[:, None, :].expand(B, Lc, Fc).reshape(B * Lc, Fc)
        x = self.enc(x, src_key_padding_mask=kpm)
        return x.reshape(B, Lc, Fc, d)


class Model(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d: int = 64, d_a: int = 16, d_dna: int = 48, n_blocks: int = 4):
        super().__init__()
        assert d_a % CF_HEADS == 0
        self.d_dna = d_dna
        self.d_a = d_a
        self.hd = d_a // CF_HEADS
        self.assay_emb = nn.Embedding(N_ASSAY_ID, d_a)
        self.dna = DNATower(d_dna)
        self.dna_film = nn.Linear(d_a, 2 * d_dna)
        in_dim = 6 + d_a + d_dna                            # 6 scalar feats + assay emb + dna
        self.in_proj = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(in_dim, d), nn.GELU(), nn.LayerNorm(d))
        self.query_emb = nn.Embedding(N_ASSAY_ID, d)
        nn.init.normal_(self.query_emb.weight, std=0.02)
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList()
        dils = [1, 2, 4, 8]
        for i in range(n_blocks):
            self.blocks.append(Spatial(d, dil=dils[i % len(dils)]))
            self.blocks.append(CrossAssay(d))
        # explicit MULTI-HEAD cross-assay CF affinity (H independent bilinear forms)
        self.cf_W = nn.Parameter(torch.eye(self.hd)[None].repeat(CF_HEADS, 1, 1))  # [H,hd,hd]
        self.cf_gate = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(N_ASSAY_ID))   # per-assay pass-through of CF prior
        # AVERAGE-REFERENCE residual: per-assay gate on the cross-assay mean enrichment baseline
        self.base_gate = nn.Parameter(torch.full((N_ASSAY_ID,), 0.5))
        # MULTI-SCALE (pyramid) regional-context projection for the enrichment readout
        self.ctx_proj = nn.Linear(len(SCALES) * d, D_CTX)
        self.head_r = nn.Linear(d, 1)        # NB dispersion (depth-free)
        self.head_mu = nn.Linear(d, 1)       # NB base enrichment (depth-free)
        # DECOUPLED depth-free enrichment readout: imputation (masked) vs denoising (kept) pathways
        sig_in = d + 1 + CF_HEADS + D_CTX
        self.head_sig_imp = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(sig_in, d), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(d, 1))  # masked positions
        self.head_sig_den = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(sig_in, d), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(d, 1))  # kept positions
        # COVARIATE-ROLE pathway: target (read_length, run_type) -> light additive level bias.
        self.cov_bias = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(2, d_a), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(d_a, 1))
        nn.init.zeros_(self.cov_bias[-1].weight); nn.init.zeros_(self.cov_bias[-1].bias)
        self.disp_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(N_ASSAY_ID))
        self.sig_scale = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(N_ASSAY_ID))
        self.sig_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(N_ASSAY_ID))
        self.pk_scale = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(N_ASSAY_ID))
        self.pk_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(N_ASSAY_ID))

    def _aid(self, x_meta):
        return x_meta[:, 1, :].round().long().clamp(0, N_ASSAY_ID - 1)   # [B,F]

    def forward(self, x_counts, x_avail, x_mask, x_meta, x_dna,
                control, ctrl_avail, y_meta, query_mask):
        B = x_counts.shape[0]
        aid = self._aid(y_meta)                                        # [B,F] target assay ids

        dna = self.dna(x_dna)[:, :, None, :].expand(B, L, F, self.d_dna)
        ae = self.assay_emb(aid)                                       # [B,F,d_a]
        gamma, beta = self.dna_film(ae).chunk(2, dim=-1)
        dna = dna * (1.0 + gamma[:, None]) + beta[:, None]

        cnt = torch.arcsinh(x_counts) * x_avail[:, None, :]
        av = x_avail[:, None, :].expand(B, L, F)
        is_query = x_mask.float()
        dep_in = x_meta[:, 0, :][:, None, :].expand(B, L, F)
        dep_tgt = y_meta[:, 0, :][:, None, :].expand(B, L, F)
        ctrl = (control[:, :, 0] * ctrl_avail[:, None])[:, :, None].expand(B, L, F)
        scal = torch.stack([cnt, av, is_query, dep_in, dep_tgt, ctrl], dim=-1)

        ae_b = ae[:, None, :, :].expand(B, L, F, ae.shape[-1])
        feat = torch.cat([scal, ae_b, dna], dim=-1)

        h = self.in_proj(feat)                                        # [B,L,F,d]
        qtok = self.query_emb(aid)
        h = h + x_mask.float().unsqueeze(-1) * qtok[:, None]

        # cross-assay attention reads ONLY present context assays as keys
        key_padding = ~(x_avail > 0)                                  # [B,F] True = ignore as key
        for blk in self.blocks:
            h = blk(h, key_padding)

        # --- MULTI-SCALE regional context (Avocado-style position pyramid: fine+mid+coarse) ---
        d = h.shape[-1]
        hc = h.permute(0, 2, 3, 1).reshape(B * F, d, L)              # [B*F,d,L]
        ms = []
        for win in SCALES:
            pooled = Fn.avg_pool1d(hc, kernel_size=win, stride=win)   # [B*F,d,L/win]
            ms.append(Fn.interpolate(pooled, size=L, mode="nearest"))  # broadcast back to bins
        hc_ms = torch.cat(ms, dim=1)                                # [B*F, S*d, L]
        hc_ms = hc_ms.reshape(B, F, len(SCALES) * d, L).permute(0, 3, 1, 2)   # [B,L,F,S*d]
        ctx = self.ctx_proj(hc_ms)                                  # [B,L,F,D_CTX]

        # --- explicit MULTI-HEAD cross-assay CF prior (depth-free), masked to present sources ---
        size_in = torch.pow(2.0, (x_meta[:, 0, :] - REF_DEPTH).clamp(-4, 4)).clamp(min=1e-6)  # [B,F]
        enr_in = torch.arcsinh(x_counts.clamp(min=0) / size_in[:, None, :])                   # [B,L,F]
        ae_h = ae.view(B, F, CF_HEADS, self.hd)                       # [B,F,H,hd]
        aff = torch.einsum('bfhd,hde,bghe->bfgh', ae_h, self.cf_W, ae_h)   # [B,F,F,H]
        key_ok = (x_avail > 0)[:, None, :, None]                      # [B,1,F,1] present as source
        aff = aff.masked_fill(~key_ok, -1e9)
        p = torch.softmax(aff, dim=2)                                # [B,F,F,H] over source g
        cf_prior = torch.einsum('bfgh,blg->blfh', p, enr_in)         # [B,L,F,H] H CF estimates
        cf_mean = cf_prior.mean(dim=-1)                              # [B,L,F] gated additive prior

        # --- AVERAGE-REFERENCE baseline: mean depth-free enrichment over PRESENT context assays ---
        present = (x_avail > 0).float()                              # [B,F]
        base_profile = (enr_in * present[:, None, :]).sum(dim=-1) / present.sum(dim=-1).clamp(min=1.0)[:, None]  # [B,L]
        base_term = base_profile[:, :, None] * self.base_gate[aid][:, None, :]  # [B,L,F] strong shared shape

        disp = self.disp_bias[aid][:, None, :]
        r = Fn.softplus(self.head_r(h).squeeze(-1) + disp) + 1e-2
        mu_base = Fn.softplus(self.head_mu(h).squeeze(-1)) + 1e-3     # depth-free enrichment
        size = torch.pow(2.0, (y_meta[:, 0, :] - REF_DEPTH).clamp(-4, 4))[:, None, :]
        mu = mu_base * size
        probs = (mu / (mu + r)).clamp(1e-4, 1 - 1e-4)
        count_dist = torch.distributions.NegativeBinomial(total_count=r, probs=probs)

        log_enr = torch.log(mu_base + 1e-3).unsqueeze(-1)            # physics-grounded rank prior
        feat_sig = torch.cat([h, log_enr, cf_prior, ctx], dim=-1)
        sig_imp = self.head_sig_imp(feat_sig).squeeze(-1)            # masked-position DEVIATION readout
        sig_den = self.head_sig_den(feat_sig).squeeze(-1)           # kept-position DEVIATION readout
        sig = torch.where(x_mask, sig_imp, sig_den)                 # decoupled pathway selection

        # COVARIATE-ROLE additive bias from TARGET (read_length, run_type) — protocol level offset
        cov = torch.stack([y_meta[:, 2, :] / 100.0, y_meta[:, 3, :]], dim=-1)  # [B,F,2]
        cov_b = self.cov_bias(cov).squeeze(-1)[:, None, :]          # [B,1,F]

        gate = self.cf_gate[aid][:, None, :]
        # signal = average-reference anchor + cross-assay CF prior + protocol level + learned deviation
        combined = sig + gate * cf_mean + cov_b + base_term
        sc = self.sig_scale[aid][:, None, :]
        bi = self.sig_bias[aid][:, None, :]
        signal_pred = combined * sc + bi
        pk = self.pk_scale[aid][:, None, :]
        pb = self.pk_bias[aid][:, None, :]
        peak_prob = torch.sigmoid(signal_pred * pk + pb)
        return {"count_dist": count_dist, "signal_pred": signal_pred, "peak_prob": peak_prob}


class Objective:
    """ONE noise process: sample a depth level (denoising) AND mask present assays (imputation).
    Curriculum: 70% deployment-matched low-mask (1–2 assays), 30% heavier. NB target = full-depth
    raw counts; signal target = depth-free enrichment arcsinh(y_counts/size). Loss =
    correlation-dominant (genome-wide + per-track value-Pearson + local within-window
    value-Pearson), light Huber for well-posedness, light NB owning ECE/DCR, plus a light
    CROSS-ASSAY CONSISTENCY correlation anchor on the imputed tracks. No soft-Spearman surrogate.
    Supervision weight emphasizes BOTH the high-signal peaks (magnitude) AND the intermediate
    /ambiguous mid-range (where genome-wide held-out skill is won). IMP_W=1.0."""

    LEVELS = [("counts", "meta"),
              ("counts_dsf2", "meta_dsf2"),
              ("counts_dsf4", "meta_dsf4"),
              ("counts_dsf8", "meta_dsf8")]

    IMP_W = 1.0   # equal weighting of imputation (masked) and denoising (kept) positions
    CONS_W = 0.3  # cross-assay consistency anchor weight
    LOCAL_CORR_W = 0.75  # local within-window peak-shape correlation weight
    MID_W = 0.75  # mid-range (intermediate/ambiguous signal) emphasis amplitude
    MID_S = 0.6   # mid-range bump width (in target/mean enrichment units)

    def corrupt(self, batch, rng):
        avail = batch["avail"]
        counts_full, meta_full = batch["counts"], batch["meta"]
        B, Lc, Fc = counts_full.shape
        dev = counts_full.device

        li = int(torch.randint(0, len(self.LEVELS), (1,), generator=rng).item())
        ck, mk = self.LEVELS[li]
        x_counts = batch[ck].clone()
        x_meta = batch[mk]

        heavy = float(torch.rand((1,), generator=rng).item()) < 0.3
        lo, span = (0.30, 0.20) if heavy else (0.10, 0.20)

        x_avail = avail.clone()
        x_mask = torch.zeros(B, Lc, Fc, dtype=torch.bool, device=dev)
        for b in range(B):
            present = torch.where(avail[b] > 0)[0]
            n = present.numel()
            if n <= 1:
                continue
            frac = lo + span * float(torch.rand((1,), generator=rng).item())
            k = max(1, min(max(1, n - 1), int(round(frac * n))))
            drop = present[torch.randperm(n, generator=rng)[:k]]
            x_avail[b, drop] = 0.0
            x_mask[b, :, drop] = True
        x_counts = x_counts * x_avail[:, None, :]

        sup_mask = (avail > 0)[:, None, :].expand(B, Lc, Fc).clone()
        thr = torch.quantile(counts_full, 0.90, dim=1, keepdim=True)
        y_peaks = (counts_full > thr).float()
        size = torch.pow(2.0, (meta_full[:, 0, :] - REF_DEPTH).clamp(-4, 4))[:, None, :]
        y_enr = torch.arcsinh(counts_full.clamp(min=0) / size.clamp(min=1e-6))
        return {
            "x_counts": x_counts, "x_avail": x_avail, "x_mask": x_mask, "x_meta": x_meta,
            "x_dna": batch["dna"], "control": batch["control"], "ctrl_avail": batch["ctrl_avail"],
            "y_meta": meta_full, "query_mask": (avail > 0),
            "y_counts": counts_full, "sup_mask": sup_mask, "y_peaks": y_peaks, "y_enr": y_enr,
        }

    def _pearson_track(self, pred, tgt, track_imp):
        if track_imp.sum() == 0:
            return pred.sum() * 0.0
        p = pred - pred.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True)
        t = tgt - tgt.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True)
        num = (p * t).sum(dim=1)
        den = torch.sqrt(((p * p).sum(dim=1)).clamp(min=1e-6) *
                         ((t * t).sum(dim=1)).clamp(min=1e-6))
        corr = (num / den)[track_imp]
        return 1.0 - corr.mean()

    def _pearson_local(self, pred, tgt, track_imp, W=LOCAL_W):
        """LOCAL within-window per-track value-Pearson on imputed tracks: rewards reproducing
        the signal SHAPE inside each ~800 bp neighbourhood (the under-served peak-shape lever),
        not just the broad genome-wide level. Attacks within-peak over-smoothing."""
        if track_imp.sum() == 0:
            return pred.sum() * 0.0
        B, Lc, Fc = pred.shape
        nwin = Lc // W
        Lt = nwin * W
        p = pred[:, :Lt, :].reshape(B, nwin, W, Fc)
        t = tgt[:, :Lt, :].reshape(B, nwin, W, Fc)
        p = p - p.mean(dim=2, keepdim=True)
        t = t - t.mean(dim=2, keepdim=True)
        num = (p * t).sum(dim=2)                                  # [B,nwin,F]
        den = torch.sqrt((p * p).sum(dim=2).clamp(min=1e-6) *
                         (t * t).sum(dim=2).clamp(min=1e-6))
        corr = num / den                                          # [B,nwin,F]
        sel = track_imp[:, None, :].expand(B, nwin, Fc)           # imputed tracks only
        return 1.0 - corr[sel].mean()

    def _pearson_global(self, pred, tgt, sel):
        if sel.sum() < 2:
            return pred.sum() * 0.0
        p = pred[sel]; t = tgt[sel]
        p = p - p.mean(); t = t - t.mean()
        den = torch.sqrt((p * p).sum().clamp(min=1e-6) * (t * t).sum().clamp(min=1e-6))
        return 1.0 - (p * t).sum() / den

    def _consistency(self, sig_pred, sig_tgt, cb, m):
        """Imputed tracks' per-position mean profile must CORRELATE (across positions) with the
        observed tracks' per-position mean profile (observed detached)."""
        imp_sel = (cb["x_mask"] & m).float()                 # [B,L,F]
        obs_sel = ((~cb["x_mask"]) & m).float()              # [B,L,F]
        imp_n = imp_sel.sum(dim=2).clamp(min=1.0)            # [B,L]
        obs_n = obs_sel.sum(dim=2).clamp(min=1.0)
        imp_m = (sig_pred * imp_sel).sum(dim=2) / imp_n       # [B,L]
        obs_m = (sig_tgt.detach() * obs_sel).sum(dim=2) / obs_n
        valid_b = ((cb["x_mask"] & m).any(dim=1).any(dim=1) &
                   ((~cb["x_mask"]) & m).any(dim=1).any(dim=1))   # [B] has both imp & obs tracks
        if valid_b.sum() == 0:
            return sig_pred.sum() * 0.0
        p = imp_m - imp_m.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True)
        t = obs_m - obs_m.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True)
        num = (p * t).sum(dim=1)
        den = torch.sqrt((p * p).sum(dim=1).clamp(min=1e-6) * (t * t).sum(dim=1).clamp(min=1e-6))
        corr = (num / den)[valid_b]
        return 1.0 - corr.mean()

    def loss(self, out, cb):
        m = cb["sup_mask"]
        if m.sum() == 0:
            return (out["signal_pred"].sum() * 0.0).requires_grad_(True)
        y = cb["y_counts"].clamp(min=0)
        sig_tgt = cb["y_enr"]
        sig_pred = out["signal_pred"]

        # Supervision weight over the THREE-REGIME signal axis (PLAN §3.6a):
        #   - high-signal term (1 + 0.5·tnorm): magnitude at correctly-located peaks
        #   - mid-range Gaussian bump (peaks at tnorm≈1): the intermediate/ambiguous regime where
        #     genome-wide held-out skill is actually won; background (tnorm≈0) stays low.
        tnorm = (sig_tgt / (sig_tgt.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True).clamp(min=1e-3) + 1e-6)).clamp(0, 4)
        mid = self.MID_W * torch.exp(-0.5 * ((tnorm - 1.0) / self.MID_S) ** 2)
        hi = 1.0 + 0.5 * tnorm + mid
        w = torch.where(cb["x_mask"], self.IMP_W, 1.0) * m.float() * hi
        wsum = w.sum().clamp(min=1.0)

        nll = -out["count_dist"].log_prob(y)
        huber = Fn.smooth_l1_loss(sig_pred, sig_tgt, reduction="none", beta=1.0)
        nll_t = (nll * w).sum() / wsum
        hub_t = (huber * w).sum() / wsum

        track_imp = cb["x_mask"][:, 0, :] & cb["query_mask"]
        sel = cb["x_mask"] & m

        pe_gl = self._pearson_global(sig_pred, sig_tgt, sel)
        pe_pt = self._pearson_track(sig_pred, sig_tgt, track_imp)
        pe_loc = self._pearson_local(sig_pred, sig_tgt, track_imp)
        cons = self._consistency(sig_pred, sig_tgt, cb, m)

        pk_logit = torch.logit(out["peak_prob"].clamp(1e-4, 1 - 1e-4))
        bce = Fn.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(pk_logit[m], cb["y_peaks"][m])

        return (0.5 * nll_t + 0.5 * hub_t
                + 1.5 * pe_gl + 1.0 * pe_pt
                + self.LOCAL_CORR_W * pe_loc
                + self.CONS_W * cons
                + 0.1 * bce)

    def configure_optimizer(self, params):
        return torch.optim.AdamW(params, lr=1.5e-3, weight_decay=3e-4)

"""CANDI v3 — cross-assay collaborative-filtering imputer with an explicit RESIDUAL-ON-REFERENCE
readout: the strong, leak-free average-reference baseline (plus the cross-assay CF deviation
estimate) is the structural carrier of the prediction, and the learned, decoupled imp/den heads
add ONLY the cell-type-specific deviation that the ENCODE-challenge assessment (§3.6a) says is
the only thing that beats the average reference.

Regime kept from the prior best (ONE NB likelihood on raw counts with a size-factor offset
owning ECE/DCR; depth-free enrichment signal head matched to the depth-invariant pval target;
motif-preserving DNA tower; availability-aware set-transformer cross-assay attention; unified
dropout+downsample corruption; curriculum masking; control-optional; fixed decoder; no JEPA;
multi-head bilinear cross-assay CF prior; decoupled imp/den readout heads; cross-assay
consistency anchor; covariate-role additive bias; average-reference + deviation decomposition;
explicit deviation-correlation loss; IMP_W=1.0; correlation-dominant objective).

This revision makes TWO targeted, score-aligned changes (the headline metric is the held-out
imputation pval SPEARMAN over masked V_/B_ positions, which the reference carrier already
matches at baseline; the ONLY way to exceed baseline is correctly-ranked cell-type-specific
DEVIATION, §3.6a):

  (1) STRONGER deviation supervision. The deviation-correlation loss — correlate (pred−ref) vs
      (target−ref) on imputed positions — is the gradient most aligned with the scored quantity,
      so it is up-weighted AND extended with a PER-TRACK variant (per held-out assay, across
      positions) that directly shapes each imputed assay's within-track ranking. The absolute
      Huber term (which competes with the rank objective and is partly absorbed by the reference)
      is correspondingly de-emphasised. No soft-Spearman surrogate (known dead-end).

  (2) The decoupled imp/den head final layers are SMALL-init (std 1e-2) rather than exact zero:
      the strong reference+CF baseline is still the dominant carrier at step 0 (ref_gate=1.0,
      tiny Δ), but the residual heads carry a small live signal immediately so the fixed-budget
      training spends fewer steps escaping a flat zero and more on the cell-type deviation.

The NB/size-factor head (DCR/ECE — a known-fragile, near-solved mechanism) is byte-for-byte
unchanged for clean attribution of the score delta to the deviation pathway.
"""

import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as Fn

F = 8           # assays
L = 768         # bins
POOL = 25       # 19200 bp / 768 bins
REF_DEPTH = 23.0
N_ASSAY_ID = 64  # global assay-id table (indexed by meta assay_id, not tensor position)
CF_HEADS = 4     # multi-head CF affinity


class DNATower(nn.Module):
    """Motif-scale base-resolution stem -> max-pool to bins -> residual dilated convs (regional)."""

    def __init__(self, d_dna: int):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Conv1d(4, d_dna, kernel_size=15, padding=7)
        self.dils = nn.ModuleList()
        for dil in (1, 2, 4, 8):
            self.dils.append(nn.Sequential(
                nn.Conv1d(d_dna, d_dna, kernel_size=5, padding=2 * dil, dilation=dil),
                nn.GELU(),
                nn.Conv1d(d_dna, d_dna, kernel_size=1),
            ))
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d_dna)

    def forward(self, x_dna):                                # [B,19200,4]
        x = Fn.gelu(self.stem(x_dna.transpose(1, 2)))        # [B,d_dna,19200] motif scale
        x = Fn.max_pool1d(x, POOL)                           # [B,d_dna,768] strongest hit per bin
        for blk in self.dils:
            x = x + blk(x)                                   # grow receptive field (regional)
        return self.norm(x.transpose(1, 2))                  # [B,L,d_dna]


class Spatial(nn.Module):
    """Dilated depthwise-separable conv over position, applied per-assay (memory-efficient)."""

    def __init__(self, d: int, dil: int):
        super().__init__()
        self.dw = nn.Conv1d(d, d, kernel_size=5, padding=2 * dil, dilation=dil, groups=d)
        self.pw = nn.Conv1d(d, d, kernel_size=1)
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(d)

    def forward(self, h, key_padding=None):               # h: [B,L,F,d]
        B, Lc, Fc, d = h.shape
        x = h.permute(0, 2, 3, 1).reshape(B * Fc, d, Lc)   # [B*F, d, L]
        y = self.pw(Fn.gelu(self.dw(x)))
        y = y.reshape(B, Fc, d, Lc).permute(0, 3, 1, 2)    # [B,L,F,d]
        return self.norm(h + y)


class CrossAssay(nn.Module):
    """Set-transformer over the F assays at each position (cross-assay collaborative filtering).
    Keys are restricted to PRESENT CONTEXT assays so every query reads only real evidence."""

    def __init__(self, d: int, nhead: int = 4, dropout: float = 0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.enc = nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
            d_model=d, nhead=nhead, dim_feedforward=2 * d, dropout=dropout, batch_first=True
        )

    def forward(self, h, key_padding=None):               # h:[B,L,F,d]; key_padding:[B,F] True=ignore
        B, Lc, Fc, d = h.shape
        x = h.reshape(B * Lc, Fc, d)
        kpm = None
        if key_padding is not None:
            kpm = key_padding[:, None, :].expand(B, Lc, Fc).reshape(B * Lc, Fc)
        x = self.enc(x, src_key_padding_mask=kpm)
        return x.reshape(B, Lc, Fc, d)


class Model(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d: int = 64, d_a: int = 16, d_dna: int = 48, n_blocks: int = 4):
        super().__init__()
        assert d_a % CF_HEADS == 0
        self.d_dna = d_dna
        self.d_a = d_a
        self.hd = d_a // CF_HEADS
        self.assay_emb = nn.Embedding(N_ASSAY_ID, d_a)
        self.dna = DNATower(d_dna)
        self.dna_film = nn.Linear(d_a, 2 * d_dna)
        in_dim = 7 + d_a + d_dna                            # 7 scalar feats (+ avg-ref) + assay emb + dna
        self.in_proj = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(in_dim, d), nn.GELU(), nn.LayerNorm(d))
        self.query_emb = nn.Embedding(N_ASSAY_ID, d)
        nn.init.normal_(self.query_emb.weight, std=0.02)
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList()
        dils = [1, 2, 4, 8]
        for i in range(n_blocks):
            self.blocks.append(Spatial(d, dil=dils[i % len(dils)]))
            self.blocks.append(CrossAssay(d))
        # explicit MULTI-HEAD cross-assay CF affinity (H independent bilinear forms)
        self.cf_W = nn.Parameter(torch.eye(self.hd)[None].repeat(CF_HEADS, 1, 1))  # [H,hd,hd]
        self.cf_gate = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(N_ASSAY_ID))   # per-assay pass-through of CF prior
        self.head_r = nn.Linear(d, 1)        # NB dispersion (depth-free)
        self.head_mu = nn.Linear(d, 1)       # NB base enrichment (depth-free)
        # DECOUPLED depth-free DEVIATION readout: imputation (masked) vs denoising (kept) pathways.
        # Final layer SMALL-init (std 1e-2) so the model starts ~at the reference+CF baseline yet
        # carries a small live deviation signal immediately (ENCODE-challenge prior §3.6a).
        self.head_sig_imp = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(d + 1 + CF_HEADS, d), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(d, 1))  # masked positions
        self.head_sig_den = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(d + 1 + CF_HEADS, d), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(d, 1))  # kept positions
        for head in (self.head_sig_imp, self.head_sig_den):
            nn.init.normal_(head[-1].weight, std=1e-2); nn.init.zeros_(head[-1].bias)
        # COVARIATE-ROLE pathway: target (read_length, run_type) -> light additive level bias.
        self.cov_bias = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(2, d_a), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(d_a, 1))
        nn.init.zeros_(self.cov_bias[-1].weight); nn.init.zeros_(self.cov_bias[-1].bias)
        self.disp_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(N_ASSAY_ID))
        # AVERAGE-REFERENCE gate: per-target-assay coefficient on the cross-assay activity prior.
        # Init at 1.0 so the strong, leak-free baseline is the DOMINANT carrier from step 0 and the
        # small-init learned heads start by modelling the *deviation* around it (§3.6a).
        self.ref_gate = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(N_ASSAY_ID))
        self.sig_scale = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(N_ASSAY_ID))
        self.sig_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(N_ASSAY_ID))
        self.pk_scale = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(N_ASSAY_ID))
        self.pk_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(N_ASSAY_ID))

    def _aid(self, x_meta):
        return x_meta[:, 1, :].round().long().clamp(0, N_ASSAY_ID - 1)   # [B,F]

    def forward(self, x_counts, x_avail, x_mask, x_meta, x_dna,
                control, ctrl_avail, y_meta, query_mask):
        B = x_counts.shape[0]
        aid = self._aid(y_meta)                                        # [B,F] target assay ids

        dna = self.dna(x_dna)[:, :, None, :].expand(B, L, F, self.d_dna)
        ae = self.assay_emb(aid)                                       # [B,F,d_a]
        gamma, beta = self.dna_film(ae).chunk(2, dim=-1)
        dna = dna * (1.0 + gamma[:, None]) + beta[:, None]

        # depth-free enrichment of the OBSERVED context (input depth), in arcsinh units
        size_in = torch.pow(2.0, (x_meta[:, 0, :] - REF_DEPTH).clamp(-4, 4)).clamp(min=1e-6)  # [B,F]
        enr_in = torch.arcsinh(x_counts.clamp(min=0) / size_in[:, None, :])                   # [B,L,F]
        # --- AVERAGE REFERENCE: mean enrichment over genuinely-present context assays [B,L] ---
        avail_f = x_avail[:, None, :]                                  # [B,1,F]
        ref = (enr_in * avail_f).sum(dim=2) / x_avail.sum(dim=1, keepdim=True).clamp(min=1.0)  # [B,L]
        ref_b = ref[:, :, None].expand(B, L, F)                        # broadcast to all assays

        cnt = torch.arcsinh(x_counts) * x_avail[:, None, :]
        av = x_avail[:, None, :].expand(B, L, F)
        is_query = x_mask.float()
        dep_in = x_meta[:, 0, :][:, None, :].expand(B, L, F)
        dep_tgt = y_meta[:, 0, :][:, None, :].expand(B, L, F)
        ctrl = (control[:, :, 0] * ctrl_avail[:, None])[:, :, None].expand(B, L, F)
        scal = torch.stack([cnt, av, is_query, dep_in, dep_tgt, ctrl, ref_b], dim=-1)

        ae_b = ae[:, None, :, :].expand(B, L, F, ae.shape[-1])
        feat = torch.cat([scal, ae_b, dna], dim=-1)

        h = self.in_proj(feat)                                        # [B,L,F,d]
        qtok = self.query_emb(aid)
        h = h + x_mask.float().unsqueeze(-1) * qtok[:, None]

        # cross-assay attention reads ONLY present context assays as keys
        key_padding = ~(x_avail > 0)                                  # [B,F] True = ignore as key
        for blk in self.blocks:
            h = blk(h, key_padding)

        # --- explicit MULTI-HEAD cross-assay CF prior (depth-free), masked to present sources ---
        ae_h = ae.view(B, F, CF_HEADS, self.hd)                       # [B,F,H,hd]
        aff = torch.einsum('bfhd,hde,bghe->bfgh', ae_h, self.cf_W, ae_h)   # [B,F,F,H]
        key_ok = (x_avail > 0)[:, None, :, None]                      # [B,1,F,1] present as source
        aff = aff.masked_fill(~key_ok, -1e9)
        p = torch.softmax(aff, dim=2)                                # [B,F,F,H] over source g
        cf_prior = torch.einsum('bfgh,blg->blfh', p, enr_in)         # [B,L,F,H] H CF estimates
        cf_mean = cf_prior.mean(dim=-1)                              # [B,L,F] CF deviation estimate

        disp = self.disp_bias[aid][:, None, :]
        r = Fn.softplus(self.head_r(h).squeeze(-1) + disp) + 1e-2
        mu_base = Fn.softplus(self.head_mu(h).squeeze(-1)) + 1e-3     # depth-free enrichment
        size = torch.pow(2.0, (y_meta[:, 0, :] - REF_DEPTH).clamp(-4, 4))[:, None, :]
        mu = mu_base * size
        probs = (mu / (mu + r)).clamp(1e-4, 1 - 1e-4)
        count_dist = torch.distributions.NegativeBinomial(total_count=r, probs=probs)

        log_enr = torch.log(mu_base + 1e-3).unsqueeze(-1)            # physics-grounded rank prior
        feat_sig = torch.cat([h, log_enr, cf_prior], dim=-1)
        delta_imp = self.head_sig_imp(feat_sig).squeeze(-1)          # masked-position residual
        delta_den = self.head_sig_den(feat_sig).squeeze(-1)          # kept-position residual
        delta = torch.where(x_mask, delta_imp, delta_den)           # decoupled pathway selection

        # COVARIATE-ROLE additive bias from TARGET (read_length, run_type) — protocol level offset
        cov = torch.stack([y_meta[:, 2, :] / 100.0, y_meta[:, 3, :]], dim=-1)  # [B,F,2]
        cov_b = self.cov_bias(cov).squeeze(-1)[:, None, :]          # [B,1,F]

        gate = self.cf_gate[aid][:, None, :]
        rgate = self.ref_gate[aid][:, None, :]
        # RESIDUAL-ON-REFERENCE: strong leak-free baseline (reference + CF deviation) is the
        # carrier; the small-init learned heads add the cell-type-specific deviation Δ.
        combined = rgate * ref_b + gate * cf_mean + cov_b + delta
        sc = self.sig_scale[aid][:, None, :]
        bi = self.sig_bias[aid][:, None, :]
        signal_pred = combined * sc + bi
        pk = self.pk_scale[aid][:, None, :]
        pb = self.pk_bias[aid][:, None, :]
        peak_prob = torch.sigmoid(signal_pred * pk + pb)
        return {"count_dist": count_dist, "signal_pred": signal_pred, "peak_prob": peak_prob}


class Objective:
    """ONE noise process: sample a depth level (denoising) AND mask present assays (imputation).
    Curriculum: 70% deployment-matched low-mask (1–2 assays), 30% heavier. NB target = full-depth
    raw counts; signal target = depth-free enrichment arcsinh(y_counts/size). Loss =
    correlation-dominant (genome-wide + per-track value-Pearson) PLUS an UP-WEIGHTED explicit
    DEVIATION-correlation term (global + per-track) on imputed positions — correlating pred−ref vs
    target−ref, the cell-type-specific residual the held-out Spearman rewards — light Huber for
    well-posedness (de-emphasised, it competes with rank), light NB owning ECE/DCR, and a light
    cross-assay consistency anchor. No soft-Spearman surrogate. IMP_W=1.0."""

    LEVELS = [("counts", "meta"),
              ("counts_dsf2", "meta_dsf2"),
              ("counts_dsf4", "meta_dsf4"),
              ("counts_dsf8", "meta_dsf8")]

    IMP_W = 1.0   # equal weighting of imputation (masked) and denoising (kept) positions
    CONS_W = 0.3  # cross-assay consistency anchor weight
    DEV_W = 1.5   # explicit global deviation-from-average-reference correlation weight
    DEV_T_W = 0.75  # per-track deviation correlation weight (shapes each imputed assay's ranking)

    def corrupt(self, batch, rng):
        avail = batch["avail"]
        counts_full, meta_full = batch["counts"], batch["meta"]
        B, Lc, Fc = counts_full.shape
        dev = counts_full.device

        li = int(torch.randint(0, len(self.LEVELS), (1,), generator=rng).item())
        ck, mk = self.LEVELS[li]
        x_counts = batch[ck].clone()
        x_meta = batch[mk]

        heavy = float(torch.rand((1,), generator=rng).item()) < 0.3
        lo, span = (0.30, 0.20) if heavy else (0.10, 0.20)

        x_avail = avail.clone()
        x_mask = torch.zeros(B, Lc, Fc, dtype=torch.bool, device=dev)
        for b in range(B):
            present = torch.where(avail[b] > 0)[0]
            n = present.numel()
            if n <= 1:
                continue
            frac = lo + span * float(torch.rand((1,), generator=rng).item())
            k = max(1, min(max(1, n - 1), int(round(frac * n))))
            drop = present[torch.randperm(n, generator=rng)[:k]]
            x_avail[b, drop] = 0.0
            x_mask[b, :, drop] = True
        x_counts = x_counts * x_avail[:, None, :]

        sup_mask = (avail > 0)[:, None, :].expand(B, Lc, Fc).clone()
        thr = torch.quantile(counts_full, 0.90, dim=1, keepdim=True)
        y_peaks = (counts_full > thr).float()
        size = torch.pow(2.0, (meta_full[:, 0, :] - REF_DEPTH).clamp(-4, 4))[:, None, :]
        y_enr = torch.arcsinh(counts_full.clamp(min=0) / size.clamp(min=1e-6))
        # full-depth average-reference over all genuinely-present assays (matches model's prior)
        avail_full = (avail > 0).float()                                       # [B,F]
        y_ref = (y_enr * avail_full[:, None, :]).sum(dim=2) / \
                avail_full.sum(dim=1, keepdim=True).clamp(min=1.0)             # [B,L]
        return {
            "x_counts": x_counts, "x_avail": x_avail, "x_mask": x_mask, "x_meta": x_meta,
            "x_dna": batch["dna"], "control": batch["control"], "ctrl_avail": batch["ctrl_avail"],
            "y_meta": meta_full, "query_mask": (avail > 0),
            "y_counts": counts_full, "sup_mask": sup_mask, "y_peaks": y_peaks, "y_enr": y_enr,
            "y_ref": y_ref,
        }

    def _pearson_track(self, pred, tgt, track_imp):
        if track_imp.sum() == 0:
            return pred.sum() * 0.0
        p = pred - pred.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True)
        t = tgt - tgt.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True)
        num = (p * t).sum(dim=1)
        den = torch.sqrt(((p * p).sum(dim=1)).clamp(min=1e-6) *
                         ((t * t).sum(dim=1)).clamp(min=1e-6))
        corr = (num / den)[track_imp]
        return 1.0 - corr.mean()

    def _pearson_global(self, pred, tgt, sel):
        if sel.sum() < 2:
            return pred.sum() * 0.0
        p = pred[sel]; t = tgt[sel]
        p = p - p.mean(); t = t - t.mean()
        den = torch.sqrt((p * p).sum().clamp(min=1e-6) * (t * t).sum().clamp(min=1e-6))
        return 1.0 - (p * t).sum() / den

    def _deviation_pearson(self, pred, tgt, ref, sel):
        """Correlate the cell-type-specific RESIDUAL (pred-ref) vs (target-ref) on imputed
        positions — the ONLY signal that beats the average-reference baseline (§3.6a). Putting
        gradient pressure here keeps the model from coasting on the (leak-free) reference."""
        if sel.sum() < 2:
            return pred.sum() * 0.0
        refb = ref[:, :, None].expand_as(pred)
        dp = (pred - refb)[sel]
        dt = (tgt - refb)[sel]
        dp = dp - dp.mean(); dt = dt - dt.mean()
        den = torch.sqrt((dp * dp).sum().clamp(min=1e-6) * (dt * dt).sum().clamp(min=1e-6))
        return 1.0 - (dp * dt).sum() / den

    def _deviation_pearson_track(self, pred, tgt, ref, track_imp):
        """Per-imputed-track deviation correlation: for each held-out assay, correlate
        (pred-ref) vs (target-ref) ACROSS positions. Directly shapes each track's within-assay
        ranking — the per-assay component of the pooled genome-wide held-out Spearman."""
        if track_imp.sum() == 0:
            return pred.sum() * 0.0
        refb = ref[:, :, None].expand_as(pred)
        dp = pred - refb
        dt = tgt - refb
        dp = dp - dp.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True)
        dt = dt - dt.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True)
        num = (dp * dt).sum(dim=1)
        den = torch.sqrt((dp * dp).sum(dim=1).clamp(min=1e-6) *
                         (dt * dt).sum(dim=1).clamp(min=1e-6))
        corr = (num / den)[track_imp]
        return 1.0 - corr.mean()

    def _consistency(self, sig_pred, sig_tgt, cb, m):
        """Imputed tracks' per-position mean profile must CORRELATE (across positions) with the
        observed tracks' per-position mean profile (observed detached)."""
        imp_sel = (cb["x_mask"] & m).float()                 # [B,L,F]
        obs_sel = ((~cb["x_mask"]) & m).float()              # [B,L,F]
        imp_n = imp_sel.sum(dim=2).clamp(min=1.0)            # [B,L]
        obs_n = obs_sel.sum(dim=2).clamp(min=1.0)
        imp_m = (sig_pred * imp_sel).sum(dim=2) / imp_n       # [B,L]
        obs_m = (sig_tgt.detach() * obs_sel).sum(dim=2) / obs_n
        valid_b = ((cb["x_mask"] & m).any(dim=1).any(dim=1) &
                   ((~cb["x_mask"]) & m).any(dim=1).any(dim=1))   # [B] has both imp & obs tracks
        if valid_b.sum() == 0:
            return sig_pred.sum() * 0.0
        p = imp_m - imp_m.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True)
        t = obs_m - obs_m.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True)
        num = (p * t).sum(dim=1)
        den = torch.sqrt((p * p).sum(dim=1).clamp(min=1e-6) * (t * t).sum(dim=1).clamp(min=1e-6))
        corr = (num / den)[valid_b]
        return 1.0 - corr.mean()

    def loss(self, out, cb):
        m = cb["sup_mask"]
        if m.sum() == 0:
            return (out["signal_pred"].sum() * 0.0).requires_grad_(True)
        y = cb["y_counts"].clamp(min=0)
        sig_tgt = cb["y_enr"]
        sig_pred = out["signal_pred"]

        tnorm = sig_tgt / (sig_tgt.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True).clamp(min=1e-3) + 1e-6)
        hi = 1.0 + 0.5 * tnorm.clamp(0, 4)
        w = torch.where(cb["x_mask"], self.IMP_W, 1.0) * m.float() * hi
        wsum = w.sum().clamp(min=1.0)

        nll = -out["count_dist"].log_prob(y)
        huber = Fn.smooth_l1_loss(sig_pred, sig_tgt, reduction="none", beta=1.0)
        nll_t = (nll * w).sum() / wsum
        hub_t = (huber * w).sum() / wsum

        track_imp = cb["x_mask"][:, 0, :] & cb["query_mask"]
        sel = cb["x_mask"] & m

        pe_gl = self._pearson_global(sig_pred, sig_tgt, sel)
        pe_pt = self._pearson_track(sig_pred, sig_tgt, track_imp)
        dev = self._deviation_pearson(sig_pred, sig_tgt, cb["y_ref"], sel)
        dev_t = self._deviation_pearson_track(sig_pred, sig_tgt, cb["y_ref"], track_imp)
        cons = self._consistency(sig_pred, sig_tgt, cb, m)

        pk_logit = torch.logit(out["peak_prob"].clamp(1e-4, 1 - 1e-4))
        bce = Fn.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(pk_logit[m], cb["y_peaks"][m])

        return (0.5 * nll_t + 0.3 * hub_t
                + 1.5 * pe_gl + 1.0 * pe_pt
                + self.DEV_W * dev + self.DEV_T_W * dev_t
                + self.CONS_W * cons
                + 0.1 * bce)

    def configure_optimizer(self, params):
        return torch.optim.AdamW(params, lr=1.5e-3, weight_decay=3e-4)

"""CANDI v3 — cross-assay collaborative-filtering imputer with an explicit RESIDUAL-ON-REFERENCE
readout, now sharpened toward the ACTUAL held-out metric (per-assay genome-wide imputation
Spearman) and given cheap MULTI-RESOLUTION long-range context.

Regime kept from the prior best (ONE NB likelihood on raw counts with a size-factor offset
owning ECE/DCR; depth-free enrichment head matched to the depth-invariant pval target;
motif-preserving DNA tower; availability-aware set-transformer cross-assay attention; unified
dropout+downsample corruption; curriculum masking; control-optional; fixed decoder; no JEPA;
multi-head bilinear cross-assay CF prior; decoupled imp/den readout heads; cross-assay
consistency anchor; covariate-role additive bias; average-reference + CF-deviation residual
decomposition with ZERO-INIT learned heads so training starts exactly at the strong leak-free
baseline and spends all capacity on the cell-type-specific deviation).

Two targeted, mutually-independent changes this revision makes, both straight from the
ENCODE-challenge / Avocado priors (§3.6):

1. METRIC-ALIGNED SUPERVISION. The held-out score is the *per-assay genome-wide* imputation
   Spearman of the depth-invariant signal — i.e. the cell-type-specific deviation, scored
   one held-out track at a time. The previous deviation term pooled ALL imputed positions and
   assays into ONE correlation, where between-assay/between-position level offsets dominate and
   wash out the per-track residual that is actually scored. We add a PER-TRACK deviation
   correlation (correlate pred−ref vs target−ref over positions, *within each held-out track*,
   averaged over tracks) — the closest differentiable surrogate to the metric — alongside the
   existing global term for stability.

2. MULTI-RESOLUTION POSITIONAL CONTEXT (Avocado, §3.6b). We hand the model a cheap coarse-scale
   view of the average-reference shape (16-bin average-pooled, broadcast back), so it can place
   long-range enhancer/TAD-scale level structure without any quadratic attention — a memory-free
   long-range factor (constraint 2). One extra scalar input channel; no new attention.

The NB/size-factor head (DCR/ECE) and every existing loss weight are byte-for-byte identical
for clean attribution; the only additions are the per-track deviation weight and the coarse
input channel.
"""
